title.zh: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 德宗上
title.raw: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 德宗上 Volume 12 Annals 12: Dezong 1

sentences.zh: 德宗上德宗神武孝文皇帝諱適，代宗長子，母曰睿真皇後沈氏。

translations.literal: Dezong 1 — Emperor Dezong, posthumous title Divine Martial Filial Literary, bore the taboo name Shi; he was Daizong's eldest son; his mother was Empress Ruizhen of the Shen clan.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong — styled Divine Martial Filial Literary, taboo name Shi — was Daizong's eldest son; his mother was Empress Ruizhen (née Shen).

sentences.zh: 天寶元年四月癸巳，生於長安大內之東宮。

translations.literal: On guisi of the fourth month of Tianbao 1 he was born at the Eastern Palace within the Great Inner of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on guisi in the fourth month, Tianbao 1, at the Eastern Palace in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 其年十二月，拜特進，封奉節郡王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year he was appointed Special Eminent Grandee and enfeoffed Prince of Fengjie commandery.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he became Special Eminent Grandee and Prince of Fengjie.

sentences.zh: 代宗即位之年五月，以上為天下兵馬元帥，改封魯王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the year Daizong took the throne, the Prince was made commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven and re-enfeoffed Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: When Daizong acceded in the fifth month, the prince became supreme commander and Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 八月，改封雍王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was re-enfeoffed Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month his title became Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 時史朝義據東都，十月，遣上會諸軍於陜州，大舉討賊。

translations.literal: At that time Shi Chaoyi held the Eastern Capital; in the tenth month the Prince was sent to assemble the armies at Shaanzhou for a great campaign against the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: With Chaoyi in Luoyang, in the tenth month the prince gathered the hosts at Shaanzhou to crush the rebels.

sentences.zh: 十一月，破賊於洛陽，進收東都，河南平定。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the rebels were defeated at Luoyang; he advanced to recover the Eastern Capital and Henan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he shattered the rebels at Luoyang, retook the eastern capital, and pacified Henan.

sentences.zh: 朝義走河北。

translations.literal: Chaoyi fled to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Chaoyi fled north into Hebei.

sentences.zh: 分命諸將追之，俄而賊將懷仙斬朝義首以獻，河北平。

translations.literal: He separately ordered the generals to pursue; soon the rebel general Huaixian cut off Chaoyi's head and presented it — Hebei was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Generals pursued him; Huaixian soon sent Chaoyi's head and Hebei submitted.

sentences.zh: 以元帥功拜尚書令，食實封二千戶，與郭子儀等八人圖形凌煙閣。

translations.literal: For merit as commander-in-chief he was appointed Minister over the Masses, with a substantive fief of two thousand households; with Guo Ziyi and seven others his likeness was painted in the Lingyan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: For commanding the campaign he became Minister over the Masses with two thousand households' fief, and joined Guo Ziyi and seven others on the Lingyan rolls.

sentences.zh: 廣德二年二月，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second month of Guangde 2 he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangde 2's second month he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大歷十四年大歷十四年五月辛酉，代宗崩。

translations.literal: Dali 14 — Dali 14, fifth month, xinyou: Daizong died. (The reign year is duplicated in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Dali 14, on xinyou, Daizong died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，即位於太極殿。

translations.literal: On guihai he took the throne in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he ascended the throne in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬申，貶中書舍人崔祐甫為河南少尹。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on renshen, Secretariat Drafter Cui Youfu was demoted to Henan vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, renshen: Cui Youfu was demoted to Henan vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，貶門下侍郎、平章事常袞為潮州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Gate Department Vice Director and Grand Secretariat Associate Chang Gun was demoted to Chaozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Chang Gun lost his chancellorship and became Chaozhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 召崔祐甫為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Youfu was summoned as Gate Department Vice Director and Grand Secretariat Associate of equal rank.
translations.idiomatic: Youfu was recalled as vice director of the Gate Department and chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔諸州府、新羅、渤海歲貢鷹鷂皆停。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict halted annual tribute of hawks and falcons from all prefectures, Silla, and Parhae.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi tribute hawks and falcons from the provinces, Silla, and Parhae were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔山南枇杷、江南柑橘，歲一貢以供宗廟，餘貢皆停。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict stated: Shannan loquats and Jiangnan mandarins — one tribute per year for the ancestral temples; all other such tribute was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin only Shannan loquats and Jiangnan citrus were kept, once yearly for the temples; the rest stopped.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以兵部尚書路嗣恭為東都留守，以常州刺史蕭復為潭州刺史、湖南團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Minister of War Lu Sijing was made Eastern Capital commandant; Changzhou prefect Xiao Fu was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan training-and-observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Lu Sijing became Luoyang commandant; Xiao Fu became Hunan commissioner from Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷邕府歲貢奴婢。

translations.literal: On xinsi the annual tribute of slave girls from Yong prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yong's annual tribute of slave girls ended.

sentences.zh: 癸未，改括州為處州，括蒼縣為麗水縣。

translations.literal: On guiwei Kuozhou was renamed Chuzhou; Kuocang county became Lishui county.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Kuozhou became Chuzhou and Kuocang became Lishui.

sentences.zh: 停梨園使及伶官之冗食者三百人，留者皆隸太常。

translations.literal: The Pear Garden commissioner and three hundred supernumerary performers were abolished; those retained were placed under the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Pear Garden office and three hundred spare performers were cut; survivors went to the Court of Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 劍南歲貢春酒十斛，罷之。

translations.literal: The ten hu of spring wine annually tribute from Jiannan was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiannan's annual ten-hu tribute of spring wine was ended.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以司徒、兼中書令、河中尹、靈州大都督、單于鎮北大都護充關內河東副元帥、朔方節度、關內支度鹽池六城水運大使、押諸蕃部落、管內及河陽等道觀察使、上柱國、汾陽郡王、山陵使、食實封一千九百戶郭子儀可加號尚父，守太尉，餘官如故，加實封通前二千戶，月給一千五百人糧、馬二百匹草料。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Grand Mentor, concurrent Grand Secretariat Director, Hezhong prefect, Lingzhou grand protector, Shanyu northern pacification grand protector Guo Ziyi, Prince of Fenyang, mountain-tomb commissioner, with substantive fief of one thousand nine hundred households, might add the title Exalted Father, hold Grand Preceptor, other offices unchanged, total substantive fief two thousand households, monthly ration one thousand five hundred men's grain and two hundred horses' fodder.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Guo Ziyi gained the title Exalted Father and Grand Preceptor, two thousand households' fief, and rations for fifteen hundred men and two hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 以朔方都虞候李懷光為河中尹，邠、寧、慶、晉、絳、慈、隰等州節度觀察使；

translations.literal: Shuofang deputy commander Li Huai'guang was made Hezhong prefect and commissioner of Bin, Ning, Qing, Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Xi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huai'guang became Hezhong prefect and commissioner over Bin, Ning, Qing, and six other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以朔方右留後常謙光靈州大都督，西受降城、定遠軍、天德、鹽、夏、豐節度等使；

translations.literal: Shuofang right rear commander Chang Qian'guang was made Lingzhou grand protector and commissioner of the western surrender city, Dingyuan army, Tiande, Yan, Xia, Feng, and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Qian'guang took Lingzhou and the western garrisons from Dingyuan to Feng.

sentences.zh: 以朔方左留後、單于副都護渾璘為單于大都護，振武軍、東中二受降城、鎮北及綏、銀、麟、勝等軍州節度營田使。

translations.literal: Shuofang left rear commander and Shanyu vice grand protector Hun Lin was made Shanyu grand protector, Zhenwu army, the two eastern surrender cities, Zhenbei, and commissioners of Sui, Yin, Lin, Sheng, and other army-prefectures and garrison-farming.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Lin became Shanyu grand protector over Zhenwu, the eastern surrender cities, and Sui-Yin-Lin-Sheng.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔禁天下不得貢珍禽異獸，銀器勿以金飾。

translations.literal: On bingxu an edict forbade the empire from presenting rare birds and beasts; silver vessels must not be gilded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu tribute of exotic creatures was banned and gilding silver was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔文單國所獻舞象三十二，令放荊山之陽，五坊鷹犬皆放之，出宮女百餘人。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict ordered the thirty-two dancing elephants presented by Wendantu released on the south slope of Jing Mountain; all hawks and hounds of the Five Paddocks were released; more than a hundred palace women were sent out.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wendantu's thirty-two dancing elephants went free on Jing Mountain, the Five Paddocks' birds and dogs were released, and over a hundred palace women left service.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以右羽林大將軍吳希光檢校散騎常侍、兼御史中丞，充渭北鄜坊丹延都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On jichou Right General of the Feathered Forest Wu Xiguang was made acting Palace Attendant and Censor-in-Chief, commissioner of Weinan, Bian, Fang, Dan, and Yan united training observation.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wu Xiguang became acting palace attendant and censor-in-chief over Weinan and four neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以河陽三城鎮遏使馬燧檢校工部尚書，兼太原尹、御史大夫、北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Heyang Three Cities pacification commissioner Ma Sui was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Taiyuan prefect, Censor-in-Chief, northern capital commandant, and Hedong commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Ma Sui became acting works minister, Taiyuan prefect, and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以河東節度留後鮑防為京畿觀察使；

translations.literal: On renchen Hedong acting commissioner Bao Fang was made capital-region observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Bao Fang became capital-region observer.

sentences.zh: 陳州刺史李芃檢校太常少卿，為河陽三城鎮遏使。

translations.literal: Chenzhou prefect Li Qi was made acting Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Heyang Three Cities pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qi became acting grand master of splendor and Heyang pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以壽州刺史杜亞為江西觀察使。

translations.literal: On guisi Shouzhou prefect Du Ya was made Jiangxi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Du Ya became Jiangxi observer.

sentences.zh: 甲午，冊太尉子儀。

translations.literal: On jiawu Grand Preceptor Ziyi was enfeoffed in ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Guo Ziyi received his enfeoffment rites.

sentences.zh: 自開元以來，冊禮多廢，天寶中楊國忠冊司空，至是行子儀之冊。

translations.literal: Since Kaiyuan enfeoffment rites had largely fallen into disuse; in Tianbao Yang Guozhong was enfeoffed as Minister of Works — now Ziyi's ceremony was performed.
translations.idiomatic: Enfeoffment rites had lapsed since Kaiyuan; Yang Guozhong's Tianbao ceremony was the last until Ziyi's.

sentences.zh: 以江西觀察使杜亞為陜州長史，充轉運使。

translations.literal: Jiangxi observation commissioner Du Ya was made Shaanzhou chief administrator and transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Ya moved from Jiangxi to Shaanzhou as chief administrator and transport chief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔兵部侍郎黎幹害若豺狼，特進劉忠翼掩義隱賊，並除名長流。

translations.literal: On bingshen an edict stated: War Vice Minister Li Gan is vicious as wolves; Special Eminent Liu Zhongyi concealed righteousness and harbored rebels — both were struck from registers and exiled far.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Gan and Liu Zhongyi were disgraced and exiled for corruption and sheltering rebels.

sentences.zh: 既行，俱賜死。

translations.literal: After they had set out, both were ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: Once on the road, both were ordered to commit suicide.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以京畿觀察使鮑防為福州刺史、福建都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingyou capital-region observation commissioner Bao Fang was made Fuzhou prefect and Fujian united training observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Bao Fang became Fujian commissioner from the capital region.

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎、判度支韓滉為太常卿，吏部尚書劉晏判度支鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: Households Vice Minister and revenue judge Han Huang was made Grand Minister of Sacrifices; Minister of Civil Offices Liu Yan judged revenue, salt, iron, and transport.
translations.idiomatic: Han Huang became grand minister of sacrifices; Liu Yan took over revenue, salt, iron, and transport.

sentences.zh: 初，晏與滉分掌天下財賦，至是晏都領之。

translations.literal: At first Yan and Huang had divided the empire's finances; now Yan held them all.
translations.idiomatic: Yan and Huang had split the treasury; now Yan controlled everything.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥朔，御丹鳳樓，大赦天下，罪無輕重，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jihai new moon: he held court at Danfeng Tower and proclaimed a great amnesty — crimes light or heavy were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's new moon he proclaimed universal amnesty from Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 內外文武三品已上賜爵一級，四品已下加一階，致仕官同見任，百姓為戶者賜古爵一級。

translations.literal: Civil and military inside and outside of third rank and above received one step in noble rank; fourth rank and below one grade; retired officials like incumbents; commoners as household heads received one ancient noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank officials and above gained a noble step; lower ranks a grade; retirees and common householders shared in the largesse.

sentences.zh: 加李正己司徒、太子太傅，崔寧、李勉本官同平章事。

translations.literal: Li Zhengji was advanced to Grand Mentor and Grand Preceptor to the Heir; Cui Ning and Li Mian kept their posts and became Grand Secretariat Associates of equal rank.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhengji became grand mentor and grand preceptor to the heir; Cui Ning and Li Mian became chancellors while keeping their commands.

sentences.zh: 天下進獻，事緣郊祀陵廟所須，依前勿闕，餘並停。

translations.literal: Empire-wide presentations — only those required for suburban sacrifice and imperial tombs and temples were to remain as before without omission; all others were halted.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute continued only for rites and tombs; everything else stopped.

sentences.zh: 諸州刺史上佐今後準式入計。

translations.literal: Prefectural assistants and chief administrators were hereafter to enter accounts according to statute.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural deputies were required to file accounts on schedule.

sentences.zh: 諸州刺史、常參官，父在未有官，量與五品致仕官；

translations.literal: Where prefects and regular-attendance officials had fathers living without office, they were to be given fifth-rank retired status in measure.
translations.idiomatic: Officials whose fathers lived without rank could secure measured fifth-rank retirement for them.

sentences.zh: 父亡歿，與追贈。

translations.literal: Where fathers had died, posthumous enfeoffment was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Dead fathers without rank could receive posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 自至德已來別敕，或因人奏，或臨事頒行，差互不同。

translations.literal: From Zhide onward separate edicts, or memorials by individuals, or ad hoc orders on current affairs, differed and overlapped.
translations.idiomatic: Since Zhide, ad hoc edicts and memorial orders had piled up inconsistently.

sentences.zh: 使人疑惑，中書門下與詳定官決，取堪久長行用者編入格條。

translations.literal: They made men doubtful; the Secretariat and Gate Department with the review officials were to decide and take what could long be applied, compiling it into codified articles.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellery was to codify only the durable rules and end the confusion.

sentences.zh: 自今更不得奏置寺觀及度人。

translations.literal: From now on no more memorials to establish temples and monasteries or ordain clergy.
translations.idiomatic: New temples, monasteries, and ordinations by memorial were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 庚子，封元子育為宣王，次子謨為舒王，諶為通王，諒為虔王，詳為肅王，並加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengzi the eldest son Yu was enfeoffed Prince of Xuan; the second son Mo Prince of Shu; Chen Prince of Tong; Liang Prince of Qian; Xiang Prince of Su — all with the rank Opening the Government, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yu became Prince of Xuan and four younger brothers received princely titles with three-duke honors.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，封皇弟乃為益王，迅為隨王。

translations.literal: On yisi the emperor's younger brother Nai was enfeoffed Prince of Yi; Xun Prince of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi younger brothers Nai and Xun became princes of Yi and Sui.

sentences.zh: 丙午，舉先天故事，非供奉侍衛之官，自文武六品已上清望官，每日二人更直待制，以備顧問，乃以延英南藥院故地為廨。

translations.literal: On bingwu, following the Xiantian precedent, officials not of the palace guard or attendance corps — from civil and military sixth rank and above among officers of clear reputation — two each day in rotation would await orders to draft, for consultation; the former site of the medicine hall south of Yanying was made their office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Xiantian "await orders" rotation returned: two reputable officials daily south of Yanying Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔皇族五服等已上居四方者，家一人赴山陵，縣次給食。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict: clansmen of five degrees of mourning and above living in distant places — one person per household might go to the mountain tomb; counties were to supply food in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou kinsmen within five degrees of mourning could send one mourner per household to the tomb with county rations.

sentences.zh: 己未，揚州每年貢端午日江心所鑄鏡，幽州貢麝香，皆罷之。

translations.literal: On jiwei Yangzhou's annual tribute of mirrors cast at the river's heart on the Dragon Boat Festival, and Youzhou's tribute of musk, were both abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yangzhou's Dragon-Boat mirrors and Youzhou musk tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷宣歙池、鄂岳沔二都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Xuan-She-Chi and E-Yue-Mian united training observation commissions were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou two united training observation circuits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 陜虢都防禦使，以其地分隸諸道。

translations.literal: The Shaan-Guo metropolitan defense commissioner — its territory was distributed among the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Shaan-Guo defense was dissolved and its prefectures reassigned.

sentences.zh: 復置東都京畿觀察使，以御史中丞為之。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital capital-region observation commissioner was restored, held by the censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang capital-region observation was restored under the censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，處州刺史王縉、湖州刺史第五琦皆為太子賓客，睦州刺史李揆為國子祭酒，並留司東都。

translations.literal: On renxu Chuzhou prefect Wang Jin and Huzhou prefect Diwu Qi both became grand mentors to the heir; Muzhou prefect Li Hui became director of the Directorate of Education — all remaining at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Jin, Diwu Qi, and Li Hui took eastern-capital posts as heir mentors and education director.

sentences.zh: 中官邵光超送淮西旌節，李希烈遺縑七百匹，事發，杖六十，配流。

translations.literal: The eunuch Shao Guangchao delivered the Huai-Xi command baton; Li Xilie sent him seven hundred bolts of silk — when it came to light he was beaten sixty strokes and exiled.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Shao Guangchao carried the Huai-Xi baton; Xilie's seven hundred bolts of silk cost him sixty strokes and exile.

sentences.zh: 由是中官不敢受賂。

translations.literal: Thereupon palace eunuchs did not dare accept bribes.
translations.idiomatic: After that, palace eunuchs refused bribes.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔中書門下、御史臺五品已上，諸司三品已上長官，各舉可任刺史縣令者一人，中書門下量才進擬，有犯坐舉主。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict: Secretariat and Gate Department fifth rank and above, and all bureaus' third-rank chiefs and above, each recommend one man fit for prefect or county magistrate; the Secretariat and Gate Department were to weigh talent and advance nominations; if the nominee was punished, the recommender was punished.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai senior officials each nominated one candidate for prefect or magistrate, with the recommender liable for the nominee's crimes.

sentences.zh: 秋

translations.literal: Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: The annals turn to autumn.

sentences.zh: 七月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Seventh month, wuchen new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, new moon on wuchen: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使、吏部尚書顏真卿奏：「列聖謚號，文字繁多，請以初謚為定。

translations.literal: Rites commissioner and Minister of Civil Offices Yan Zhenqing memorialized: "The posthumous titles of successive sages have too many characters — please fix on the initial posthumous title."
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhenqing urged using only the first posthumous title for the former emperors.

sentences.zh: 」兵部侍郎袁傪議云：「陵廟玉冊已刻，不可輕改。

translations.literal: War Vice Minister Yuan Chuan argued: "The tomb jade books are already carved — they must not be lightly changed."
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Chuan objected that the tomb tablets were already cut.

translations.literal: The proposal was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The reform was dropped.

sentences.zh: 傪妄奏，不知玉冊皆刻初謚而已。

translations.literal: Chuan had memorialized rashly, not knowing the jade books all bore only the initial posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: Chuan had blundered: the books already used the short titles only.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔：邕州所奏金坑，誠為潤國，語人以利，非朕素懷。

translations.literal: On gengwu an edict stated: "The gold mines reported from Yong prefecture truly enrich the state, but to speak profit to the people is not Our constant intent — let men mine freely; officials must not forbid."
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yong's gold pits were opened to private mining; officials could not block them.

sentences.zh: 其坑任人開採，官不得禁。

translations.literal: On xinwei Civil Offices Vice Minister Fang Zongyan was made censor-in-chief and eastern-capital capital-region observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Fang Zongyan became censor-in-chief and eastern-capital observer.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以吏部侍郎房宗偃為御史中丞、東都畿觀察使。

translations.literal: The Right Silver Terrace Gate Guest Office's annual grain ration of twelve thousand hu was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The guest office's twelve-thousand-hu annual grain was cut.

sentences.zh: 罷右銀臺門客省歲給廩料萬二千斛。

translations.literal: Since Yongtai, those whose circuit accounts had not been dispatched, or who had memorialized and offended, or foreign envoys awaiting reply — often several hundred — were fed at the guest office at ruinous cost; hence it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yongtai hundreds of stranded envoys and punished memorialists had fed at the guest office; the drain ended now.

sentences.zh: 自永泰已來，或四方奏計未遣者，或上書言事忤旨者，及蕃客未報者，常數百人，於客省給食，橫費已甚，故罷之。

translations.literal: On renshen the mansions of Yuan Zai, Ma Lin, and Liu Zhongyi were torn down for exceeding regulations in grandeur.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yuan Zai's, Ma Lin's, and Liu Zhongyi's mansions were demolished for extravagance.

sentences.zh: 壬申，毀元載、馬璘、劉忠翼之第，以其雄侈逾制也。

translations.literal: On guiyou palace furnishings and regular tribute were reduced by thousands of items.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou palace tribute and furnishings were cut by thousands.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，減宮中服御常貢者千數。

translations.literal: On dingchou the stable horses for imperial escort were restored outside the Moon Splendor Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou escort horses returned to stables outside Moon Splendor Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，復置廄馬隨仗於月華門外。

translations.literal: On jimao an edict: princes, dukes, and ministers must not compete with the people for profit; all circuit observation commissioners' Yangzhou trade lodges were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao nobles were forbidden to trade with commoners and circuit trade lodges at Yangzhou closed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔王公卿士不得與民爭利，諸節度觀察使於揚州置回易邸，並罷之。

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict to the Court of Imperial Entertainments: foreign guests entering the capital were each to wear their own nation's dress.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen foreign envoys were ordered to wear national dress in the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔鴻臚寺，蕃客入京，各服本國之服。

translations.literal: Shangzhou's annual tribute of glue was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shangzhou glue tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 罷商州歲貢䅻膠。

translations.literal: On xinmao the empire-wide wine monopoly was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the state wine monopoly ended empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，罷天下榷酒。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict stated: state revenue is not yet supplied.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict admitted the treasury was still short.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔國用未給。

translations.literal: The opening-government salaries of the Prince of Xuan and those below were all halted.
translations.idiomatic: Princes' opening-government stipends were suspended for lack of funds.

sentences.zh: 其宣王已下開府俸料皆罷給。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiachen: Gate Department Vice Director and Associate Cui Youfu became Secretariat Vice Director and Associate; Daozhou acting chief administrator Yang Yan became Gate Department Vice Director and Associate; Huaizhou prefect Qiao Lin became censor-in-chief, associate, and capital-region observer.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Youfu, Yang Yan, and Qiao Lin were reshuffled into top chancellery posts.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，以門下侍郎、平章事崔祐甫為中書侍郎、平章事，以道州司馬同正楊炎為門下侍郎、平章事，以懷州刺史喬琳為御史大夫、同平章事、京畿觀察使。

translations.literal: On yisi Grand Master of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wei Lun was sent to Tibet; five hundred Tibetan captives were returned — to restore good relations.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wei Lun went to Tibet with five hundred captives to reopen relations.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣太常少卿韋倫使吐蕃，以蕃俘五百人還之，修好也。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict: those who died outside and returned coffins to the city were not to be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai bringing coffins into the capital from outside was permitted.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔人死亡於外以棺柩還城者勿禁。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiaxu: the Huai-Xi circuit became the Huaining army.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Huai-Xi was renamed the Huaining army.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，以淮西節度為淮寧軍。

translations.literal: On xinsi acting Minister of Punishments Bai Xiaode was made Junior Tutor to the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Bai Xiaode became junior tutor to the heir.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以檢校刑部尚書白孝德為太子少傅。

translations.literal: On bingxu Secretariat Junior Director Shao Yue was made Civil Offices Vice Minister; Drafting Section attendant Liu Nai was made War Vice Minister; Secretariat Drafter Linghu Yan was made Rites Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Shao Yue, Liu Nai, and Linghu Yan took vice-minister posts.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，秘書少監邵說為吏部侍郎，給事中劉乃為兵部侍郎，中書舍人令狐峘為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, dingyou new moon: Tibet with the southern barbarians — a host claiming two hundred thousand — raided in three columns through Mao, Fu, Wen, Li, Ya, and other prefectures, seizing commanderies in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Tibet and Nanman, claiming two hundred thousand men, overran western Shu in three columns.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉朔，吐蕃合南蠻之眾號二十萬，三道寇茂州、扶、文、黎、雅等州，連陷郡邑。

translations.literal: Four thousand troops were sent to aid Shu and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Four thousand reinforcements crushed them in Shu.

sentences.zh: 發兵四千助蜀，大破之。

translations.literal: On jiyou Daizong was buried at Yuan tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Daizong was buried at Yuanling.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬代宗於元陵。

translations.literal: On wuwu tribute of animal-shaped charcoal stoves from Jiucheng Palace and sugar-cane crafts from Xiangzhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Jiucheng charcoal stoves and Xiangzhou sugar crafts tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 戊午，九成宮貢立獸炭爐，襄州貢種蔗蒻之工，皆罷之。

translations.literal: Three thousand head of pigs kept by honorary officials were given to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand official hogs were distributed to the poor.

sentences.zh: 散官豢豬三千頭給貧民。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinwei: Court of Imperial Entertainments Director Jia Dan was made Liangzhou prefect and Shannan West circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Jia Dan became Shannan West commissioner from Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，以鴻臚卿賈耽為梁州刺史、山南西道節度觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingchou Shaanzhou chief administrator Du Ya was made Hezhong prefect and Hezhong-Jin-Jiang-Ci-Xi metropolitan defense observer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Du Ya took Hezhong and its four-prefecture defense command.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以陜州長史杜亞為河中尹、河中晉絳慈隰都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: On renwu Censor-in-Chief and Associate Qiao Lin was made Minister of Works and removed from governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Qiao Lin became works minister and left the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 壬午，御史大夫、平章事喬琳為工部尚書，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Sword-South West circuit commissioner, acting Minister of Works, associate, Chengdu prefect Cui Ning was made concurrent censor-in-chief and capital-region observer.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ning of Sword-South West added capital-region observation while keeping Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 加劍南西川節度觀察度支營田等使、檢校司空、平章事、成都尹崔寧兼御史大夫、京畿觀察使。

translations.literal: Sword-South West circuit commissioner, acting Minister of Works, associate, Chengdu prefect Cui Ning was made concurrent censor-in-chief and capital-region observer.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ning of Sword-South West added capital-region observation while keeping Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，加崔寧兼靈州大都督、單于鎮北大都護、朔方節度等使、出鎮坊州。

translations.literal: On guisi Cui Ning was further made concurrent Lingzhou grand protector, Shanyu northern pacification grand protector, Shuofang commissioner, and went out to garrison Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Ning also took Lingzhou, Shanyu, and Shuofang and marched to Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以荊南節度使、檢校禮部尚書、兼江陵尹、御史大夫張延賞檢校兵部尚書兼成都尹、御史大夫、劍南西川節度度支營田觀察等使。

translations.literal: Jingnan commissioner, acting Rites Minister, concurrent Jiangling prefect and censor-in-chief Zhang Yanshang was made acting War Minister, concurrent Chengdu prefect, censor-in-chief, and Sword-South West commissioner for revenue, garrison-farming, and observation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanshang left Jingnan to become Chengdu prefect and Sword-South West commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以朔方節度虞候杜希全為靈州留後；

translations.literal: Shuofang deputy Du Xiquan was made Lingzhou acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xiquan became acting commissioner at Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以鄜州刺史張光晟單于振武軍使、東中二受降城綏銀鄜勝等軍州留後；

translations.literal: Bian prefect Zhang Guangsheng was made Shanyu Zhenwu commissioner and rear commander of the two eastern surrender cities and Sui-Yin-Bian-Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsheng took Shanyu, Zhenwu, and the eastern surrender cities.

sentences.zh: 延州刺史李建為鄜坊慶延留後。

translations.literal: Yanzhou prefect Li Jian was made Bian-Fang-Qing-Yan rear commander.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jian became rear commander of Bian, Fang, Qing, and Yan.

sentences.zh: 楊炎素惡崔寧，雖授以三鎮，仍署此三人為留後，奪寧之權也，人皆憤之。

translations.literal: Yang Yan had long hated Cui Ning; though Ning was given three commands, Yan still appointed these three as rear commanders to strip his power — all were indignant.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yan stripped Cui Ning by posting three rear commanders despite Ning's triple command; the court seethed.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，南選使可以專達，勿復以御史臨之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jihai: southern selection envoys might report directly without censors again overseeing them.
translations.idiomatic: Southern selection envoys could report directly, without censor escorts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，制：宣王某可立為皇太子。

translations.literal: On yimao an edict stated: the Prince of Xuan may be established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Prince of Xuan was named heir.

sentences.zh: 丙寅晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of bingyin there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: At month-end on bingyin the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 詔元日朝會不得奏祥瑞事。

translations.literal: An edict forbade presenting auspicious omens at the New Year's audience.
translations.idiomatic: New Year's court was barred from auspicious-omen memorials.

sentences.zh: 建中元年建中元年春正月丁卯朔，御含元殿，政元建中，群臣上尊號曰聖神文武皇帝。

translations.literal: Jianzhong 1 — first month, dingmao new moon: he held court at Hanyuan Hall, changed the era name to Jianzhong, and the ministers offered the honorific Sagacious Divine Martial Emperor. (The source repeats the reign year.)
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jianzhong, on dingmao, he took the era name Jianzhong and received the title Sagacious Divine Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上朝太清宮。

translations.literal: On jisi he attended court at the Grand Supreme Sovereign Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he worshipped at the Grand Supreme Sovereign Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，謁太廟。

translations.literal: On gengwu he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he visited the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，有事於郊丘。

translations.literal: On xinwei he performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he offered at the suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 是日還宮，御丹鳳門，大赦天下。

translations.literal: That day he returned to the palace and held court at Danfeng Gate, proclaiming a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: The same day he proclaimed amnesty from Danfeng Gate.

sentences.zh: 自艱難以來，征賦名目頗多。

translations.literal: Since the times of hardship, tax items had multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: Since the rebellion, tax categories had proliferated.

sentences.zh: 今後除兩稅外，輒率一錢，以枉法論。

translations.literal: Henceforth aside from the two taxes, to levy one cash more was to be prosecuted as violating the law.
translations.idiomatic: After this, any levy beyond the two taxes was a capital crime.

sentences.zh: 常參官、諸道節度觀察防禦等使、都知兵馬使、刺史、少尹、畿赤令、大理司直評事等，授訖三日內，於四方館上表讓一人以自代。

translations.literal: Regular-attendance officials, circuit commissioners, army commanders, prefects, capital magistrates, and Grand Court reviewers, within three days of appointment, were to submit at the Four Directions Lodge a memorial yielding the post to one other.
translations.idiomatic: New appointees had three days to nominate a substitute at the Four Directions Lodge.

sentences.zh: 其外官委長吏附送其表，付中書門下。

translations.literal: Outer officials were to have their superiors forward the memorial to the Secretariat and Gate Department.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial superiors forwarded the same memorials to the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 每官闕，以舉多者授之。

translations.literal: When a post fell vacant, the man with the most nominations received it.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies went to the candidate with the most nominations.

sentences.zh: 王府六品以上官及諸州縣有司可並省及諸官減者，量事廢省。

translations.literal: Sixth-rank princely officials and reducible posts in prefectures and counties were to be abolished as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Princely and county posts were cut wherever possible.

sentences.zh: 天下子為父後者賜勛兩轉。

translations.literal: All who succeeded fathers as household heirs received two merit rotations.
translations.idiomatic: Heirs who succeeded their fathers gained two merit steps.

sentences.zh: 己巳，福建觀察使鮑防、湖南觀察使蕭復讓憲官，從之。

translations.literal: On jisi Fujian observer Bao Fang and Hunan observer Xiao Fu yielded their censorial concurrent posts — it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Bao Fang and Xiao Fu gave up concurrent censor titles.

sentences.zh: 自兵興已來，方鎮重任必兼臺省長官，以至外府僚佐，亦帶臺省銜。

translations.literal: Since the wars, heavy frontier posts had routinely carried capital bureau titles, down to outer staff.
translations.idiomatic: Since the wars, frontier posts had hoarded capital bureau titles.

sentences.zh: 至是除韓滉蘇州刺史，杜亞河中少尹，而領都團練觀察使，不帶臺省兼官。

translations.literal: Now Han Huang was made Suzhou prefect and Du Ya Hezhong vice prefect while holding united training observation commands, without capital bureau concurrent posts.
translations.idiomatic: Han Huang and Du Ya took observation commands without capital concurrents.

sentences.zh: 自是諸道非節度而兼憲官者皆讓。

translations.literal: Thereafter all circuits not under military commissioners who held censor posts yielded them.
translations.idiomatic: Other non-commissioners holding censor titles followed suit.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔：「東都河南江淮山南東道等轉運租庸青苗鹽鐵等使、尚書左僕射晏，頃以兵車未息，權立使名，久勤元老，集我庶務，悉心瘁力，垂二十年，朕以征稅多門，鄉邑凋耗，聽於群議，思有變更，將置時和之理，宜復有司之制。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict stated: "Eastern Capital, Henan, Huai-Hai, Jiang-Huai, Shannan East circuit transport, corvée, green-sprout, salt, and iron commissioner, Left Vice Director Liu Yan — when chariots of war had not ceased, the commission was set up provisionally; long he toiled as an elder, gathering Our affairs, heart and strength worn, nearly twenty years. We hear in council that many tax gates exhaust the districts; We seek change toward timely harmony and restore the ministries' system."
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict ended Liu Yan's transport monopoly after twenty years, citing tax exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 晏所領使宜停，天下錢穀委金部、倉部，中書門下揀兩司郎官，準格式調掌。

translations.literal: Yan's commission was halted; empire-wide funds were entrusted to the Revenue and Granaries bureaus, the Secretariat and Gate Department to select bureau directors per statute.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue returned to the ministries under chancellery-selected directors.

sentences.zh: 」是月，浚豐州陵陽渠。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict. That month the Lingyang canal at Feng prefecture was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict. That month Feng's Lingyang canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，遣黜陟使一十一人分行天下。

translations.literal: Second month, bingshen: eleven promotion-and-demotion envoys were dispatched through the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: eleven inspection envoys fanned out across the empire.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以戶部郎中韓洄為諫議大夫，以涇原節度使段秀實為司農卿。

translations.literal: On guimao Households Bureau Director Han Hui was made Remonstrance and Review Grand Master; Jingyuan commissioner Duan Xiushi was made Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Han Hui became remonstrance grand master; Duan Xiushi minister of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，貶尚書左僕射劉晏為忠州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou Left Vice Director Liu Yan was demoted to Zhongzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Liu Yan was demoted to Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，昭義軍節度留後李抱真為本道節度使。

translations.literal: On guichou Zhaoyi army acting commissioner Li Baozhen became full commissioner of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Li Baozhen became Zhaoyi's commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，貶史館修撰、禮部侍郎令狐峘郴州司馬，右補闕柳冕巴州司戶。

translations.literal: On jiayin History Bureau compiler and Rites Vice Minister Linghu Yan was demoted to Chenzhou aide; Right Supplementation Officer Liu Mian to Bazhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Linghu Yan and Liu Mian were exiled to the south.

sentences.zh: 日本國朝貢。

translations.literal: Japan presented tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: Japan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，朱泚兼四鎮北庭行軍、涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai Zhu Ci was made concurrent Four Garrisons Northern Court campaign commander and Jingyuan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhu Ci added Four Garrisons and Jingyuan commands.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，禮儀使奏東都太廟闕木主，請造。

translations.literal: Third month, bingyin: the Rites commissioner memorialized that the Eastern Capital temple lacked wooden spirit tablets and requested they be made.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: rites officials sought new spirit tablets for Luoyang's temple.

sentences.zh: 詔下議之，不決。

translations.literal: The edict was sent down for discussion; no decision was reached.
translations.idiomatic: Debate produced no decision.

sentences.zh: 庚午，監察御史張著以法冠彈中丞嚴郢浚陵陽渠匿詔不行，消郢官，著賜緋魚。

translations.literal: On gengwu Investigating Censor Zhang Zhu, wearing the law cap, impeached Censor-in-Chief Yan Yi for dredging Lingyang canal while concealing the edict and not executing it — Yi's office was struck; Zhu was granted crimson and fish.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhang Zhu impeached Yan Yi for ignoring an edict on the Lingyang canal; Zhu won crimson robes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，左散騎常侍、翰林學士張涉放歸田里。

translations.literal: On xinwei Left Palace Attendant and Hanlin academician Zhang She was sent home to his district.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhang She left the Hanlin for retirement.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以前司農卿庾準為江陵尹、兼御史中丞、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu former Minister of Agriculture Yu Zhun was made Jiangling prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Jingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yu Zhun became Jingnan commissioner from agriculture minister.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以諫議大夫韓洄為戶部侍郎、判度支。

translations.literal: On guisi Remonstrance Grand Master Han Hui was made Households Vice Minister and revenue judge.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Han Hui became revenue judge.

sentences.zh: 時將貶劉晏，罷使名，歸尚書省本司。

translations.literal: At that time Liu Yan was about to be demoted; the commission name was abolished and affairs returned to the ministry's home bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan's fall abolished the transport commission.

sentences.zh: 今又命洄判度支，令金部郎中杜佑權勾當江淮水陸運使，一如劉晏、韓滉之則，蓋楊炎之排晏也。

translations.literal: Now Hui was ordered to judge revenue and Revenue Bureau Director Du You was made acting Jiang-Huai land-and-water transport commissioner, on the model of Liu Yan and Han Huang — Yang Yan's purge of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Han Hui and Du You replaced Yan's transport system at Yang Yan's instigation.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未朔，涇原裨將劉文喜據城叛。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yiwei new moon: Jingyuan lieutenant Liu Wenxi seized the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Liu Wenxi rebelled at Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，地震。

translations.literal: On jihai there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命江西觀察使崔昭冊命回紇可汗。

translations.literal: On xinwei Jiangxi observer Cui Zhao was ordered to invest the Uyghur qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Cui Zhao was sent to invest the Uyghur qaghan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以福建觀察使鮑防為洪州刺史、江西團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On wushen Fujian observer Bao Fang was made Hongzhou prefect and Jiangxi united training observer.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Bao Fang moved to Jiangxi from Fujian.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上誕日，不納中外之貢，唯李正己、田悅各獻縑三萬匹，詔付度支。

translations.literal: On guichou on the emperor's birthday he did not accept gifts from inside or outside — only Li Zhengji and Tian Yue each presented thirty thousand bolts of silk; an edict sent them to the revenue office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the emperor refused birthday gifts except silk from Zhengji and Yue, sent to revenue.

sentences.zh: 妃父王景先、駙馬高怡獻金銅像，上曰：「有何功德？

translations.literal: The consort's father Wang Jingxian and the emperor's son-in-law Gao Yi presented gold and bronze images. The emperor said: "What merit is there? It is not what We did."
translations.idiomatic: The consort's father and a son-in-law offered golden images; the emperor refused them.

sentences.zh: 非吾所為。

translations.literal: It is not what We did.
translations.idiomatic: "That was not Our doing."

sentences.zh: 」退還之。

translations.literal: They were returned.
translations.idiomatic: The gifts were sent back.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以衡州刺史、嗣曹王皋為潭州刺史、湖南團練觀察使，御史中丞元全柔為杭州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu Hengzhou prefect, Heir of Prince of Cao Li Gao was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan united training observer; Censor-in-Chief Yuan Quanrou was made Hangzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Gao became Hunan commissioner; Yuan Quanrou Hangzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiazi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以太常少卿韋倫為太常卿，復使吐蕃。

translations.literal: On wuchen Grand Master of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wei Lun was made Grand Minister of Sacrifices and again sent to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wei Lun returned to Tibet as grand minister of sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 己卯，右金吾衛大將軍李通為黔州刺史、黔中經略招討觀察鹽鐵等使。

translations.literal: On jimao Right General of the Golden Guard Li Tong was made Qianzhou prefect and Qianzhong pacification, suppression, observation, and salt-iron commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Tong became Qianzhong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 潮州刺史常袞為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: Chaozhou prefect Chang Gun was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Gun became Fujian observer.

sentences.zh: 涇州將劉光國殺劉文喜降，涇州平。

translations.literal: Jingyuan officer Liu Guangguo killed Liu Wenxi and surrendered; Jingyuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangguo killed Wenxi and Jingyuan submitted.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午朔，中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事崔祐甫卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiawu new moon: Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Cui Youfu died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Chancellor Cui Youfu died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，築奉天城。

translations.literal: On xinchou Fengtian city was built.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou they fortified Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 加試殿中監劉海賓兼御史中丞封兵平郡王。

translations.literal: Acting Palace Aide Liu Haibin was made concurrent censor-in-chief and enfeoffed Prince of Bingbing pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Haibin, rewarded for killing Wenxi, became a pacification prince.

sentences.zh: 海賓涇州將，賞殺劉文喜也。

translations.literal: Haibin was a Jingyuan officer — rewarded for killing Liu Wenxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was a Jingyuan officer honored for slaying Wenxi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，京兆尹源休使回紇，冊武義成功可汗。

translations.literal: On yimao Jingzhao prefect Yuan Xiu was sent to the Uyghurs to invest the Martial-Righteous Successful Qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Yuan Xiu invested the Uyghur qaghan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，罷內出盂蘭盆，不命僧為內道場。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingchou: the palace Ullambana offering was abolished; monks were not ordered to perform inner chapels.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: palace Ullambana rites and inner chapels were ended.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以鴻臚寺左右威遠營隸金吾。

translations.literal: On renshen the Court of Imperial Entertainments' Left and Right Majestic Far Camps were placed under the Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Majestic Far Camps joined the Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 己醜惡，忠州刺史劉晏賜自盡。

translations.literal: On jichou (source corrupt: 醜惡 for 丑), Loyalty Prefecture prefect Liu Yan was ordered to commit suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Liu Yan was ordered to kill himself at Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，振武軍使張光晟殺領蕃回紇首領突董統等千人，收駝馬千餘、繒錦十萬匹。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiawu: Zhenwu commissioner Zhang Guangsheng killed more than a thousand Uyghur leaders led by Tudu Tong and others, seizing over a thousand camels and horses and one hundred thousand bolts of brocade.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhang Guangsheng massacred Uyghur leaders and seized vast booty.

sentences.zh: 乃徵光晟歸朝，以彭令芳代之。

translations.literal: Guangsheng was then summoned to court; Peng Lingfang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Guangsheng was recalled; Peng Lingfang replaced him.

sentences.zh: 乙未，河中晉、絳觀察使杜亞為睦州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiwei Hezhong-Jin-Jiang observer Du Ya was made Muzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Du Ya was demoted to Muzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，加朱泚中書令，餘官使並如故。

translations.literal: On dingwei Zhu Ci was advanced to Grand Secretariat Director; other posts unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhu Ci became grand secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 以舒王謨為涇原節度大使，尚書右丞孟皞為涇州刺史、知留後。

translations.literal: Prince of Shu Mo was made Jingyuan commissioner-in-chief; Right Vice Director Meng Hao was made Jing prefect and acting rear commander.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shu Mo headed Jingyuan; Meng Hao held Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 東僰烏蠻守來朝貢。

translations.literal: Eastern Bo Wuman chieftains came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Bo chieftains presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遙尊上母沈氏曰皇太后。

translations.literal: On dingsi the emperor's mother Lady Shen was honored as empress dowager from afar.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Empress Shen was proclaimed from afar.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以吏部尚書顏真卿為太子少師，依前禮儀使。

translations.literal: On wuwu Minister of Civil Offices Yan Zhenqing was made Junior Tutor to the Heir, still Rites commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Yan Zhenqing became junior tutor while keeping rites duties.

sentences.zh: 改封嗣舒王藻為嗣郢王。

translations.literal: Heir of Prince of Shu Zao was re-enfeoffed Heir of Prince of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: The heir of Shu was re-titled heir of Ying.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，判度支韓洄奏請於商州紅崖冶洛源監置十爐鑄錢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuchen: revenue judge Han Hui memorialized to set up ten furnaces casting coin at Shangzhou Hongya, Luoyuan, and supervisory smelters.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Han Hui sought ten new mints in Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 江淮七監每鑄一千費二千文，請皆罷，從之。

translations.literal: The seven Jiang-Huai mints cost two thousand cash per thousand cast — all were requested abolished; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai mints, too costly, were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己卯，雷。

translations.literal: On jimao there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，貶尚書左丞薛邕為連山尉，坐贓也。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, jiawu: Left Secretariat Director Xue Yong was demoted to Lianshan district magistrate for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Xue Yong was exiled for graft.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太子少傅、昌化郡王白孝德卒。

translations.literal: On yisi Junior Tutor to the Heir, Prince of Changhua Bai Xiaode died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Bai Xiaode died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以睦王述為奉迎皇太后使，工部尚書喬琳為副。

translations.literal: On gengyin Prince of Mu Shu was made commissioner to welcome the empress dowager; Works Minister Qiao Lin was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince of Mu led the mission to welcome Empress Shen.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉朔，朝集使及貢使見於宣政殿，兵興已來，四方州府不上計、內外不朝會者二十有五年，至此始復舊制。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinyou new moon: assembly envoys and tribute envoys were received at Xuanzheng Hall — since the wars, circuits had not filed accounts nor had inside and outside attended court for twenty-five years; now the old system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: after twenty-five years, provincial assemblies and tribute audiences returned.

sentences.zh: 州府朝集者一百七十三人，詔每令分番二人待詔。

translations.literal: One hundred seventy-three circuits attended; an edict ordered two waiting on rotation at court.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred seventy-three delegations came; two at a time waited on the emperor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，贈敬暉等五王官，又贈張九齡司徒，鐘紹京太子太傅。

translations.literal: On yichou the five kings including Jing Hui were posthumously enfeoffed; Zhang Jiuling was posthumously made Grand Mentor; Zhong Shaojing Grand Preceptor to the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou loyal Tang princes and Zhang Jiuling received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，諸王有官者初令出閣就班。

translations.literal: On wuyin princes who held office were first ordered to leave the palace and take court ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin titled princes began attending court outside the palace.

sentences.zh: 又出嫁岳陽等一十縣主，皆在諸王院久而未適人者，上悉命以禮出降。

translations.literal: Ten county princesses of Yueyang and others, long unmarried in the princes' hostel, were all ordered married by ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Ten long-unwed princesses were married off by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，韋倫使回，與吐蕃宰相論欽明思等五十五人同至，獻方物，修好也。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinmao: Wei Lun returned from mission with fifty-five Tibetans including the minister Lun Qinmingsi, presenting gifts — relations were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Wei Lun returned with Tibetan envoys bearing gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，令詳定國初以來將相功臣房玄齡等一百八十七人，據功績分為三等。

translations.literal: On dingyou an order was given to classify one hundred eighty-seven founding ministers from Fang Xuanling onward into three grades of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou founding ministers were ranked in three grades of merit.

sentences.zh: 是歲，戶部計帳，戶總三百八萬五千七十有六，賦入一千三百五萬六千七十貫，鹽利不在此限。

translations.literal: That year the Households account: households totaled 3,085,076; tax revenue 13,056,070 strings — salt profits not included.
translations.idiomatic: That year the census counted 3,085,076 households and 13.06 million strings in tax.

sentences.zh: 建中二年二年春正月庚申朔。

translations.literal: Jianzhong 2 — first month, gengshen new moon. (The source repeats the year numeral.)
translations.idiomatic: Jianzhong 2 opened on gengshen, first month.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，成德軍節度、恆定等州觀察使、司空、兼太子太傅、同中書門下平章事、恆州刺史、隴西郡王李寶臣卒。

translations.literal: On wuchen Chengdé commissioner, Heng-Ding observer, Minister of Works, Grand Preceptor to the Heir, associate, Hengzhou prefect, Prince of Longxi Li Baochen died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Baochen of Chengdé died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以汴宋滑亳陳潁泗節度觀察使、檢校帶領部尚書、同平章事李勉為永平軍節度、汴滑陳等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: On bingzi Bian-Song-Slip-Chen commissioner Li Mian was made Yongping commissioner over Bian, Slip, and Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Mian became Yongping commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以兵部尚書、東都留守路嗣恭為鄭汝陜河陽三城節度、東畿觀察等使；

translations.literal: War Minister and Luoyang commandant Lu Sijing was made Zheng-Ru-Shaan-Heyang commissioner and eastern-capital observer.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Sijing became eastern-capital observer over Zheng-Ru-Shaan-Heyang.

sentences.zh: 以宋州刺史劉洽為宋亳潁節度使。

translations.literal: Songzhou prefect Liu Xia was made Song-Bo-Ying commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xia became Song-Bo-Ying commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以鄭州隸永平軍。

translations.literal: Zhengzhou was placed under Yongping army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengzhou joined Yongping.

sentences.zh: 自去年十月無雪，至甲申方雨雪。

translations.literal: From last year's tenth month there was no snow until jiashen when snow and rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Snow finally fell on jiashen after a snowless year.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，檢校戶部尚書張獻恭為東都留守。

translations.literal: On dinghai acting Households Minister Zhang Xiangong was made Luoyang commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhang Xiangong became Luoyang commandant.

sentences.zh: 以河南尹趙惠伯為河中尹、河中晉絳慈隰都防禦觀察使，以前鄭州刺史于頎為河南尹。

translations.literal: Henan prefect Zhao Huibo was made Hezhong prefect and Hezhong-Jin-Jiang-Ci-Xi defense observer; former Zhengzhou prefect Yu Yi was made Henan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Huibo and Yu Yi swapped Hezhong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，以御史中丞盧杞為御史大夫、京畿觀察使，以桂管觀察使李昌巙為江陵尹、兼御史大夫、荊南節度等使。

translations.literal: Second month, yiwei: Censor-in-Chief Lu Qi was made censor-in-chief and capital-region observer; Gui-guan observer Li Changqi was made Jiangling prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Jingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Lu Qi and Li Changqi took capital and Jingnan posts.

sentences.zh: 以前荊南節度使庾準為左丞。

translations.literal: Former Jingnan commissioner Yu Zhun was made Left Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zhun became left director.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以容州刺史盧嶽為桂州防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Rongzhou prefect Lu Yue was made Gui prefect and Gui-guan defense observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Lu Yue became Gui-guan observer.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以門下侍郎楊炎為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，以御史大夫盧杞為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On yisi Gate Department Vice Director Yang Yan was made Secretariat Vice Director and associate; Censor-in-Chief Lu Qi was made Gate Department Vice Director and associate.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yang Yan and Lu Qi traded chancellor posts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以宋亳節度為宣武軍。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Song-Bo circuit was renamed the Xuanwu army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Song-Bo became the Xuanwu army.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以御史中丞袁高為京畿觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingwei Censor-in-Chief Yuan Gao was made capital-region observer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yuan Gao became capital-region observer.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，振武軍亂，殺其帥彭令芳、監軍劉惠光。

translations.literal: On yimao Zhenwu army mutinied, killing its commander Peng Lingfang and army monitor Liu Huiguang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhenwu troops killed Peng Lingfang and Liu Huiguang.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申朔，築汴州城。

translations.literal: Third month, gengshen new moon: Bianzhou city was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: they walled Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，大歷中李正己有淄、青、齊、海、登、萊、沂、密、德、棣、曹、濮、徐、兗、鄆十五州之地，李寶臣有恆、定、易、趙、深、冀、滄七州之地，田承嗣有魏、博、相、衛、洺、貝、澶七州之地，梁崇義有襄、鄧、均、房、復、郢六州之地，各聚兵數萬。

translations.literal: At first in Dali, Li Zhengji held fifteen prefectures from Zi to Yan; Li Baochen seven from Heng to Cang; Tian Chengsi seven from Wei to Cao; Liang Chongyi six from Xiang to Ying — each mustered tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In Dali four warlords held vast domains and huge armies.

sentences.zh: 始因叛亂得位，雖朝廷寵待加恩，心猶疑貳，皆連衡盤結以自固。

translations.literal: They had first won office through rebellion; though the court heaped favor on them, their hearts remained doubtful and they allied to secure themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel-born commanders stayed allied against the court despite imperial favors.

sentences.zh: 朝廷增一城，浚一池，便飛語有辭，而諸盜完城繕甲，略無寧日。

translations.literal: If the court added a city or dredged a moat, rumor flew; the bandits repaired walls and armor — scarcely a peaceful day.
translations.idiomatic: Every court fortification provoked warlord armament and rumor.

sentences.zh: 至是田悅初稟命，劉文喜殄除，群兇震懼。

translations.literal: Now Tian Yue first submitted, Liu Wenxi was destroyed, and the ringleaders were terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Yue's submission and Wenxi's fall terrified the warlords.

sentences.zh: 又奏計者還，都無賜與，既歸，皆構怨言。

translations.literal: When account envoys returned without gifts, they all nursed grievances.
translations.idiomatic: Account envoys returned empty-handed and bred resentment.

sentences.zh: 先是汴州以城隘不容眾，請廣之。

translations.literal: Earlier Bianzhou, cramped for troops, had asked to expand the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Bianzhou had long sought a larger wall.

sentences.zh: 至是築城，正己、田悅移兵於境為備，故詔分汴、宋、滑為三節度，移京西防秋兵九萬二千人以鎮關東。

translations.literal: Now as the wall was built, Zhengji and Yue moved troops to the border; hence Bian, Song, and Hua were split into three commands and ninety-two thousand western autumn-defense troops were shifted to guard the east.
translations.idiomatic: The Bianzhou wall provoked Zhengji and Yue; the court split Henan commands and moved ninety-two thousand western troops east.

sentences.zh: 又於郾城置溵州。

translations.literal: Yin prefecture was also established at Yancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yin prefecture was created at Yancheng.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以汾州刺史王翃為振武軍使、東中二受降城鎮北綏銀麟勝等州留後。

translations.literal: On xinsi Fenzhou prefect Wang Hong was made Zhenwu commissioner and rear commander of the eastern surrender cities and Sui-Yin-Lin-Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Wang Hong took Zhenwu and the eastern garrisons.

sentences.zh: 以萬年令崔漢衡為殿中少監，使吐蕃。

translations.literal: Wannian magistrate Cui Hanheng was made Palace Aide and sent to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Hanheng went to Tibet as palace aide.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉朔，省沔州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiyou new moon: Qian prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Qian prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，襄州梁崇義兼同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On gengyin Xiangzhou's Liang Chongyi was made associate chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liang Chongyi became chancellor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，省燕州、順化州。

translations.literal: On jihai Yan and Shunhua prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Yan and Shunhua were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，並平琴州為黨州。

translations.literal: On yimao Pingqin was merged into Dang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Pingqin was merged into Dang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，貶禮部侍郎於召桂州刺史，御史中丞袁高韶州長史。

translations.literal: On dingsi Rites Vice Minister Yu Zhao was demoted to Guizhou prefect; Censor-in-Chief Yuan Gao to Shaozhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yu Zhao and Yuan Gao were exiled south.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，以軍興十一而稅。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingyin: a military-exigency tax of one in eleven was levied.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: a one-eleventh war tax was imposed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以淮寧軍節度使李希烈充漢南北諸道都知兵馬招撫處置等使，封南平王。

translations.literal: On jisi Huaining commissioner Li Xilie was made commander of all Han-north routes for pacification and disposal, enfeoffed Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Xilie was named southern-pacification commander and Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以浙江西道為鎮海軍。

translations.literal: On gengyin Zhejiang West circuit became the Zhenhai army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhejiang West became Zhenhai.

sentences.zh: 加蘇州刺史韓滉檢校禮部尚書、潤州刺史，充鎮海軍節度使、浙江東西道觀察等使。

translations.literal: Suzhou prefect Han Huang was made acting Rites Minister and Runzhou prefect, Zhenhai commissioner and Zhejiang East-West observer.
translations.idiomatic: Han Huang became Zhenhai commissioner from Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞一員為理匭使，諫議大夫一員知匭使；

translations.literal: One censor-in-chief was made Petition-Box commissioner; one remonstrance grand master supervised the boxes.
translations.idiomatic: A censor-in-chief and remonstrance officer oversaw the petition boxes.

sentences.zh: 給事中、中書舍人為監考使。

translations.literal: Drafting Section attendants and secretariat drafters were made examination supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: Drafters supervised the civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，尚父、中書令、汾旭郡王郭子儀薨。

translations.literal: On xinchou Exalted Father, Grand Secretariat Director, Prince of Fenyang Guo Ziyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Guo Ziyi died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以檢校秘書少監鄭叔則為御史中丞、東都畿觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingwu acting Secretariat Junior Director Zheng Shuzhe was made censor-in-chief and eastern-capital capital-region observer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zheng Shuzhe became eastern-capital observer.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以懷鄭、河陽節度副使李芃為河陽三城、懷州節度使，仍割東畿五縣隸焉。

translations.literal: On renzi Heyang deputy Li Qi was made Heyang Three Cities and Huai commissioner; five eastern-capital counties were detached to him.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Qi gained Heyang command and five counties.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子朔，詔曰：「二庭四鎮，統任西夏五十七蕃、十姓部落，國朝以來，相奉率職。

translations.literal: Seventh month, wuzi new moon, an edict stated: "The Two Courts and Four Garrisons oversee fifty-seven western tribes and ten surname groups; since the dynasty they have served in duty."
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: an edict praised the western garrisons' loyalty since the fall of Longyou.

sentences.zh: 自關、隴失守，東西阻絕，忠義之徒，泣血相守，慎固封略，奉遵禮教，皆侯伯守將交修共理之所致也。

translations.literal: "Since Tong and Long were lost and east and west cut off, loyal men have wept blood holding the frontier, guarding borders and rites — all from mutual governance by frontier lords."
translations.idiomatic: The edict hailed frontier lords who kept the western passes under siege.

sentences.zh: 伊西、北庭節度觀察使李元忠可北庭大都護，四鎮節度留後郭昕可安西大都護、四鎮節度觀察使。

translations.literal: "Western Garrisons observer Li Yuanzhong may be Beiting grand protector; Four Garrisons rear commander Guo Xin may be Anxi grand protector and Four Garrisons observer."
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuanzhong and Guo Xin were named Beiting and Anxi protectors.

sentences.zh: 」自河、隴陷虜，伊西、北庭為蕃戎所隔，間者李嗣業、荔非元禮、孫志直、馬璘輩皆遙領其節度使名。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict. Since He-Long fell, Yixi and Beiting were cut off; Li Siye, Li Feiyuanli, Sun Zhizhi, and Ma Lin had only held the titles remotely.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict. Western commands had been titular since Longyou's fall.

sentences.zh: 初，李元忠、郭昕為伊西北庭留後，隔絕之後，不知存亡，至是遣使歷回紇諸蕃入奏，方知音信，上嘉之。

translations.literal: At first Yuanzhong and Xin had been Yixi-Beiting rear commanders; after isolation their fate was unknown — now envoys through the Uyghurs reported them alive and the emperor rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys through the Uyghurs proved Yuanzhong and Xin still held the west.

sentences.zh: 其伊西、北庭將士敘官，仍超七資。

translations.literal: Yixi-Beiting officers were ranked in office, advanced seven grades beyond norm.
translations.idiomatic: Western officers received extraordinary promotions.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以中書侍郎、平章事楊炎為左僕射，以前永平軍節度使張鎰為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On gengshen Secretariat Vice Director Yang Yan was made Left Vice Director; former Yongping commissioner Zhang Yi was made Secretariat Vice Director and associate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yang Yan became left director; Zhang Yi joined the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 司空、淮陽郡王侯希逸卒，丁丑，以河中尹關播為給事中，同州刺史李承為河中尹、晉絳都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: Minister of Works, Prince of Huaiyang Hou Xiyi died; on dingchou Hezhong prefect Guan Bo was made Drafting attendant; Tongzhou prefect Li Cheng was made Hezhong prefect and Jin-Jiang defense observer.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Xiyi died; Guan Bo and Li Cheng took Hezhong posts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以邠寧節度使李懷光兼靈州大都督、單于鎮北大都護、朔方節度使。

translations.literal: On xinsi Binning commissioner Li Huai'guang was made concurrent Lingzhou grand protector, Shanyu grand protector, and Shuofang commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Huai'guang took Shuofang and Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以鄜坊、丹延觀察留後李建徽為坊州刺史、鄜坊丹延都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: Bian-Fang-Dan-Yan rear commander Li Jianhui was made Fangzhou prefect and Bian-Fang-Dan-Yan united training observer.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jianhui became Bian-Fang observer.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以幽州隴右節度使、中書令朱泚為太尉。

translations.literal: On renwu Youzhou-Longyou commissioner Zhu Ci was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zhu Ci became grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 田悅攻寇臨洺，守將張伾城守。

translations.literal: Tian Yue attacked Linming; defender Zhang Pi held the city.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Yue besieged Linming; Zhang Pi held out.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，平盧淄青節度觀察使、司徒、太子太保、同中書門下平章事李正己卒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinmao: Pinglu-Zi-Qing commissioner Li Zhengji died.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Li Zhengji died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以中書舍人衛晏為御史中丞、京畿觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengxu Secretariat Drafter Wei Yan was made censor-in-chief and capital-region observer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wei Yan became capital observer.

sentences.zh: 壬子，淮寧軍節度使李希烈攻襄陽，誅梁崇義，斬其同惡三十餘人。

translations.literal: On renzi Huaining commissioner Li Xilie attacked Xiangyang, executed Liang Chongyi, and beheaded more than thirty accomplices.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Xilie seized Xiangyang and killed Liang Chongyi and thirty followers.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，以易州刺史張孝忠為恆州刺史，充成德軍節度觀察使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinyou: Yizhou prefect Zhang Xiaozhong was made Hengzhou prefect and Chengdé commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Zhang Xiaozhong became Chengdé commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，加李希烈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On renxu Li Xilie was made associate chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Xilie became chancellor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，兵部尚書、翼國公路嗣恭卒。

translations.literal: On guihai War Minister, Prince of Yiguo Lu Sijing died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Lu Sijing died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以晉絳觀察使李承為襄州刺史、山南東道節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: On jiazi Jin-Jiang observer Li Cheng was made Xiangzhou prefect and Shannan East commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Li Cheng became Shannan East commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以杭州刺史元全柔為黔中經略招討觀察等使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Hangzhou prefect Yuan Quanrou was made Qianzhong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Yuan Quanrou became Qianzhong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，尚書左僕射楊炎貶崖州司馬，尋賜死。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, yiyou: Left Vice Director Yang Yan was demoted to Yazhou aide and soon ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Yang Yan was exiled to Yazhou and forced to suicide.

sentences.zh: 戊申，加宣武軍節度使劉洽御史大夫。

translations.literal: On wushen Xuanwu commissioner Liu Xia was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Liu Xia became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史李洧棄其帥李納，以州來降。

translations.literal: Xuzhou prefect Li Wei abandoned his commander Li Na and surrendered the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei surrendered Xuzhou to the court.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，宣武節度劉洽與神策將曲環大破李納之眾於徐州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinwei: Xuanwu commissioner Liu Xia and Shence general Qu Huan crushed Li Na at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Liu Xia and Qu Huan shattered Li Na at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔：「成德軍節度都知兵馬使、恆州刺史、襲隴西郡王李惟岳，以其父寶臣有忠勞於王室，惟岳隳墜父業，蔑棄國恩，縗絰之中，擅掌戎務。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict stated: "Chengdé army commander, Hengzhou prefect, Heir of Longxi Li Weiyue — though his father Baochen served the throne, Weiyue ruins his father's work, scorns imperial grace, and in mourning usurps command."
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict condemned Li Weiyue for seizing command during mourning.

sentences.zh: 外結兇黨，益固奸謀，不孝不忠，宜肆原野。

translations.literal: "He allies with criminals and deepens treason — unfilial and disloyal — fit to be exposed in the wild."
translations.idiomatic: The edict called him unfilial and disloyal.

sentences.zh: 削爾在身官爵。

translations.literal: "Strip your personal ranks and titles."
translations.idiomatic: "Your ranks are revoked."

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，貶戶部侍郎、判度支韓洄蜀州刺史，以江淮轉運使、度支郎中杜佑代判度支、戶部事。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict. On yihai Households Vice Minister Han Hui was demoted to Shuzhou prefect; Jiang-Huai transport director Du You replaced him judging revenue and households.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict. Han Hui fell; Du You took revenue.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以陜州長史李齊為河中尹，充河中晉絳防禦觀察使；

translations.literal: On dingchou Shaan chief administrator Li Qi was made Hezhong prefect and Jin-Jiang defense observer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Qi took Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 以商州刺史姚明揚為陜州長史、本州防禦、陸運使；

translations.literal: Shangzhou prefect Yao Mingyang was made Shaan chief administrator, Shaan defense commissioner, and land transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Mingyang took Shaan and land transport.

sentences.zh: 以權鹽鐵使、戶部郎中包佶充江淮水陸運使。

translations.literal: Acting salt commissioner Bao Ji was made Jiang-Huai land-and-water transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ji became Jiang-Huai transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 李納將海州刺史王涉以州降。

translations.literal: Li Na's officer Wang She surrendered Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang She surrendered Haizhou to the court.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，河中節度使馬燧檢校左僕射，澤潞節度使李抱真檢校兵部尚書，賞破田悅之功也。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengyin: Hezhong commissioner Ma Sui was made acting Left Vice Director; Zelu commissioner Li Baozhen acting War Minister — reward for defeating Tian Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Ma Sui and Li Baozhen were promoted for beating Tian Yue.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太子賓客王縉卒。

translations.literal: On bingshen Grand Mentor to the Heir Wang Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wang Jin died.

sentences.zh: 建中三年三年春正月乙卯朔。

translations.literal: Jianzhong 3 — first month, yimao new moon. (The source repeats the year numeral.)
translations.idiomatic: Jianzhong 3 opened on yimao.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幽州節度使朱滔、張孝忠破李惟岳之兵於束鹿。

translations.literal: On bingyin Zhu Tao and Zhang Xiaozhong defeated Weiyue at Shulu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhu Tao and Zhang Xiaozhong won at Shulu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔供御及太子諸王常膳有司宜減省之，於是宰臣上言，減堂廚百官月俸，請三分省一以助軍，從之。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict ordered reduced imperial and princely kitchens; the chancellors asked to cut palace and official salaries by one-third for the army — granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei court kitchens and salaries were cut a third for the war effort.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，追封皇叔僖為宋王，贈皇弟選荊王。

translations.literal: On gengchen the emperor's uncle Xi was posthumously made Prince of Song; younger brother Xuan Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen two kinsmen received posthumous princely titles.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙申，以文宣王三十七代孫齊賢為兗州司功，襲文宣公。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, bingshen: the thirty-seventh-generation descendant of Confucius Qixian was made Yanzhou registrar, inheriting Duke of Literary Glory.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Confucius's heir received Yanzhou office.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復置具員簿。

translations.literal: On xinchou the full-strength register was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the full-strength register returned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，成德軍兵馬使王武俊殺李惟岳，傳首京師。

translations.literal: On jiachen Chengdé officer Wang Wujun killed Li Weiyue and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wang Wujun killed Weiyue and sent his head to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，馬燧、李芃破田悅兵於洹水，進攻魏州。

translations.literal: On gengxu Ma Sui and Li Qi defeated Tian Yue at Huan River and advanced on Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Ma Sui and Li Qi beat Tian Yue at Huan River.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，惟岳將定州刺史楊政義以州降。

translations.literal: Second month, wuwu: Weiyue's Dingzhou officer Yang Zhengyi surrendered his prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Yang Zhengyi surrendered Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 加朱滔檢校司徒，以張孝忠檢校兵部尚書、易定滄三州節度使，以檢校太子賓客王武俊檢校秘書監、恆州刺史、恆冀都團練觀察使，康日知為趙州刺史、深趙都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: Zhu Tao was made acting Grand Mentor; Zhang Xiaozhong acting War Minister over Yi-Ding-Cang; Wang Wujun acting Secretariat Director and Hengzhou prefect; Kang Rizhi Zhao prefect and Shen-Zhao observer.
translations.idiomatic: Tang generals and turncoats received new Hebei commands.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，贈故衛尉卿顏杲卿司徒，故常山太守袁履謙左散騎常侍，故許州長史龐堅右散騎常侍，故鞏縣主簿蔣清禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, dinghai: posthumous honors for Yan Gaoqing, Yuan Lüqian, Pang Jian, and Jiang Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: martyrs of the An Lushan war were enfeoffed posthumously.

sentences.zh: 贈故驍衛將軍、代國公安金藏兵部尚書，授其子承恩廬州長史。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors for An Jinzang, Minister of War; his son Chengen was made Luzhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: An Jinzang was honored; his son received office.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以徐州刺史李洧為徐、沂、海團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On yiwei Xuzhou prefect Li Wei was made Xu-Yi-Hai training observer.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Wei became Xu-Yi-Hai observer.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，田悅、洺州刺史田昂以城降。

translations.literal: On wuxu Tian Yue and Luozhou prefect Tian Ang surrendered their city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Tian Yue and Tian Ang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 以嶺南節度使張伯儀檢校兵部尚書，兼江陵尹、御史大夫、荊南節度等使；

translations.literal: Lingnan commissioner Zhang Boyi was made acting War Minister, Jiangling prefect, censor-in-chief, and Jingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Boyi took Jingnan from Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 以容管經略使元琇為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: Rong-guan commissioner Yuan Xiu was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Xiu became Lingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，貶京兆尹盧惎撫州長史。

translations.literal: On bingwu Jingzhao prefect Lu Ji was demoted to Fuzhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Lu Ji was exiled to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，李納守德州將李士真、守棣州將李長卿皆以城降。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Li Na's Dezhou officer Li Shizhen and Di prefecture officer Li Changqing surrendered their cities.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: two of Li Na's officers surrendered De and Di.

sentences.zh: 庚申，先陷蕃僧尼將士八百人自吐蕃而還。

translations.literal: On gengshen eight hundred monks, nuns, soldiers, and officials long captive in Tibet returned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen eight hundred captives returned from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，封朱滔為通義郡王。

translations.literal: On renxu Zhu Tao was enfeoffed Prince of Tongyi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhu Tao became Prince of Tongyi.

sentences.zh: 朱滔、王武俊與田悅合從而為叛。

translations.literal: Zhu Tao, Wang Wujun, and Tian Yue allied in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tao, Wang Wujun, and Tian Yue rebelled together.

sentences.zh: 太常博士韋都賓、陳京以軍興庸調不給，請借京城富商錢，大率每商留萬貫，餘並入官，不一二十大商，則國用濟矣。

translations.literal: Court of Sacrifices doctors Wei Dubin and Chen Jing, citing insufficient war corvée funds, asked to borrow money from Chang'an merchants — roughly ten thousand strings left per merchant, the rest to the state; a dozen great merchants would fund the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Dubin and Chen Jing proposed seizing merchant wealth for the war.

sentences.zh: 判度支杜佑曰：「今諸道用兵，月費度支錢一百餘萬貫，若獲五百萬貫，才可支給數月。

translations.literal: Revenue judge Du You said: "Armies now cost over a million strings monthly; five million would last only months."
translations.idiomatic: Du You noted a million strings a month in war costs.

sentences.zh: 」甲子，詔京兆尹、長安萬年令大索京畿富商，刑法嚴峻，長安令薛蘋荷校乘車，於坊市搜索，人不勝鞭笞，乃至自縊。

translations.literal: Thus ended the memorial. On jiazi an edict ordered the Jingzhao prefect and Chang'an-Wannian magistrates to hunt wealthy households; punishments were harsh — Wannian magistrate Xue Ping was cangued and carted through markets until men hanged themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the memorial. The court squeezed Chang'an merchants with torture.

sentences.zh: 京師囂然，如被盜賊。

translations.literal: The capital seethed as if plundered.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an panicked like a sacked city.

sentences.zh: 搜括既畢，計其所得才八十萬貫，少尹韋禛又取僦櫃質庫法拷索之，才及二百萬。

translations.literal: When the search ended only eight hundred thousand strings were gained; Vice Prefect Wei Zhen squeezed pawnshops for two million more.
translations.idiomatic: The squeeze yielded under three million strings.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，彭王傅徐浩卒，贈太子少師。

translations.literal: On dingchou Prince of Peng tutor Xu Hao died, posthumously Junior Tutor to the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Xu Hao died.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以中書侍郎、平章事張鎰兼鳳翔尹、隴右節度使，以代朱泚。

translations.literal: On wuyin Associate Zhang Yi was made Fengxiang prefect and Longyou commissioner to replace Zhu Ci.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zhang Yi replaced Zhu Ci in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 加泚實封五百戶，賜竇氏名園、涇水上腴田及錦彩金銀器，以安其意，時滔叛故也。

translations.literal: Ci gained five hundred households' fief, Dou clan gardens, fertile Jing lands, and brocade and gold — to soothe him while Tao rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci was bribed with fiefs and gardens while Tao rebelled.

sentences.zh: 壬午，貶御史大夫嚴郢為費州長史，杖殺左巡使、殿中侍御史鄭詹。

translations.literal: On renwu Censor-in-Chief Yan Yi was demoted to Fei chief administrator; Left Patrol Commissioner Zheng Zhan was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Yan Yi was exiled; Zheng Zhan was flogged to death.

sentences.zh: 郢歲餘卒。

translations.literal: Yi died after a year.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yi died within the year.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，增兩稅、鹽榷錢，兩稅每貫增二百，鹽每斗增一百。
