translations.literal: Fifth month, bingxu: the two taxes and salt monopoly were raised — two hundred cash per string on taxes, one hundred per dou of salt.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: taxes and salt surcharges rose.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，貶太子詹事邵說歸州刺史，卒於貶所。

translations.literal: On dinghai Grand Mentor to the Heir Shao Yue was demoted to Guizhou prefect and died in exile.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Shao Yue was exiled to Guizhou and died on the way.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔朔方節度使李懷光率神策及朔方軍東討。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict ordered Shuofang commissioner Li Huai'guang to lead Shence and Shuofang troops east.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Huai'guang marched east.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔：「故伊西北庭節度使楊休明、故河西節度使周鼎、故西州刺史李琇璋、故瓜州刺史張銑等，寄崇方鎮，時屬殷憂，固守西陲，以抗期戎虜。

translations.literal: On bingshen an edict stated: "Former Yixi-Beiting commissioners Yang Xiuming, Zhou Ding, Xizhou prefect Li Xiuzhang, Guazhou prefect Zhang Xuan, and others, posted to distant commands in Our deep grief, held the western border against the barbarians."
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict praised western martyrs lost in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 歿身異域，多歷歲年，以迨於茲，旅櫬方旋，誠深追悼，宜加寵贈，以賁幽泉。

translations.literal: "They died in foreign lands across many years; now their coffins return — We mourn deeply and grant posthumous honors to enrich the underworld."
translations.idiomatic: The edict mourned officers whose bones were only now returning.

sentences.zh: 休明可贈司徒，鼎贈太保，琇璋贈戶部尚書，銑贈兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Xiuming may be posthumously Grand Mentor; Ding Grand Preceptor; Xiuzhang Households Minister; Xuan War Vice Minister."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xiuming, Zhou Ding, Li Xiuzhang, and Zhang Xuan received posthumous ranks.

sentences.zh: 」皆隴右牧守，至德已來陷吐蕃而歿故，至是西蕃通和，方得歸葬也。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict. All were Longyou governors who died in Tibet since Zhide; now, with western peace, they could be buried at last.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict: Longyou men lost in Tibet were honored as the west reopened.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加河東節度使、檢校左僕射馬燧同平章事，澤潞李抱真檢校右僕射，河陽李芃檢校兵部尚書，神策營招討使李晟右散騎常侍，賞破田悅功也。

translations.literal: On dingyou Hedong commissioner Ma Sui was made associate; Zelu Li Baozhen acting Right Vice Director; Heyang Li Qi acting War Minister; Shence commander Li Sheng Right Palace Attendant — reward for defeating Tian Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Ma Sui, Li Baozhen, Li Qi, and Li Sheng were promoted for beating Tian Yue.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，貶戶部侍郎、判度支杜佑為蘇州刺史，以中書舍人趙贊為戶部侍郎、判度支。

translations.literal: On yisi Households Vice Minister Du You was demoted to Suzhou prefect; Secretariat Drafter Zhao Zan became Households Vice Minister and revenue judge.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Du You fell; Zhao Zan took revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，易定節度賜名義武軍。

translations.literal: On xinhai Yi-Ding circuit was named the Yiwu army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Yi-Ding became the Yiwu army.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，尚書左丞庾準卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingsi: Left Secretariat Director Yu Zhun died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Yu Zhun died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，京師地震。

translations.literal: On jiazi the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Chang'an shook.

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍李涵為入回紇吊祭使，京兆少尹源休為光祿卿。

translations.literal: Left Palace Attendant Li Han was made envoy to mourn the Uyghurs; Jingzhao Vice Prefect Yuan Xiu was made Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Han mourned the Uyghurs; Yuan Xiu became chamberlain.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以前衢州刺史趙涓為尚書左丞，右庶子柳載為右丞。

translations.literal: On wuyin former Quzhou prefect Zhao Juan was made Left Secretariat Director; Right Subaltern Liu Zai Right Director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zhao Juan and Liu Zai became left and right directors.

sentences.zh: 辛未，朱滔、王武俊兵救田悅，至魏州北。

translations.literal: On xinwei Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun marched to rescue Tian Yue north of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun reinforced Tian Yue.

sentences.zh: 是日李懷光兵亦至，馬燧、抱真、李芃等盛軍容迓懷光。

translations.literal: That day Li Huai'guang's troops also arrived; Ma Sui, Li Baozhen, and Li Qi arrayed grandly to welcome Huai'guang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huai'guang arrived; Ma Sui and allies staged a grand welcome.

sentences.zh: 朱滔等慮其掩襲，遽出兵，懷光與之接戰於連篋山之西，王師不利，各還營壘。

translations.literal: Zhu Tao feared a surprise attack and rushed out; Huai'guang engaged west of Lianye Mountain — the imperial army fared ill and each withdrew to camp.
translations.idiomatic: Tao attacked; Huai'guang fought at Lianye Mountain and the court army retreated.

sentences.zh: 賊乃壅河決水，絕我糧道。

translations.literal: The rebels dammed the river and cut the grain route.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels flooded the river and starved the imperial supply line.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，以前振武軍使王翃為京兆尹，以兵部郎中楊真為御史中丞、京畿觀察使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiashen: former Zhenwu commissioner Wang Hong was made Jingzhao prefect; War Bureau Director Yang Zhen was made censor-in-chief and capital-region observer.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Wang Hong became Jingzhao prefect; Yang Zhen capital observer.

sentences.zh: 以括率商戶，人情不安，癸巳，詔除已收納入庫外，一切停，已貯納者仍明置簿歷，各給文牒，後準元數卻還。

translations.literal: Because merchant levies unsettled the people, on guisi an edict halted all collections except what was already stored; stored funds were registered and vouchers issued for later full refund.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the merchant squeeze was stopped and deposits marked for refund.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以前同州刺史蕭復為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jiawu former Tongzhou prefect Xiao Fu was made War Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Xiao Fu became war vice minister.

sentences.zh: 庚子，馬燧、李懷光、李抱真、李芃等四節度兵退保魏橋。

translations.literal: On gengzi Ma Sui, Li Huai'guang, Li Baozhen, and Li Qi withdrew to guard Weiqiao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the four generals fell back to Weiqiao.

sentences.zh: 朱滔、王武俊、田悅之眾亦屯於魏橋東南，與官軍隔河對壘。

translations.literal: Zhu Tao, Wang Wujun, and Tian Yue also camped southeast of Weiqiao, facing the imperial army across the river.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels camped across the river from the imperial host at Weiqiao.

sentences.zh: 自五月不雨，甲辰始雨。

translations.literal: From the fifth month there was no rain until jiachen when rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rain returned on jiachen after a drought since the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 宣武節度李勉為檢校司徒，懷寧李希烈檢校司空，邠寧李懷光同平章事，李芃封開陽郡王。

translations.literal: Xuanwu commissioner Li Mian was made acting Grand Mentor; Huaining Li Xilie acting Minister of Works; Binning Li Huai'guang associate; Li Qi enfeoffed Prince of Kaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mian, Li Xilie, Huai'guang, and Li Qi received honors.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，初分置汴東西水陸運兩稅鹽鐵事，從戶部侍郎、判度支趙贊奏也。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingwei: Bian east and west land-water transport and two-tax salt-iron posts were first split — per revenue judge Zhao Zan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: transport and salt offices were divided at Zhao Zan's urging.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太子賓客第五琦卒於位，辛酉，以涇原節度留後姚令言為涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On wuwu Grand Mentor to the Heir Diwu Qi died in office; on xinyou Jingyuan rear commander Yao Lingyan was made Jingyuan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Diwu Qi died; Yao Lingyan became Jingyuan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以江淮鹽鐵使、太常少卿包佶為汴東水陸運兩稅鹽鐵使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Jiang-Huai salt commissioner Bao Ji was made Bian-east land-water transport and two-tax salt commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Bao Ji took eastern transport and salt.

sentences.zh: 己巳，加劍南西川節度使張延賞檢校吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On jisi Sword-South West commissioner Zhang Yanshang was made acting Civil Offices Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhang Yanshang became acting civil offices minister.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以大理少卿崔縱為汴西水陸運兩稅鹽鐵使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Grand Court Vice Minister Cui Zong was made Bian-west land-water transport and two-tax salt commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Cui Zong took western transport and salt.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以禮儀使、太子少師顏真卿為太子太師。

translations.literal: On dingchou Rites commissioner Yan Zhenqing was made Grand Preceptor to the Heir.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Yan Zhenqing became grand preceptor to the heir.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，徐、海、沂都團練使李洧卒。

translations.literal: On gengchen Xu-Hai-Yi training commissioner Li Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Li Wei died.

sentences.zh: 江淮訛言有毛人捕人，食其心，人情大恐。

translations.literal: In Jiang-Huai a rumor spread of hairy men catching people and eating hearts — terror gripped the people.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiang-Huai rumor of man-eating 'hairy men' terrified the populace.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以李洧部將高承宗為徐州刺史、徐海沂都團練使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dinghai: Li Wei's officer Gao Chengzong was made Xuzhou prefect and Xu-Hai-Yi training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Gao Chengzong succeeded Li Wei at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 判度支趙贊上言，請為兩都、江陵、成都、鎩汴、蘇、洪等州署常平輕重本錢。

translations.literal: Revenue judge Zhao Zan memorialized to establish ever-normal light-and-heavy reserve funds in the two capitals, Jiangling, Chengdu, Bian, Su, Hong, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zan proposed ever-normal granary funds in major prefectures.

sentences.zh: 上至百萬貫，下至十萬貫，收貯斛斗匹段絲麻，候貴則下價出賣，賤則加估收糴，權輕重以利民。

translations.literal: From one million strings down to one hundred thousand, storing grain, cloth, and silk — selling when dear, buying when cheap to balance weight for the people's good.
translations.idiomatic: Funds would stabilize prices by buying cheap and selling dear.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 贊乃於諸道津要置吏稅商貨，每貫稅二十文，竹木茶漆皆什一稅一，以充常平之本。

translations.literal: Zan then placed tax officers at ferry crossings — twenty cash per string on goods, one-tenth on bamboo, wood, tea, and lacquer to fund the reserves.
translations.idiomatic: Zan taxed goods at crossings to fill the ever-normal coffers.

sentences.zh: 己亥夜，有猛獸入宜陽里，傷二人，詰朝獲之。

translations.literal: On jihai night a fierce beast entered Yiyang ward, wounding two; at dawn it was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai a beast wounded two in Yiyang ward before capture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，以湖南觀察使嗣曹王皋為洪州刺史、江西節度使。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, xinhai: Hunan observer Heir of Cao Li Gao was made Hongzhou prefect and Jiangxi commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Li Gao became Jiangxi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以吏部侍郎關播為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingchen Civil Offices Vice Minister Guan Bo was made Secretariat Vice Director and associate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Guan Bo entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 都官員外郎樊澤使吐蕃回，與蕃相尚結贊約來年正月望日會盟清水。

translations.literal: Court of Justice aide Fan Ze returned from Tibet; with Tibetan minister Shang Jiezan he agreed to ally at Qingshui on the first full moon of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ze arranged a Qingshui treaty meeting with Tibet.

sentences.zh: 丙子，肅王詳薨。

translations.literal: On bingzi Prince of Su Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Prince of Su, Xiang, died.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，以山南西道節度使賈耽檢校工部尚書、兼襄州刺史、御史大夫、山南東道節度使，以興鳳團練使嚴震為梁州刺史、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jimao: Shannan West commissioner Jia Dan was made acting Works Minister, concurrent Xiangzhou prefect, censor-in-chief, and Shannan East commissioner; Xing-Feng trainer Yan Zhen was made Liangzhou prefect and Shannan West commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Jia Dan and Yan Zhen swapped Shannan commands.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以前山南東道節度使李承為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiawu former Shannan East commissioner Li Cheng was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Cheng became Hunan observer.

sentences.zh: 是月，朱滔、田悅、王武俊於魏縣軍壘各相推獎，僭稱王號。

translations.literal: That month at Wei county the rebels Zhu Tao, Tian Yue, and Wang Wujun mutually praised one another and usurped royal titles.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hebei rebels proclaimed themselves kings at Wei.

sentences.zh: 滔稱大冀王，武俊稱趙王，悅稱魏王。

translations.literal: Tao called himself King of Great Ji; Wujun King of Zhao; Yue King of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Tao became King of Great Ji; Wujun and Yue took Zhao and Wei.

sentences.zh: 又勸李納稱齊王。

translations.literal: They urged Li Na to become King of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: They urged Li Na to proclaim Qi.

sentences.zh: 僭署官名如國初親王行臺之制。

translations.literal: They appointed officials like the early princes' field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: They copied early Tang princely headquarters in their titles.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李希烈自稱天下都元帥、太尉、建興王，與朱滔等四盜膠固為逆。

translations.literal: On dingchou Li Xilie styled himself supreme commander under Heaven, Grand Preceptor, and King of Jianxing — joining Zhu Tao's four rebels in stubborn revolt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Xilie declared himself king and allied with the Hebei rebels.

sentences.zh: 建中四年四年春正月戊寅朔。

translations.literal: Jianzhong 4 — first month, wuyin new moon. (The source repeats the year numeral.)
translations.idiomatic: Jianzhong 4 opened on wuyin.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，鳳翔節度使張鎰與吐蕃宰相尚結贊同盟於清水。

translations.literal: On dinghai Fengxiang commissioner Zhang Yi allied with Tibetan minister Shang Jiezan at Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhang Yi and Tibet allied at Qingshui.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，李希烈陷汝州，執州將李元平而去，東都震駭。

translations.literal: On gengyin Li Xilie took Ruzhou and seized prefect Li Yuanping — Luoyang was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Xilie took Ruzhou and terrified Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣顏真卿宣慰李希烈軍。

translations.literal: On jiawu Yan Zhenqing was sent to reassure Li Xilie's army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yan Zhenqing went to parley with Xilie.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以龍武大將軍哥舒曜為東都畿汝節度使，率鳳翔、邠寧、涇原等軍，東討希烈。

translations.literal: On wuxu Dragon Martial General Geshu Yao was made eastern-capital Ji-Ru commissioner, leading Fengxiang, Binning, Jingyuan, and other troops east against Xilie.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Geshu Yao marched east against Xilie from the northwest.

sentences.zh: 丙午，福建觀察使常袞卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu Fujian observer Chang Gun died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Chang Gun died.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，於河陽三城置河陽軍節度。

translations.literal: Second month, wushen: the Heyang Three Cities army command was established.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: the Heyang army command was created.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，哥舒曜收汝州。

translations.literal: On yimao Geshu Yao recovered Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Geshu Yao retook Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以工部侍郎蔣鎮充禮儀使。

translations.literal: On dingchou Works Vice Minister Jiang Zhen was made Rites commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Jiang Zhen became rites commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，復置沔州。

translations.literal: Third month, jimao: Qian prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Qian prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以左散騎常侍孟皞為福建都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On guiwei Left Palace Attendant Meng Hao was made Fujian united training observer.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Meng Hao became Fujian observer.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，嗣曹王皋擊李希烈將陳質之眾，敗之，收復黃州。

translations.literal: On xinmao Heir of Cao Li Gao defeated Li Xilie's officer Chen Zhi and recovered Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Gao beat Chen Zhi and retook Huang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，荊南張伯儀與賊戰，敗績。

translations.literal: On dingyou Jingnan Zhang Boyi fought rebels and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhang Boyi lost to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 嗣曹王收復蘄州。

translations.literal: Heir of Cao recovered Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gao retook Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，以永平宣武河陽等軍節度都統、檢校司待、平章事李勉為淮西招討使，襄陽帥賈耽、江西嗣曹王等為之副。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengshen: Yongping-Xuanwu-Heyang commander-in-chief Li Mian was made Huai-Xi suppression commissioner; Xiangyang's Jia Dan and Jiangxi's Heir of Cao were his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Li Mian led the Huai-Xi campaign with Jia Dan and Li Gao as deputies.

sentences.zh: 甲子，京師地震，生黃白毛，長尺餘。

translations.literal: On jiazi the capital earthquake; yellow-white hair a foot long grew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an earthquake grew foot-long yellow-white hair from the ground.

sentences.zh: 丙子，哥舒曜進軍至潁橋，大震雷，人死者十之三四，乃退保襄城。

translations.literal: On bingzi Geshu Yao advanced to Ying Bridge; great thunder killed three or four tenths of his men — he withdrew to guard Xiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi thunder shattered Geshu Yao's army at Ying Bridge; he fell back to Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳夜，京師地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinsi night: the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Chang'an quaked at night.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，潁王璬薨。

translations.literal: On yiyou Prince of Ying Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Prince of Ying Jun died at court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，滑、濮二州黃河清。

translations.literal: On yisi the Yellow River ran clear in Hua and Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Yellow River ran unusually clear through Hua and Pu.

sentences.zh: 滑州馬生角。

translations.literal: In Huazhou horses grew horns.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou reported horses with horns — an omen.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，初稅屋間架、除陌錢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengxu: the building-frame and market-stall taxes were first levied.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: new housing and transfer taxes were imposed.

sentences.zh: 時馬燧、李懷光、李抱真、李芃屯魏縣，李晟屯易定，李勉、陳少游、哥舒曜屯懷汝間，神策諸軍皆臨賊境。

translations.literal: Ma Sui, Li Huai'guang, Li Baozhen, and Li Qi camped at Wei county; Li Sheng at Yiding; Li Mian, Chen Shaoyou, and Geshu Yao between Huai and Ru; Shence armies lined the rebel border.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial armies ringed the rebels from Wei to Ru.

sentences.zh: 凡諸道之軍出境，仰給於度支，謂之食出界糧，月費錢一百三十萬貫，判度支趙贊巧法聚斂，終不能給。

translations.literal: All troops abroad were fed by the revenue office — "cross-border grain" costing 1.3 million strings monthly; Zhao Zan's exactions still could not supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Cross-border rations cost 1.3 million strings a month; Zhao Zan's levies failed.

sentences.zh: 至是又稅屋，所由吏秉筆持算，入人廬舍而抄計，峻法繩之，愁嘆之聲，遍於天下。

translations.literal: Now housing was taxed too — clerks with brush and abacus entered homes to tally; harsh law filled the empire with lament.
translations.idiomatic: Tax clerks counted houses door to door amid empire-wide grief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，以國子祭酒李揆為禮部侍郎，復其爵。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiashen: Director of Education Li Hui was made Rites Vice Minister and his rank restored.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Li Hui regained rank as rites vice minister.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以揆為左僕射、兼御史大夫，為入吐蕃會盟使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Li Hui was made Left Vice Director, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and envoy to the Tibetan treaty at Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Hui became left director and treaty envoy.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，李希烈率眾三萬攻哥舒曜於襄城。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingwei: Li Xilie led thirty thousand men against Geshu Yao at Xiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Xilie besieged Geshu Yao at Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 湖南觀察使李承卒。

translations.literal: Hunan observer Li Cheng died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cheng died.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，龍見於汝州之城濠。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuyin: a dragon appeared in Ruzhou's moat.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: a dragon was seen in Ruzhou's moat.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，李勉將唐漢臣、劉德信喪師于扈澗，汴軍自此不振，東都危急。

translations.literal: On bingxu Li Mian's Tang Hanchen and Liu Dexin were defeated at Hujian — Bian armies never recovered; Luoyang was desperate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Mian lost at Hujian; Luoyang teetered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，詔涇原節度使姚令言率涇原之師救哥舒曜。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingwu: an edict ordered Jingyuan commissioner Yao Lingyan to lead Jingyuan troops to rescue Geshu Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Yao Lingyan's Jingyuan army was sent to relieve Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 丁未，涇原軍出京城，至滻水，倒戈謀叛，姚令言不能禁。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Jingyuan army left the capital; at Chan water they mutinied — Yao Lingyan could not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Jingyuan troops mutinied at Chan water.

sentences.zh: 上令載繒彩二車，遣晉王往慰諭之，亂兵已陳於丹鳳闕下，促神策軍拒之。

translations.literal: The emperor sent two carts of silk to comfort them; Prince of Jin went to plead — the mutineers were already at Danfeng Gate demanding Shence resistance.
translations.idiomatic: Silk gifts failed; mutineers faced Danfeng Gate.

sentences.zh: 無一人至者。

translations.literal: Not one Shence soldier came.
translations.idiomatic: No Shence troops answered.

sentences.zh: 與太子諸王妃主百餘人出苑北門，右龍武軍使令狐建方教射於軍中，聞難，聚射士得四百人扈從。

translations.literal: With the heir, consorts, and more than a hundred kin he fled the northern park gate; Right Dragon Martial commander Linghu Jian, drilling archers, heard the alarm and gathered four hundred bowmen to escort.
translations.idiomatic: The court fled north; Linghu Jian rallied four hundred archers as escort.

sentences.zh: 其夕至咸陽，飯數匕而過。

translations.literal: That evening they reached Xianyang, ate a few bites, and passed on.
translations.idiomatic: At Xianyang they ate briefly and pressed on.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至奉天。

translations.literal: On wushen they reached Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the fugitive court reached Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 己酉，元帥都虞候渾瑊以子弟家屬至，乃以瑊為行在都虞候，神策軍使白志貞為行在都知兵馬使，以令狐建為中軍鼓角使，金吾將軍侯仲莊為奉天防城使。

translations.literal: On jiyou Marshal Deputy Hun Jian brought kin and household — he was made camp deputy; Shence commander Bai Zhizhen camp marshal; Linghu Jian middle-army drum-and-conch officer; Golden Guard general Hou Zhongzhuang Fengtian defense commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Hun Jian and Bai Zhizhen organized Fengtian's defense.

sentences.zh: 亂兵既剽京城，屯於白華，乃於晉昌里迎朱泚為帥，稱太尉，居含元殿。

translations.literal: The mutineers plundered the capital and camped at Baihua, then welcomed Zhu Ci as commander at Jinchang Lane — he styled himself Grand Preceptor and occupied Hanyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Mutineers made Zhu Ci emperor in Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 上以奉天隘，欲幸鳳翔，壬子，鳳翔軍亂，殺節度使張鎰，乃止。

translations.literal: Fengtian was cramped; the emperor wished to go to Fengxiang — on renzi Fengxiang mutinied and killed Zhang Yi, so he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: A planned flight to Fengxiang ended when Fengxiang killed Zhang Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，李希烈陷襄城，哥舒曜走洛陽。

translations.literal: On guichou Li Xilie took Xiangcheng; Geshu Yao fled to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Xilie took Xiangcheng; Geshu Yao fled.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜檢校司空崔寧薨。

translations.literal: On yimao posthumous honors were granted for Acting Minister of Works Cui Ning.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Cui Ning received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以吏部尚書蕭復，刑部侍郎劉從一、諫議大夫姜公輔並以本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On dingsi Civil Offices Minister Xiao Fu, Punishments Vice Minister Liu Congyi, and Remonstrance Grand Master Jiang Gongfu were all made associates while keeping their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Xiao Fu, Liu Congyi, and Jiang Gongfu joined the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 邠寧節度韓游瑰與論惟明率兵三千至，才入奉天，賊軍亦至，乃出拒之，王師不利。

translations.literal: Binning commissioner Han Yougui and Lun Weiming led three thousand men — just entering Fengtian when rebels arrived; they went out to fight and the court army fared ill.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yougui's relief force fought rebels at Fengtian and lost.

sentences.zh: 賊乘勝攻門，自卯至午，殺傷殆半，會有草車在門外，渾瑊令焚之，賊眾遂退。

translations.literal: Rebels pressed the assault from mao to wu hour, killing nearly half; straw carts outside the gate were burned by Hun Jian's order and the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels nearly broke Fengtian until Hun Jian burned straw carts at the gate.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，泚賊三面攻城，渾瑊力戰御之，方退。

translations.literal: On guisi Zhu Ci attacked on three sides; Hun Jian fought them off and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Hun Jian repelled a three-sided assault.

sentences.zh: 大將呂希倩死之。

translations.literal: Grand General Lü Xiqian died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Xiqian fell in the siege.

sentences.zh: 賊自丁未攻城，至己巳二十餘日，矢石不絕。

translations.literal: From dingwei the siege ran twenty-plus days to jisi without cease of arrows and stones.
translations.idiomatic: The siege rained missiles for twenty days.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，以隴右節度判官、隴州留後、殿中侍御史韋皋為隴州刺史、兼御史大夫、奉義軍節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yihai: Longyou aide Wei Gao was made Long prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Fengyi army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Wei Gao became Fengyi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 靈武留後杜希全、鹽州刺史戴休顏、夏州刺史時常春合兵六千來援，至漠谷，為賊所敗而退。

translations.literal: Lingwu rear Du Xiquan, Yan prefect Dai Xiuyan, and Xia prefect Shi Changchun united six thousand reinforcements — at Mogu valley rebels defeated them and they retreated.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand reinforcements were crushed at Mogu.

sentences.zh: 賊由是攻城愈急，矢石雨下，薨傷者眾，人心危蹙，上與渾瑊對泣。

translations.literal: Rebels pressed harder; arrows fell like rain, casualties mounted, hearts wavered — the emperor and Hun Jian wept face to face.
translations.idiomatic: As casualties mounted, emperor and Hun Jian wept together.

sentences.zh: 朱泚據乾陵作樂，下瞰城中，詞多侮慢。

translations.literal: Zhu Ci held music on Qianling, looking down on the city with insults.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci mocked Fengtian from Qianling.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賊造雲橋，攻東北隅，兵仗不能及，城中憂恐，相顧失色。

translations.literal: On wuzi rebels built a cloud-bridge against the northeast corner — weapons could not reach it; terror spread.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi a cloud-bridge threatened the northeast wall.

sentences.zh: 渾瑊預為地道，及雲橋傅城，腳陷不得進，瑊命焚之，風回焰轉，橋焚而賊退。

translations.literal: Hun Jian had dug a tunnel; when the bridge reached the wall its feet sank — he ordered it burned; wind blew flames back and the bridge burned while rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Jian burned the cloud-bridge and drove rebels back.

sentences.zh: 朔方節度李懷光遣兵馬使張韶奉表，言大軍將至，乃令舁韶巡城，叫呼歡聲動地，賊不之測，疑懼緩攻。

translations.literal: Shuofang deputy Li Huai'guang sent Commander Zhang Shao with a memorial that the great army was coming — they paraded Zhang Shao on the wall; cheers shook the earth; rebels hesitated and slackened the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shao's cry that Huai'guang was coming shook rebel morale.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，懷光軍次醴泉，是夜賊解圍而去。

translations.literal: On guisi Li Huai'guang's army reached Liquan; that night the rebels lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Huai'guang reached Liquan and the rebels abandoned the siege.

sentences.zh: 神策將李晟自定州率師赴難，軍於渭橋。

translations.literal: Shence commander Li Sheng led troops from Dingzhou to the rescue and camped at Wei Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng marched from Dingzhou and camped at Wei Bridge.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以商州都虞候王仙鶴權商州防禦使。

translations.literal: On jiawu Shangzhou deputy commander Wang Xianhe was made acting Shangzhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Xianhe became acting Shangzhou defender.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，貶門下侍郎、平章事盧杞為新州司馬，貶行在都知兵馬使白志貞為恩州司馬，戶部侍郎、判度支趙贊為播州司馬。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renxu: Gate Department Vice Director Lu Qi was demoted to Xinzhou aide; camp marshal Bai Zhizhen to Enzhou aide; revenue judge Zhao Zan to Bozhou aide.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Lu Qi, Bai Zhizhen, and Zhao Zan were exiled.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以京兆少尹裴腆判度支。

translations.literal: On guihai Jingzhao Vice Prefect Pei Tian was made revenue judge.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Pei Tian took over revenue.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以湖南觀察留後趙憬為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiazi Hunan acting observer Zhao Jing was made Hunan observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhao Jing became Hunan observer.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以祠部員外郎陸贄為考功郎中，金部員外郎吳通微為職方郎中，翰林學士並如故。

translations.literal: On yichou Court of Sacrifices aide Lu Zhi was made Merit Evaluation Bureau director; Revenue Bureau aide Wu Tongwei Personnel Bureau director — both Hanlin academicians as before.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Lu Zhi and Wu Tongwei gained bureau posts while keeping Hanlin posts.

sentences.zh: 以侍御史吳通玄為起居舍人，充翰林學士。

translations.literal: Palace Aide Wu Tongxuan was made Recorder of the Left and Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tongxuan joined the Hanlin as recorder.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以河中尹李齊運為宗正卿。

translations.literal: On jisi Hezhong prefect Li Qiyun was made Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Qiyun became director of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，李希烈陷汴州。

translations.literal: On gengwu Li Xilie took Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Xilie seized Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 以右庶子崔縱為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Right Subaltern Cui Zong was made Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zong became Jingzhao prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以中書侍郎、平章事關播為刑部尚書，司封郎中杜黃裳為給事中。

translations.literal: On guiyou Secretariat Vice Director Guan Bo was made Punishments Minister; Personnel Bureau Director Du Huangshang Drafting attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Guan Bo and Du Huangshang changed posts.

sentences.zh: 命給事中孔巢父淄青宣慰，華州刺史董晉河北宣慰。

translations.literal: Drafting attendant Kong Chaofu was ordered to reassure Zi-Qing; Huazhou prefect Dong Jin to reassure Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Chaofu and Dong Jin were sent to pacify the east.

sentences.zh: 興元元年興元元年春正月癸酉朔，上在奉天行宮受朝賀。

translations.literal: Xingyuan 1 — first month, guiyou new moon: at the Fengtian traveling palace the emperor received New Year's congratulations. (The source repeats the reign year.)
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xingyuan, on guiyou, the court celebrated New Year at Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: An edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: An edict opened:

sentences.zh: 分命朝臣諸道宣諭。

translations.literal: Senior courtiers were dispatched to announce reassurance in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers were sent to reassure the provinces.

sentences.zh: 以奉天行營都團練使楊惠元檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Fengtian camp united training commissioner Yang Huiyuan was made acting Works Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Huiyuan became acting works minister.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以吏部侍郎蕭復為門下侍郎、同平章事，以吏部侍郎盧翰為兵部侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingxu Civil Offices Vice Minister Xiao Fu was made Gate Department Vice Director and associate; Civil Offices Vice Minister Lu Han War Vice Minister and associate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Xiao Fu and Lu Han entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命宰臣蕭復往山南、荊南、湖南、江西、鄂岳、浙江東西、福建等道宣慰。

translations.literal: On wuzi Chancellor Xiao Fu was ordered to reassure Shannan, Jingnan, Hunan, Jiangxi, E-Yue, Zhejiang East-West, Fujian, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Xiao Fu toured the southern and eastern circuits.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以京兆尹裴腆為戶部侍郎、判度支。

translations.literal: On jichou Jingzhao Prefect Pei Tian was made Households Vice Minister and revenue judge.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Pei Tian became revenue judge.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以山南東道行軍司馬樊澤為襄州刺史、山南東道節度使；

translations.literal: On bingshen Shannan East staff officer Fan Ze was made Xiangzhou prefect and Shannan East commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Fan Ze became Shannan East commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以渾瑊為行在都知兵馬使；

translations.literal: Hun Jian was made camp marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Jian became camp marshal.

sentences.zh: 以前趙州觀察使康日知兼同州刺史，充奉誠軍節度使。

translations.literal: Former Zhao observer Kang Rizhi was made concurrent Tongzhou prefect and Fengyi army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Rizhi became Fengyi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔六軍各置統軍一員，秩從二品；

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict: each of the Six Armies was to have one army commander of second rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Six Armies each gained a second-rank commander.

sentences.zh: 左右常侍各加一員；

translations.literal: Left and Right Palace Attendants each gained one additional post.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant posts were increased.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客加四員。

translations.literal: Grand mentors to the heir gained four additional posts.
translations.idiomatic: Four more heir mentors were authorized.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，詔故司農卿張掖王段秀實贈太尉，謚曰忠烈，賜實封五百戶。

translations.literal: Second month, wuyin: former Minister of Agriculture, Prince of Zhangye Duan Xiushi was posthumously made Grand Preceptor, styled Loyal and Stern, with five hundred households' fief.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Duan Xiushi was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 贈滑州兵馬使賈隱林左僕射，以滑州刺史李澄兼汴州刺史、汴滑節度使。

translations.literal: Slipzhou officer Jia Yinlin was posthumously Left Vice Director; Slip prefect Li Cheng was made concurrent Bianzhou prefect and Bian-Slip commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Yinlin was honored; Li Cheng took Bian-Slip.

sentences.zh: 是日，李晟自咸陽移兵東渭橋，避懷光也。

translations.literal: That day Li Sheng moved his army from Xianyang to East Wei Bridge to avoid Huai'guang.
translations.idiomatic: That day Li Sheng shifted east to avoid Huai'guang.

sentences.zh: 晟以懷光反狀已明，請上幸蜀。

translations.literal: Sheng saw Huai'guang's rebellion plain and urged the emperor to go to Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng urged flight to Shu once Huai'guang's treason was clear.

sentences.zh: 王武俊效順，加中書門下平章事，兼幽州節度使，令討朱滔。

translations.literal: Wang Wujun submitted; he was made associate chancellor and Youzhou commissioner and ordered to attack Zhu Tao.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wujun turned loyal and was sent against Zhu Tao.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃遣使來朝，請以兵助國討逆，乃令御史大夫於頎入蕃宣諭之。

translations.literal: Tibet sent envoys offering troops to help suppress rebellion; Censor-in-Chief Yu Yi was sent to announce the court's thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet offered aid; Yu Yi was sent in reply.

sentences.zh: 甲子，加李懷光太尉，仍賜鐵券，赦三死罪。

translations.literal: On jiazi Li Huai'guang was made Grand Preceptor and given an iron tally forgiving three capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Huai'guang received an iron tally and three pardons.

sentences.zh: 懷光怒曰：「凡人臣反逆，乃賜鐵券，今賜懷光，是反必矣！

translations.literal: Huai'guang raged: "When a minister rebels he is given an iron tally — giving one to Huai'guang means rebellion is certain!"
translations.idiomatic: Huai'guang raged that an iron tally marked him a rebel.

sentences.zh: 」乃投之於地。

translations.literal: He threw it to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: He threw the tally down.

sentences.zh: 上命翰林學士陸贄曉諭之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Hanlin academician Lu Zhi to explain.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Lu Zhi to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 是日人心恐駭。

translations.literal: That day hearts were terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Panic spread through the court.

sentences.zh: 懷光奪楊惠元、李建徽所將兵，惠元被害。

translations.literal: Huai'guang seized the troops of Yang Huiyuan and Li Jianhui; Huiyuan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'guang seized Yang Huiyuan's and Li Jianhui's troops and killed Huiyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，車駕幸梁州，留戴休顏守奉天，以御史中丞齊映為沿路置頓使。

translations.literal: On dingmao the imperial carriage went to Liangzhou; Dai Xiuyan was left to guard Fengtian; Censor-in-Chief Qi Ying was made transit commissioner along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the court fled to Liangzhou, leaving Dai Xiuyan at Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 李晟大集兵賦，以收復為己任。

translations.literal: Li Sheng gathered troops and supplies, taking recovery as his personal charge.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng massed forces to retake Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 李懷光患之，移軍涇陽，連朱泚，欲同滅晟。

translations.literal: Li Huai'guang resented it, moved to Jingyang, joined Zhu Ci, and wished to destroy Sheng together.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'guang allied with Zhu Ci to destroy Li Sheng.

sentences.zh: 晟卑詞厚意，致書諭之，冀其感悟，懷光頗增愧懼。

translations.literal: Sheng wrote with humble courtesy, hoping to move him; Huai'guang grew somewhat ashamed and afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng's courteous letters briefly shamed Huai'guang.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，以秘書監崔漢衡為上都留守，右散騎常侍於頎為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Third month, jiashen: Secretariat Director Cui Hanheng was made upper-capital commandant; Right Palace Attendant Yu Yi Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Cui Hanheng and Yu Yi took capital posts.

sentences.zh: 是日，懷光燒營，走歸河中。

translations.literal: That day Huai'guang burned his camp and fled back to Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: That day Huai'guang burned his camp and fled to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 其將孟涉、段威勇等千人奔歸李晟。

translations.literal: His officers Meng She, Duan Weiyong, and a thousand others defected to Li Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand of his officers defected to Li Sheng.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以前饒州刺史杜佑為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使，加神策節度使李晟兼京畿渭北鄜坊丹延節度觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingxu former Raozhou prefect Du You was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan commissioner; Shence commissioner Li Sheng was made concurrent capital-region and Weinan-Bian-Fang-Dan-Yan observer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Du You went south; Li Sheng gained the capital region.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕次城固。

translations.literal: On gengyin the imperial carriage paused at Chenggu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court halted at Chenggu.

sentences.zh: 唐安公主薨，上愛女，悼惜之甚。

translations.literal: Princess Tang'an died — the emperor's beloved daughter; he grieved deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Tang'an died and the emperor mourned deeply.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至梁州。

translations.literal: On renshen they reached Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the court reached Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宣武節度使劉洽加冊平章事。

translations.literal: On dingchou Xuanwu commissioner Liu Xia was advanced to enfeoffed associate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Liu Xia became an enfeoffed chancellor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以行在都知兵馬使渾瑊檢校左僕射、同平章事、靈州大都督，充朔方節度使、邠寧振武永平奉天行營副元帥。

translations.literal: On jihai camp marshal Hun Jian was made acting Left Vice Director, associate, Lingzhou grand protector, Shuofang commissioner, and deputy commander of Binning, Zhenwu, Yongping, and Fengtian camps.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Hun Jian became deputy supreme commander with Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔授李懷光太子太保，其餘官職並罷。

translations.literal: That day an edict made Li Huai'guang Grand Preceptor to the Heir; all other posts were removed.
translations.idiomatic: That day Huai'guang was stripped to heir grand preceptor only.

sentences.zh: 涇州亂，牙將田希鑒殺其帥馮河清，自稱留後。

translations.literal: Jingzhou mutinied; officer Tian Xijian killed commander Feng Heqing and styled himself rear commander.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou troops killed Feng Heqing; Tian Xijian seized power.

sentences.zh: 四月辛丑朔。

translations.literal: Fourth month, xinchou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, new moon on xinchou.

sentences.zh: 時將士未給春衣，上猶夾服，漢中早熱，左右請禦暑服，上曰：「將士未易冬服，獨御春衫可乎！

translations.literal: Troops had not yet received spring uniforms; the emperor still wore layered dress. Hanzhong was hot early; attendants asked him to wear summer clothes. The emperor said: "The soldiers have not changed to winter dress — may We alone wear spring silk?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused summer silks until the army had winter coats.

sentences.zh: 」俄而貢物繼至，先給諸軍而始御之。

translations.literal: Soon tribute arrived; he gave the armies first and only then changed his own dress.
translations.idiomatic: Supplies went to the troops before the emperor changed clothes.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔奉天隨從將士並賜號「元從功臣。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict granted all Fengtian followers the title "Original Followers Merit Lords."
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Fengtian veterans became Original Followers merit lords.

sentences.zh: 」以邠寧兵馬使韓游瑰為邠寧節度伎。

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict. Binning officer Han Yougui was made Binning commissioner. (Source reads 伎 for 使.)
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict. Han Yougui became Binning commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞趙涓卒。

translations.literal: Left Secretariat Director Zhao Juan died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Juan died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以陜虢防遏使唐朝臣為河中尹、河中同晉絳節度使，御史大夫李齊運兼京兆尹。

translations.literal: On jisi Shaan-Guo defense commissioner Tang Zhaochen was made Hezhong prefect and Hezhong-Tong-Jin-Jiang commissioner; Censor-in-Chief Li Qiyun was made concurrent Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Tang Zhaochen and Li Qiyun took Hezhong and Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 魏博行軍司馬田緒殺其帥田悅，詔贈悅太尉，以緒為魏州長史、魏博節度觀察使。

translations.literal: Weibo staff officer Tian Xu killed commander Tian Yue; an edict posthumously made Yue Grand Preceptor and made Xu Weizhou chief administrator and Weibo commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xu killed Tian Yue and took Weibo.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以諫議大夫、平章事姜公輔為左庶子，加劍南節度使張延賞平章事，以前山南東道節度使貢耽為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiayin Remonstrance Grand Master Jiang Gongfu was made Left Subaltern; Sword-South commissioner Zhang Yanshang associate; former Shannan East commissioner Jia Dan Works Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Jiang Gongfu, Zhang Yanshang, and Jia Dan were reshuffled.

sentences.zh: 甲子，入蕃使、左僕射李揆卒於鳳州。

translations.literal: On jiazi Tibet envoy Left Vice Director Li Hui died at Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Li Hui died at Feng on his Tibetan mission.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，渾瑊與吐蕃將論莽羅之眾破賊將韓旻之眾於武功，斬首萬級。

translations.literal: On yichou Hun Jian with Tibetan general Lun Mangluo's host defeated rebel officer Han Min at Wugong — ten thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Hun Jian and Tibet crushed Han Min at Wugong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，加李納平章事。

translations.literal: On bingyin Li Na was made associate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Na became associate.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，義王玭薨。

translations.literal: On dingmao Prince of Yi Bin died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Prince of Yi, Bin, died.

sentences.zh: 五月，淮南節度使陳少游加檢校司徒，東川節度使李叔明太子太傅，鎮海軍韓滉檢校右僕射。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Huainan commissioner Chen Shaoyou was made acting Grand Mentor; East Chuan Li Shuming Grand Preceptor to the Heir; Zhenhai Han Huang acting Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Chen Shaoyou, Li Shuming, and Han Huang were promoted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，涇王侹薨。

translations.literal: On guiyou Prince of Jing Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prince of Jing Yun died at court.

sentences.zh: 徐沂海團練使高承宗卒，以其子明應知徐州事。

translations.literal: Xu-Yi-Hai trainer Gao Chengzong died; his son Mingying was left in charge of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Chengzong died; his son held Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，李抱真、王武俊破朱滔於經城東南，斬首三萬級，擒偽相朱良祐、李俊以獻。

translations.literal: On bingzi Li Baozhen and Wang Wujun defeated Zhu Tao southeast of Jingcheng — thirty thousand heads; false chancellors Zhu Liangyou and Li Jun were captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Baozhen and Wujun shattered Zhu Tao and sent captives to court.

sentences.zh: 朱滔遁歸幽州。

translations.literal: Zhu Tao fled back to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tao fled to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，岳州李兼、黔南元全柔、桂管盧岳加御史大夫，岳加中丞。

translations.literal: On guiwei Yuezhou Li Jian, Qiannan Yuan Quanrou, and Gui-guan Lu Yue were made censor-in-chief; Yue also censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei three southern commissioners gained censor titles.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，李納上章稟命，乃贈李正己太尉。

translations.literal: On gengyin Li Na submitted a loyal memorial; Li Zhengji was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Na submitted; Zhengji was honored posthumously.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，商州尚可孤破賊於藍田。

translations.literal: On renchen Shangzhou Shang Keji defeated rebels at Lantian.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Shang Keji won at Lantian.

sentences.zh: 乙未，安西四鎮節度使郭昕、北庭都護李元忠加左右僕射。

translations.literal: On yiwei Anxi Four Garrisons commissioner Guo Xin and Beiting protector Li Yuanzhong were made Left and Right Vice Directors.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Guo Xin and Li Yuanzhong were promoted for holding the west.

sentences.zh: 是夜，李晟自渭北移軍於光泰門外。

translations.literal: That night Li Sheng moved his army from north of Wei to outside Guangtai Gate.
translations.idiomatic: That night Li Sheng advanced to Guangtai Gate.

sentences.zh: 賊來薄，我軍爭奪擊，大敗之，蹙入光泰門，斬馘數千計，賊黨慟哭而入白華。

translations.literal: Rebels pressed close; our troops fought to strike them, inflicting a great defeat, driving them into Guangtai Gate — several thousand slain; rebel ranks wailed as they entered Baihua.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng drove rebels through Guangtai Gate into Baihua.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，列陳於光泰門外。

translations.literal: On wuchen he formed battle lines outside Guangtai Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he drew up outside Guangtai Gate.

sentences.zh: 遣騎將史萬頃往神麚村，開苑墻二百餘步，賊樹柵當之。

translations.literal: Cavalry commander Shi Wanqing was sent to Shenli village to breach two hundred paces of park wall; rebels palisaded against it.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Wanqing breached the park wall at Shenli.

sentences.zh: 我軍爭柵，雲合電擊，與賊血戰，賊黨大敗，追擊至白華，朱泚、姚令言率眾萬餘遁去。

translations.literal: Our troops seized the palisade in furious battle; rebels were crushed, pursued to Baihua — Zhu Ci and Yao Lingyan fled with more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops stormed the palisade and chased Ci and Yao to Baihua.

sentences.zh: 晟收復京城。

translations.literal: Sheng recovered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng retook Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 是日，渾瑊與戴休顏亦破賊三千於咸陽，韓游瑰追朱泚於經州。

translations.literal: That day Hun Jian and Dai Xiuyan also defeated three thousand rebels at Xianyang; Han Yougui pursued Zhu Ci in Jing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Hun Jian and Dai Xiuyan won at Xianyang while Han Yougui pursued Ci.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子朔，升恆州為大都督府。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengzi new moon: Hengzhou was elevated to a metropolitan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Hengzhou became a metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，贈神策兵馬使楊惠元右僕射。

translations.literal: On guimao posthumous honors were granted Shence officer Yang Huiyuan, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yang Huiyuan was honored posthumously.

sentences.zh: 是日，李晟上《收京城露布》，上覽之，涕下沾襟。

translations.literal: That day Li Sheng submitted the "Bulletin on Recovering the Capital"; reading it, the emperor's tears soaked his robe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept over Li Sheng's victory bulletin.

sentences.zh: 涇州田希鑒斬姚令言，幽州軍士韓旻於彭原斬朱泚，並傳首至行在。

translations.literal: Jingzhou's Tian Xijian beheaded Yao Lingyan; Youzhou soldier Han Min beheaded Zhu Ci at Pengyuan — both heads reached the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: Ci and Yao's heads reached Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣吏部侍郎班宏入京宣諭。

translations.literal: On yisi Civil Offices Vice Minister Ban Hong entered the capital to announce reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Ban Hong entered Chang'an to proclaim order.

sentences.zh: 己酉，加李晟司徒、兼中書令，實封一千戶；

translations.literal: On jiyou Li Sheng was made Grand Mentor, concurrent Grand Secretariat Director, substantive fief one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Sheng became grand mentor and chancellor with a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 駱元光、尚可孤加檢校左右僕射，皆實封五百戶。

translations.literal: Luo Yuanguang and Shang Keji were made acting Left and Right Vice Directors, each five hundred households' fief.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Yuanguang and Shang Keji gained vice-director honors.

sentences.zh: 以涇州將田希鑒為涇州刺史、涇原節度使。

translations.literal: Jingzhou officer Tian Xijian was made Jing prefect and Jingyuan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xijian became Jingyuan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔以梁州為興元府，南鄭縣為赤畿，官名品制視京兆、河南，百姓給復二年，見任官員加兩階，耆老與版授，南鄭縣令賜緋。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict made Liangzhou Xingyuan prefecture; Nanzheng a crimson metropolitan county — offices and ranks like Jingzhao and Henan; commoners tax-exempt two years; incumbents two grades; elders placard-appointed; Nanzheng magistrate granted crimson.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liangzhou became Xingyuan fu with Nanzheng as a capital county.

sentences.zh: 加興元尹嚴震檢校右僕射，賜實封一百戶。

translations.literal: Xingyuan prefect Yan Zhen was made acting Right Vice Director, substantive fief one hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhen became acting right vice director.

sentences.zh: 加渾瑊待中，實封八百戶；

translations.literal: Hun Jian was made Palace Attendant, substantive fief eight hundred households. (Source reads 待中 for 侍中.)
translations.idiomatic: Hun Jian became palace attendant with eight hundred households.

sentences.zh: 韓游瑰檢校左僕射，實封四百戶；

translations.literal: Han Yougui was made acting Left Vice Director, substantive fief four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yougui became acting left vice director with four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 戴休顏檢校右僕射，實封二百戶。

translations.literal: Dai Xiuyan was made acting Right Vice Director, substantive fief two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Xiuyan became acting right vice director with two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 考功郎中、知制誥陸贄，司封郎中、知刺誥吉中孚，並為諫議大夫；

translations.literal: Merit Evaluation director and edict drafter Lu Zhi and Personnel Bureau director and review edict drafter Ji Zhongfu were both made Remonstrance Grand Masters — still Hanlin academicians.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi and Ji Zhongfu became remonstrance grand masters while keeping Hanlin posts.

sentences.zh: 水部員外郎顧少連為禮部郎中：並依前充翰林學士。

translations.literal: Waterways Bureau aide Gu Shaolian was made Rites Bureau director — still Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Shaolian became rites director while keeping Hanlin rank.

sentences.zh: 行在左右廂兵馬使令狐建、時常春並加散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Camp left and right wing marshals Linghu Jian and Shi Changchun were both made acting Palace Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Jian and Shi Changchun became acting palace attendants.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，斬偽相李忠臣，籍沒其家。

translations.literal: On bingchen the false chancellor Li Zhongchen was beheaded and his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Li Zhongchen was executed and his estate seized.

sentences.zh: 李晟奏受賊偽署同惡抵法之家，所沒財物、牛馬、奴婢，請以賞軍士。

translations.literal: Li Sheng memorialized that property, cattle, and slaves confiscated from households punished for accepting rebel appointments should reward the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng asked that rebel collaborators' seized goods pay the troops.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the request.

sentences.zh: 戊午，車駕還京，發興元，是日大雨，及入斜谷，晴霽，從官將士歡然以為天助。

translations.literal: On wuwu the imperial carriage returned to the capital, setting out from Xingyuan; that day great rain, and on entering Xiegu the sky cleared — attendants and soldiers rejoiced, taking it as Heaven's aid.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the court left Xingyuan for Chang'an in heavy rain; at Xiegu the skies cleared, and officials and troops took it as a sign from Heaven.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，車駕次鳳翔府，詔放管內今年秋稅；

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingzi: the imperial carriage halted at Fengxiang Prefecture; an edict remitted this year's autumn tax within the circuit;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingzi, the emperor paused at Fengxiang and remitted the circuit's autumn levy.

sentences.zh: 耆壽侍老八十已上，各與版授刺史，賜紫，其餘版授上佐，賜緋；

translations.literal: The aged and those attending the elderly eighty and above were each given placard appointment as prefect, granted purple; the rest placard appointment as senior aides, granted scarlet;
translations.idiomatic: Men eighty and older received placard appointments as prefects with purple robes; others received aide appointments in scarlet.

sentences.zh: 府、縣置頓官，考滿日放選。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties were to post transit officials; on term completion they were released for selection.
translations.idiomatic: Transit officers were posted in each prefecture and county and released for office after their terms.

sentences.zh: 受偽署官喬琳、蔣鎮、張光晟、李通、蔣金監伏誅。

translations.literal: Qiao Lin, Jiang Zhen, Zhang Guangcheng, Li Tong, and Jiang Jinjian — officials who had accepted rebel appointments — were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Lin, Jiang Zhen, Zhang Guangcheng, Li Tong, and Jiang Jinjian, who had served under the rebels, were put to death.

sentences.zh: 朱泚害郡王、王子、王孫七十七人於馬璘宅，丁丑，令所司具兇禮收殮於凈域寺。

translations.literal: Zhu Ci killed seventy-seven commandery princes, princes, and imperial grandsons at Ma Lin's residence; on dingchou the authorities were ordered to perform rites for the slain and inter them at Jingyu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci murdered seventy-seven kinsmen of the throne at Ma Lin's house; on dingchou their bodies were given funeral rites at Jingyu Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔：

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict was issued:
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict addressed Li Huai'ang and the Shuofang army — recalling his service at Fengtian, reproaching his later treason, yet offering pardon if he came to court within three days.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自興元。

translations.literal: On renwu he arrived from Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the emperor entered the capital from Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 時渾瑊、韓游瑰、戴休顏以其眾扈從，李晟、駱元光、尚可孤以其眾奉迎，步騎十餘萬，旌旗連亙數十里，都民僧道，歡呼感泣。

translations.literal: At the time Hun Jian, Han Yougui, and Dai Xiuyan escorted with their troops; Li Sheng, Luo Yuanguang, and Shang Keji welcomed with theirs — infantry and cavalry over a hundred thousand, banners and flags stretching for tens of li; capital residents, monks, and nuns shouted and wept with emotion.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Jian, Han Yougui, and Dai Xiuyan marched in escort; Li Sheng, Luo Yuanguang, and Shang Keji led the welcoming host — more than a hundred thousand horse and foot, banners filling miles of road while citizens and clergy wept and cheered.

sentences.zh: 李晟見於三橋，自陳收城遲晚之咎，伏地請罪，上慰勞遣之。

translations.literal: Li Sheng met him at Sanqiao, himself stating the fault of recovering the city late, prostrating himself to beg punishment; the emperor comforted and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: At Sanqiao Li Sheng prostrated himself, blaming the delay in retaking the city; the emperor consoled him and sent him on.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，河中宣慰使孔巢父、中官啖守盈並為懷光所害。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Hezhong pacification commissioner Kong Chaofu and the eunuch Dan Shouying were both killed by Huai'ang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Kong Chaofu, sent to pacify Hezhong, and the eunuch Dan Shouying were murdered by Li Huai'ang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，御丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinmao he ascended Danfeng Tower and proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he proclaimed universal amnesty from Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 賜李晟永崇里第，女樂八人。

translations.literal: Li Sheng was granted a mansion in Yongchong Ward and eight female musicians.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng received a house in Yongchong Ward and eight palace musicians.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命宰臣諸將送晟入新賜第。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor ordered chancellors and generals to escort Sheng into his newly granted residence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu chancellors and commanders escorted Sheng to his new mansion.

sentences.zh: 教坊樂，京兆府供帳食饌，鼓吹導從，京城以為榮觀。

translations.literal: Music from the Music Bureau, provisions and feasts supplied by the Capital Metropolitan Prefecture, drums and pipes leading the procession — the capital regarded it as a spectacle of glory.
translations.idiomatic: Court musicians, a feast from the metropolitan prefecture, and a brass procession made the capital turn out to watch.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，詔所司為贈太尉段秀實樹碑立廟。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinchou: an edict ordered the authorities to erect a stele and temple for the late Grandee of the Court Duan Xiushi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinchou, the court ordered a stele and shrine for the posthumously enfeoffed Duan Xiushi.

sentences.zh: 淄青節度使承前帶陸海運、押新羅渤海兩蕃等使，宜令李納兼之。

translations.literal: The Ziqing military commissioner had previously also held the posts of overseer of land-and-sea transport and commissioner for Silla and Bohai; Li Na was now to hold these concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Li Na was given the Ziqing command plus oversight of sea transport and the Silla–Bohai missions formerly borne by that post.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，加司徒、中書令、合川郡王李晟兼鳳翔尹，充鳳翔隴右節度等使、涇原四鎮北庭行營兵馬副元帥，改封西平郡王。

translations.literal: On guimao Grand Master of the Court, Grand Secretariat Director, Prince of Hechuan Li Sheng was additionally made Fengxiang prefect, commissioned as Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner and deputy commander-in-chief of the Jingyuan, Four Garrisons, and Beiting campaign forces, and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Sheng became Fengxiang prefect, deputy supreme commander on the northwest front, and Prince of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 河東保寧軍節度使、太原尹、北都留守、檢校司徒、平章事、北平郡王馬燧為奉誠軍晉絳慈隰節度行營兵馬副元帥；

translations.literal: Hedong Baoning Army military commissioner, Taiyuan prefect, northern capital protector, acting Grand Master of the Court, Grand Secretariat Associate, Prince of Beiping Ma Sui was made deputy commander-in-chief of the Fengcheng Army Jin-jiang-ci-li campaign;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui of Hedong was named deputy commander for the campaign against Li Huai'ang in Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Li.

sentences.zh: 以靈鹽節度使、侍中、兼靈州大都督、樓煩郡王渾瑊為河中尹、晉絳節度使、河中同陜虢等州及管內行營兵馬副元帥，改封咸寧郡王。

translations.literal: Lingzhou-Salt military commissioner, Palace Attendant, concurrent chief administrator of Lingzhou, Prince of Loufan Hun Jian was made Hezhong prefect, Jin-jiang military commissioner, and deputy commander-in-chief of Hezhong, Tong, Shan, and Guo and attached campaign forces, and enfeoffed Prince of Xianning commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Jian was shifted to Hezhong as commissioner and deputy commander on the Huai'ang front, taking the title Prince of Xianning.

sentences.zh: 時方命瑊與馬燧各出師討懷光故也。

translations.literal: At the time Jian and Ma Sui were each ordered to take the field against Huai'ang for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: Both men were sent out because the court was moving against Li Huai'ang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以金吾大將軍杜希全為靈州大都督、西受降城天德軍靈鹽相夏節度營田等使；

translations.literal: On jiachen the Golden Guards grand general Du Xiquan was made chief administrator of Lingzhou and commissioner of the Western Surrender City, Tiande Army, Ling-Salt, Xiang, and Xia circuits plus garrison-farming;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Du Xiquan took Lingzhou and the northwest garrisons from Xiang to Xia.

sentences.zh: 以同絳節度使唐朝臣為鄜坊丹延等州節度使；

translations.literal: Tong-jiang military commissioner Tang Chaochen was made Yan-Fang-Dan-Yan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Chaochen became commissioner of Yan, Fang, Dan, and Yan.

sentences.zh: 以保義軍節度使、鳳翔尹李楚琳為金吾大將軍；

translations.literal: Baoyi Army military commissioner and Fengxiang prefect Li Chulin was made grand general of the Golden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chulin of Baoyi was made a Golden Guards grand general.

sentences.zh: 以奉義軍節度使、隴州刺史韋皋為左金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Fengyi Army military commissioner and Longzhou prefect Wei Gao was made grand general of the Left Golden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Gao of Fengyi became grand general of the Left Golden Guards.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以奉天行營節度戴休顏為左龍武統軍。

translations.literal: On wushen Fengtian campaign commissioner Dai Xiuyan was made commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Dai Xiuyan was appointed commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以延王玢、隨王迅、西平長公主薨，廢朝。

translations.literal: On jiyou Prince of Yan Li Bin, Prince of Sui Li Xun, and the Princess of Xiping died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou three royals died and mourning closed the court.

sentences.zh: 己未，前湖州刺史袁高為給事中。

translations.literal: On jiwei former Huzhou prefect Yuan Gao was made supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yuan Gao, former prefect of Huzhou, became a supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，宗正卿李琬卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengwu: Director of the Imperial Clan Li Wan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, Director of the Imperial Clan Li Wan died.

sentences.zh: 賜渾瑊大寧里第，並女樂五人，詔宰臣諸將賜樂饋贈如送李晟入第故事。

translations.literal: Hun Jian was granted a mansion in Daning Ward and five female musicians; an edict ordered chancellors and generals to present music and gifts as in the precedent for escorting Li Sheng to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Jian received a Daning Ward mansion and five musicians, with the same ceremonial send-off given Li Sheng.

sentences.zh: 壬午，贈故右僕射致仕李涵太子太保。

translations.literal: On renwu the late retired Right Vice Director Li Han was posthumously made Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the retired Li Han was posthumously made grand mentor to the heir.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王武俊加檢校司徒，李抱真檢校司空，並賜實封五百戶，賞破朱滔之功也。

translations.literal: On yihai Wang Wujun was advanced to acting Grand Master of the Court and Li Baozhen to acting Minister of Works, each granted five hundred households of substantive fief — rewarding the defeat of Zhu Tao.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Wujun and Li Baozhen were promoted and given enlarged fiefs for crushing Zhu Tao.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以前嶺南節度使元琇為戶部侍郎、判度支。

translations.literal: On jiashen former Lingnan military commissioner Yuan Xiu was made Vice Minister of Revenue and charged with fiscal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Yuan Xiu became vice minister of revenue in charge of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上顧謂宰臣曰：「今大盜雖除，時猶多難，宜廣延納，以達下情。

translations.literal: On dinghai the emperor, turning to the chancellors, said: "Though the great rebels are gone, the times remain hard; we should widely extend reception to reach the feelings below.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor told his chancellors: "The great rebels are gone, yet troubles remain — we must hear more from below.

sentences.zh: 近日諫官都無論奏，自今每正衙及延英坐日常令朝臣三兩人奏時政得失，庶有弘益也。

translations.literal: Recently remonstrating officials have offered no memorials; from now on, at every regular audience and at sessions in the Yanying Hall, let two or three court officials regularly report gains and faults in current policy, that there may be broad benefit."
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrators have fallen silent. Hereafter, at regular audiences and in the Yanying Hall, two or three officials should speak on policy each day."

sentences.zh: 」是秋，螟蝗蔽野，草木無遺。

translations.literal: " That autumn locusts and grasshoppers covered the wilds; grass and trees were left with nothing.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn locusts blackened the fields until not a blade of grass remained.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，馬燧收絳州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yichou: Ma Sui recovered Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on yichou, Ma Sui retook Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，令中官竇文場、王希遷監左右神策軍都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: On wuchen the eunuchs Dou Wenchang and Wang Xiqian were ordered to supervise the Left and Right Divine Strategy Armies as directors knowing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen eunuchs Dou Wenchang and Wang Xiqian were placed over the Divine Strategy Armies.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，詔：「朕臨御萬方，失於君道，兵革不息，於今五年。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, gengwu, an edict stated: "We rule the myriad regions yet have failed in the way of a ruler; arms have not ceased for five years now.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary gengwu an edict opened: "Five years of war show I have failed as ruler.

sentences.zh: 閔眾庶之勞，悔征伐之事。

translations.literal: We pity the people's toil and regret campaigns of punishment.
translations.idiomatic: I pity the people's labor and regret these wars.

sentences.zh: 而李希烈蔑義棄德，反道虐人。

translations.literal: Yet Li Xilie scorned righteousness, cast off virtue, turned against the Way, and tyrannized men.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Li Xilie has scorned duty and ravaged the people.

sentences.zh: 朕哀彼生靈，陷於塗炭。

translations.literal: We mourn those living beings trapped in fire and charcoal.
translations.idiomatic: I mourn those trapped in his devastation.

sentences.zh: 敬存拯物，不憚屈身，故於歲首特布新令，赦其殊死，待以至誠。

translations.literal: Reverently wishing to save all things, We do not shrink from humbling Ourselves — therefore at the year's start We specially issued a new order, pardoning crimes warranting death, treating him with utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: To save them I humbled myself — at New Year I pardoned capital crimes and dealt with him in good faith.

sentences.zh: 使臣才及於郊圻，巨猾已聞其僭竊。

translations.literal: Our envoy had barely reached the suburbs when the great villain already heard of his usurpation.
translations.idiomatic: My envoy had scarcely left the suburbs when Xilie declared himself ruler.

sentences.zh: 酷烈滋甚，吞噬無厭。

translations.literal: His cruelty grew worse; his swallowing knew no satiety.
translations.idiomatic: His cruelty deepened and his appetite for conquest grew.

sentences.zh: 將相大臣，咸懷憤激，繼陳章疏，固請討除。

translations.literal: Generals and ministers alike burned with indignation, submitting memorial after memorial firmly begging to attack and remove him.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and generals begged in memorial after memorial to destroy him.

sentences.zh: 朕以所行天誅，本去人害，兵戈既接，玉石難分。

translations.literal: We take Heaven's punishment as removing harm to the people; once arms are joined, jade and stone are hard to distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's punishment should spare the people, yet once armies clash the innocent suffer with the guilty.

sentences.zh: 言念勛臣，橫遭脅制，雖思改革，厥路無由。

translations.literal: Thinking of meritorious ministers forcibly constrained, though We wished reform, there was no way;
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious men were dragooned into his ranks; though I wished to spare them, I could not tell friend from foe.

sentences.zh: 受污終身，銜冤沒代，淪胥以逞，誠可痛傷。

translations.literal: stained for life, bearing grievance into the grave, ruined and left to run wild — truly it can pain one.
translations.idiomatic: Many were ruined for life — a grief that cuts to the bone.

sentences.zh: 豈孽自一夫，而毒流萬姓，為人父母，寧不愧懷！

translations.literal: How can guilt rest on one man yet poison flow to ten thousand households — as father and mother to the people, how could We not feel shame in Our breast!
translations.idiomatic: Shall one man's crime poison the realm? As father of the people, I am ashamed.

sentences.zh: 宜令諸道節度使明行曉諭，罪止元兇，脅制之徒，一切不問。

translations.literal: Let every circuit military commissioner clearly proclaim and instruct: guilt stops at the chief culprit; all who were coerced are entirely not to be questioned."
translations.idiomatic: Let every commissioner proclaim: only the ringleader is guilty; all who were forced into service are forgiven."

sentences.zh: 」唐朝臣奏收永樂縣。

translations.literal: Tang Chaochen memorialized the recovery of Yongle County.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Chaochen reported the recapture of Yongle County.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以右龍武大將軍李觀為涇州刺史、涇原節度使。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Right Dragon Martial grand general Li Guan was made Jingzhou prefect and Jingyuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Guan became Jingzhou prefect and Jingyuan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔宋亳、淄青、澤潞、河東、恆冀、幽、易定、魏博等八節度，螟蝗為害，蒸民饑饉，每節度賜米五萬石，河陽、東畿各賜三萬石，所司般運，於楚州分付。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict stated: Song, Bo, Ziqing, Zelu, Hedong, Hengji, You, Yiding, and Weibo — eight circuits where locusts harmed and the people hungered — each circuit was granted fifty thousand shi of grain; Heyang and the eastern capital region each thirty thousand shi; the authorities were to transport and distribute at Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai eight famine-struck circuits received fifty thousand shi of grain each; Heyang and the eastern capital region thirty thousand each, shipped via Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李晟至涇州，誅節度使田希鑒，罪其殺馮河清也。

translations.literal: On dingchou Li Sheng reached Jing Prefecture and executed military commissioner Tian Xijian, punishing him for killing Feng Heqing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Sheng executed Tian Xijian at Jingzhou for murdering Feng Heqing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，希烈將李澄以滑州歸國。

translations.literal: On wuzi Xilie's general Li Cheng returned Huazhou to the state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Cheng surrendered Huazhou to the court.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以李澄為汴州刺史、汴滑節度使，封武威郡王。

translations.literal: On jiawu Li Cheng was made Bianzhou prefect and Bian-Hua military commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Wuwei commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Cheng became Bianzhou commissioner and Prince of Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 神策行營節度使、檢校尚書右僕射、馮翊郡王尚可孤卒。

translations.literal: Divine Strategy campaign military commissioner, acting Minister of the Right Li Shang Keji died.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Keji, Fengyi prince and Divine Strategy commander, died.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，宋亳節度使劉洽與曲環破希烈之眾於陳州，俘斬三萬級，生擒賊將翟崇暉以獻。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guimao: Song-Bo military commissioner Liu Qia with Qu Huan defeated Xilie's forces at Chenzhou — thirty thousand captives beheaded or taken; the rebel general Zhai Chonghui was captured alive and presented.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liu Qia and Qu Huan destroyed thirty thousand of Xilie's men at Chenzhou and sent up Zhai Chonghui alive.

sentences.zh: 戊午，劉洽大破希烈之眾，擒其偽相鄭賁等五人以獻。

translations.literal: On wuwu Liu Qia greatly defeated Xilie's forces and captured five of his false chancellors including Zheng Ben and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Liu Qia routed Xilie again and sent up five captured false ministers including Zheng Ben.

sentences.zh: 希烈遁歸蔡州，汴州平。

translations.literal: Xilie fled back to Caizhou; Bianzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Xilie fled to Caizhou and Bianzhou was secured.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宰相蕭復三上章乞罷免，許之。

translations.literal: On yichou Chancellor Xiao Fu thrice submitted memorials begging to be removed; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Xiao Fu resigned after three petitions and was allowed to step down.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，淮南節度使、檢校司空、平章事陳少游卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yihai: Huainan military commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Grand Secretariat Associate Chen Shaoyou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Chen Shaoyou, Huainan commissioner and chancellor, died.

sentences.zh: 贈蕭定太子太師。

translations.literal: Xiao Ding was posthumously made Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Ding was posthumously made grand preceptor to the heir.

sentences.zh: 以壽州刺史張建封為濠壽都團練使。

translations.literal: Shouzhou prefect Zhang Jianfeng was made Hao-Shou regimental defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jianfeng of Shouzhou became commissioner of Hao and Shou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以刑部侍郎杜亞為揚州長史、淮南節度使，戊子，以吏部郎中崔造為給事中。

translations.literal: On gengchen Vice Minister of Punishments Du Ya was made Yangzhou chief administrator and Huainan military commissioner; on wuzi Director of Personnel Cui Zao was made supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Du Ya became Huainan commissioner; on wuzi Cui Zao became a supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以諫議大夫陸贄為中書舍人，依前翰林學士。

translations.literal: On xinmao Remonstrance Bureau Grandee Lu Zhi was made Secretariat Drafter, continuing as Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Lu Zhi became a drafter while remaining Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 詔翰林學士朝服班序，宜同諸司官知制誥例。

translations.literal: An edict stated: Hanlin academicians' court dress and ranking in procession should follow the precedent for officials of various offices who draft edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin scholars were ordered to rank in court processions like other drafters of edicts.

sentences.zh: 貞元元年貞元元年正月丁酉朔，御含元殿受朝賀，禮畢，宣制大赦天下，改元貞元。

translations.literal: Zhenyuan 1, first month, dingyou new moon: he received congratulatory audience at Hanyuan Hall; when the rites were complete, he proclaimed amnesty for all under Heaven and changed the era name to Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the Zhenyuan new year he held audience at Hanyuan, proclaimed universal amnesty, and took the era name Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大風雪，寒。

translations.literal: On wuxu great wind and snow; cold.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu a blizzard struck and the cold was fierce.

sentences.zh: 去秋螟蝗，冬旱，至是雪，寒甚，民饑凍死者踣於路。

translations.literal: The previous autumn's locusts and winter drought — now snow fell, bitterly cold; people starved and froze to death, collapsing on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: After locusts and drought, the snow brought killing cold; corpses littered the highways.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以饒州刺史盧為福州刺史、福建允察使。

translations.literal: On dingwei Raozhou prefect Lu was made Fuzhou prefect and Fujian surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Raozhou prefect Lu was sent to Fujian as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，始聞太子太師、魯郡公顏真卿為希烈所害，追贈司徒，廢朝五日，謚曰文忠，乃特授男頵、碩等官。

translations.literal: On guichou word first came that Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent, Duke of Lu Yan Zhenqing had been killed by Xilie; he was posthumously made Grand Master of the Court, court suspended five days, posthumous title Wenzong, and his sons Yun, Shuo, and others were specially granted office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou news arrived that Yan Zhenqing had been murdered by Xilie; the court mourned five days, ennobled him posthumously as Wenzong, and advanced his sons.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以吉州長史盧杞為澧州別駕，尋卒。

translations.literal: On renxu Jizhou chief administrator Lu Qi was made Bianmao of Lizhou; soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Lu Qi was demoted to Lizhou and died soon after.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔，遣工部尚書賈耽、侍郎劉太真分往東都、兩河宣慰。

translations.literal: Second month, bingyin new moon: Minister of Works Jia Dan and Vice Minister Liu Taizhen were separately sent to comfort the eastern capital and the two He regions.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month's new moon Jia Dan and Liu Taizhen were sent to reassure Luoyang and the Hebei circuits.

sentences.zh: 河南、河北饑，米斗千錢。

translations.literal: Henan and Hebei hungered; rice reached a thousand cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Henan and Hebei drove grain to a thousand cash the dou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李抱真、嚴震來朝。

translations.literal: On guawei Li Baozhen and Yan Zhen came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On guawei Li Baozhen and Yan Zhen arrived for audience.

sentences.zh: 寒食節，上與諸將擊鞠於內殿。

translations.literal: On the Cold Food Festival the emperor played cuju in the inner hall with the generals.
translations.idiomatic: At Cold Food the emperor kicked the ball with his generals in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以檢校秘書監金良相為檢校太尉、使持節、大都督、雞林州刺史、寧海軍使，襲封新羅王。

translations.literal: On bingxu acting Director of the Palace Library Kim Yang-sang was made acting Grand Master of the Court, commissioner with credentials, chief administrator, Silla prefect, and commissioner of the Ninghai Army, succeeding to the kingship of Silla.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Kim Yang-sang of Silla was confirmed as king with full Tang honors.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大雨。

translations.literal: On xinmao great rain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao heavy rains fell.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申朔，以蜀州刺史韓洄為兵部侍郎，以汴東水陸運等使、左庶子包佶為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, bingchen new moon: Shuzhou prefect Han Hui was made Vice Minister of War; Bian-dong water-and-land transport commissioner and Left Subordinate Heir Apparent Bao Ji was made Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's new moon Han Hui became vice minister of war and Bao Ji vice minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，戶部侍郎、判度支元琇兼諸道水陸運使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Vice Minister of Revenue Yuan Xiu charged with fiscal affairs was additionally made commissioner of all circuits' water-and-land transport.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yuan Xiu also took charge of transport on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁未，李希烈陷南陽，殺守將黃金嶽。

translations.literal: On dingwei Li Xilie took Nanyang and killed defending general Huang Jinyue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xilie seized Nanyang and killed its defender Huang Jinyue.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔宰臣宣諭御史，今後上封彈奏，人自陳論，不得群署章疏。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict ordered the chancellors to instruct the censorate: hereafter sealed memorials and impeachments — each man is to state his own case; group-signed memorials are not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the chancellors were told to forbid group-signed impeachments; each memorial must speak for one man only.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宣武帥劉洽檢校司空；

translations.literal: On wuwu Xuanwu commander Liu Qia was advanced to acting Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Liu Qia of Xuanwu was promoted to acting minister of works;

sentences.zh: 以汴滑節度使李澄普滑州刺史，充鄭滑節度使。

translations.literal: Bian-Hua military commissioner Li Cheng was made universal Huazhou prefect and commissioned as Zheng-Hua military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cheng became Zheng-Hua commissioner with authority over Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 加李納司空。

translations.literal: Li Na was advanced to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Li Na was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑朔，普王誼改封舒王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yichou new moon: Prince of Pu Li Yi was re-enfeoffed Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Prince of Pu became Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，鄂岳觀察使李謙為洪州刺史、西都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On guiyou E-Yue observation commissioner Li Qian was made Hongzhou prefect and western capital regimental training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Qian was shifted from E-Yue to Hongzhou and the western capital command.

sentences.zh: 江陵度支院失火，燒租賦錢穀百餘萬。

translations.literal: The Jiangling fiscal depot caught fire, burning more than a million in rent and tax money and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Fire at the Jiangling revenue office destroyed over a million in taxes and grain.

sentences.zh: 時關東大饑，賦調不入，由是國用益窘。

translations.literal: At the time the eastern capital region suffered great famine; tax levies did not come in — for this reason state expenditures grew tighter.
translations.idiomatic: Famine east of the mountains kept taxes from arriving and the treasury grew desperate.

sentences.zh: 關中饑民蒸蝗蟲而食之。

translations.literal: In Guanzhong the starving steamed locusts and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: Around Chang'an the hungry steamed locusts for food.

sentences.zh: 汴帥劉洽賜名玄佐。

translations.literal: Bian commander Liu Qia was granted the name Xuanzuo.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qia of Bian was given the name Xuanzuo.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，分命朝臣禱群神以祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guimao: court officials were separately ordered to pray to the gods for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month officials were sent to pray at shrines for rain.

sentences.zh: 蝗自海而至，飛蔽天，每下則草木及畜毛無復孑遺。

translations.literal: Locusts came from the sea, flying until they hid the sky; wherever they descended grass, trees, and animal hair left not a single survivor.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts flew in from the sea, darkening the sky and stripping fields and livestock bare.

sentences.zh: 穀價騰踴。

translations.literal: Grain prices soared.
translations.idiomatic: Grain prices shot upward.
