sentences.zh: 辛酉，以河陽都知兵馬使雍希顏為河陽懷都團練使。

translations.literal: On xinyou Heyang director knowing military affairs Yong Xiyan was made Heyang-Huai regimental defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Yong Xiyan became commissioner of Heyang and Huai.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，以兵部侍郎韓洄為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingzi: Vice Minister of War Han Hui was made Capital Metropolitan Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Han Hui became metropolitan prefect of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，劉玄佐兼汴州史。

translations.literal: On xinsi Liu Xuanzuo was additionally made Bianzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Liu Xuanzuo was also given Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以工部尚書賈耽兼御史大夫、東都留守、都畿汝州防御刺使，以汴州刺史薛玨為河南尹。

translations.literal: On renwu Minister of Works Jia Dan was additionally made Censor-in-Chief, eastern capital protector, and metropolitan prefect of the capital region and Ruzhou defense commissioner; Bianzhou prefect Xue Jue was made Henan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Jia Dan became censor-in-chief and Luoyang protector; Xue Jue became Henan prefect.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以左金吾衛大將軍韋皋檢校戶部尚書，兼成都尹、御史大夫、劍南西川節度觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Left Golden Guards grand general Wei Gao was made acting Minister of Revenue, concurrent Chengdu prefect, censor-in-chief, and Jiannan West Circuit military observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Wei Gao was sent to Chengdu as commissioner of Jiannan West with revenue duties.

sentences.zh: 以國子祭酒董晉為左金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Director of the National University Dong Jin was made grand general of the Left Golden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Jin, director of the National University, became a Left Golden Guards grand general.

sentences.zh: 幽州朱滔卒，贈司徒。

translations.literal: Zhu Tao of Youzhou died; he was posthumously made Grand Master of the Court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tao of Youzhou died and was posthumously ennobled as grand master of the court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，河東節度使馬燧自河中行營來朝。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiawu new moon: Hedong military commissioner Ma Sui came to court from the Hezhong campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month's new moon Ma Sui left the Hezhong front for audience.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大風拔樹。

translations.literal: On gengzi great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以左散騎常侍李泌為陜州長史、陜虢都防禦觀察陸運使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Left Regular Attendant Li Bi was made Shanzhou chief administrator and Shan-Guo metropolitan defense, observation, and land transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Bi became Shanzhou commissioner overseeing Shan and Guo transport.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以鎮海軍、浙江東西道節度使韓滉檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事、江淮轉運使，以河南尹薛玨為河南水陸運使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Zhenhai Army and Zhejiang East and West military commissioner Han Huang was made acting Minister of the Left, Grand Secretariat Associate, and Jiang-Huai transport commissioner; Henan prefect Xue Jue was made Henan water-and-land transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Han Huang entered the chancellery and took Jiang-Huai transport; Xue Jue oversaw Henan shipping.

sentences.zh: 戊申，馬燧還行營。

translations.literal: On wushen Ma Sui returned to the campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Ma Sui marched back to the front.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，加檢校工部尚書王士真為德棣都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinhai acting Minister of Works Wang Shizhen was advanced to De-Di regimental training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wang Shizhen became commissioner of De and Di.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以前涿州刺史、兼御史中丞劉怦為幽州長史、御史大夫、幽州盧龍節度副大使，兼知節度管理度支營田觀察、押奚契丹經略盧龍等軍使。

translations.literal: On renzi former Zhuo prefect and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief Liu Zheng was made Youzhou chief administrator, censor-in-chief, Youzhou-Lulong deputy military commissioner, concurrently managing circuit administration, revenue, garrison-farming, observation, commissioner for Xi and Khitan, and Lulong frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liu Zheng was installed at Youzhou as Lulong deputy with full civil and frontier powers.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以左散騎常侍柳渾為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dingsi Left Regular Attendant Liu Hun was made Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Liu Hun became vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以諫議大夫高參為中書舍人。

translations.literal: On gengshen Remonstrance Bureau Grandee Gao Can was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gao Can became a secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 關中蝗食草木都盡，旱甚，灞水將竭，井多無水。

translations.literal: In Guanzhong locusts ate grass and trees to the last; drought was extreme; the Ba River nearly dried; most wells had no water.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts stripped Guanzhong bare; the Ba River shrank to a trickle and wells ran dry.

sentences.zh: 有司計度支錢穀，才可支七旬。

translations.literal: The relevant offices calculated revenue funds and grain — enough to last only seventy days.
translations.idiomatic: Treasury clerks reckoned stores would last seventy days.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔：「夫人事失於下，則天變形於上，咎徵之作，必有由然。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict stated: "When human affairs fail below, Heaven's signs take form above; the arising of omens of blame must have their cause.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict declared: "When rule fails below, Heaven warns above.

sentences.zh: 自頃已來，災沴仍集，雨澤不降，綿歷三時，蟲蝗繼臻，彌亙千里。

translations.literal: From recent times disasters have repeatedly gathered; rain has not fallen through three seasons; locusts have followed, filling a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Disasters have piled up: three seasons without rain and locusts across a thousand li.

sentences.zh: 菽粟翔貴，稼穡枯瘁，嗷嗷蒸人，聚泣田畝，與言及此，實切痛傷。

translations.literal: Grain and millet soar in price; crops wither; the people cry out in the fields — to speak of this truly cuts to pain.
translations.idiomatic: Grain prices soared, fields withered, and farmers wept in the furrows.

sentences.zh: 遍祈百神，曾不獲應，方悟禱祠非救災之術，言詞非謝譴之誠。

translations.literal: Praying to the hundred spirits everywhere, yet no response was obtained — only then did We realize prayer is not the art of relieving disaster, and words are not the sincerity of apologizing for reproof.
translations.idiomatic: Prayers to every god went unanswered — I saw that ritual alone would not end the famine.

sentences.zh: 憂心如焚，深自刻責。

translations.literal: Our heart anxious as if burning, We deeply reproach Ourselves.
translations.idiomatic: My heart burns with shame.

sentences.zh: 得非刑法舛繆。

translations.literal: Could it be that punishments are perverse?
translations.idiomatic: Have punishments been unjust?

sentences.zh: 忠良鬱湮，暴賦未蠲，勞師靡息。

translations.literal: The loyal and good are stifled; harsh levies are not remitted; weary armies know no rest.
translations.idiomatic: Have the loyal been blocked, taxes left heavy, and armies kept on campaign without cease?

sentences.zh: 事或無益，而重為煩費；

translations.literal: Matters may be without benefit yet repeatedly made vexatious expense;
translations.idiomatic: Have useless offices drained the treasury?

sentences.zh: 任或非當，而橫肆侵蟊。

translations.literal: appointments may be unfitting yet they wantonly spread harm like locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Have unfit men preyed on the people like locusts?

sentences.zh: 有一於茲，足傷和氣。

translations.literal: If there is one of these, it is enough to wound harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: Any one of these would break Heaven's harmony.

sentences.zh: 本其所以，罪實在予，萬姓何辜，重罹饑殍。

translations.literal: Tracing its source, the guilt truly lies in Us; what crime have the myriad people, that they again suffer famine and death?
translations.idiomatic: The fault is mine; the people are innocent yet starve.

sentences.zh: 所宜出次貶食，節用緩刑，側身增修，以謹天戒。

translations.literal: What is fitting is to leave the palace for humbled meals, economize expenditures and ease punishments, turn the body to increase cultivation, and with care heed Heaven's warning.
translations.idiomatic: I must eat sparingly, spend less, judge more gently, and mend my rule.

sentences.zh: 朕自今視朝不御正殿，有司供膳並宜減省，不急之務，一切停罷。

translations.literal: We from now on hold court but do not use the main hall; the authorities' provisions for Our meals should all be reduced; unurgent affairs are entirely to be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: I will hold audience outside the main hall, cut the palace kitchen, and halt all nonessential business.

sentences.zh: 除諸軍將士外，應食糧人諸色用度，本司本使長官商量減罷，以救兇荒。

translations.literal: Apart from army soldiers, for all persons receiving grain rations and every category of expense, the heads of the relevant office and commissioner are to consult and reduce or stop them to relieve famine.
translations.idiomatic: Every office that feeds retainers must slash rations except for troops in the field.

sentences.zh: 俟歲豐登，即令復舊。

translations.literal: When the year is abundantly harvested, then order restoration to the old.
translations.idiomatic: When harvest returns, old allowances may be restored.

sentences.zh: 」甲子，李懷光大將尉圭以焦籬堡降。

translations.literal: 」 On jiazi Li Huai'ang's great general Wei Gui surrendered Jiaoli Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict. On jiazi Wei Gui surrendered Jiaoli Fort to the court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，懷光將徐庭光以長春宮兵六千人降。

translations.literal: On dingmao Huai'ang's general Xu Tingguang surrendered with six thousand men of Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Xu Tingguang brought six thousand men out of Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，朔方大將牛名俊斬李懷光，傅首闕下。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Shuofang great general Niu Mingjun beheaded Li Huai'ang and sent the head to the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Niu Mingjun killed Li Huai'ang and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 馬燧收復河中。

translations.literal: Ma Sui recovered Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui retook Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，始雨。

translations.literal: On dingchou rain began at last.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou rain finally fell.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔：「朕誠信未著，撫御失宜，致使功臣陷於誅戮，謂之克敵，能不愧心！

translations.literal: On jimao an edict stated: "Our sincerity has not been displayed; Our comforting rule has been improper, causing meritorious ministers to fall into execution — to call this conquering the enemy, how could We not feel shame in Our heart!
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict said: "My failures of trust brought loyal men to ruin — how can I claim victory without shame?

sentences.zh: 然以懷光一家，在法無舍；

translations.literal: Yet as to Huai'ang's whole household, in law there is no sparing;
translations.idiomatic: By law Huai'ang's house deserved extinction;

sentences.zh: 念其昔居將相，嘗寄腹心。

translations.literal: remembering that he once stood among generals and chancellors and was once entrusted with Our inmost heart.
translations.idiomatic: yet he had once been my chief minister and confidant.

sentences.zh: 罪雖掛於刑書，功已藏於王府。

translations.literal: Though guilt is entered in the penal code, merit is already stored in the imperial repository.
translations.idiomatic: His crimes were recorded, but so were his deeds.

sentences.zh: 以干紀之跡，固合滅身；

translations.literal: For traces of violating discipline, it is fitting indeed to extinguish the person;
translations.idiomatic: Treason warranted death;

sentences.zh: 以赴難之勛，所宜有後。

translations.literal: for merit in rushing to difficulty, there ought to be descendants.
translations.idiomatic: his service at Fengtian deserved an heir.

sentences.zh: 宜以懷光男一人為嗣，賜莊宅各一區。

translations.literal: Let one of Huai'ang's sons be made heir; grant each one estate and mansion.
translations.idiomatic: One son shall inherit; each shall receive a house and estate.

sentences.zh: 仍還懷光尸首，任其收葬。

translations.literal: Still return Huai'ang's corpse and let them bury it as they will.
translations.idiomatic: His body shall be returned for burial.

sentences.zh: 懷光妻、諸兒女遞送澧州，委李皋逐便安置，使得存立。

translations.literal: Huai'ang's wife and all sons and daughters are to be sent in turn to Lizhou and entrusted to Li Gao to settle as convenient, that they may survive.
translations.idiomatic: Wife and children go to Lizhou under Li Gao's care so they may live.

sentences.zh: 其出嫁女、諸親並釋放。

translations.literal: Married daughters and all relatives are to be released.
translations.idiomatic: Married daughters and kin are freed.

sentences.zh: 陷賊將士，一切並與洗雪。

translations.literal: Soldiers who fell into rebel hands are all to be cleared together.
translations.idiomatic: Every soldier forced into rebellion is pardoned.

sentences.zh: 河中、絳百姓，給復一年。

translations.literal: The people of Hezhong and Jiang are granted tax relief for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong and Jiang receive a year's tax remission.

sentences.zh: 北平王馬燧、咸寧王渾瑊並與一子五品正員官。

translations.literal: Prince of Beiping Ma Sui and Prince of Xianning Hun Jian are each granted one son a regular fifth-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui and Hun Jian each receive a fifth-rank post for a son.

sentences.zh: 燧可侍中，瑊可檢校司空。

translations.literal: Sui may be Palace Attendant; Jian may be acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Sui becomes palace attendant; Jian acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 駱元光、韓游瑰、唐朝臣各賜實封二百戶，與一子六品正員官。

translations.literal: Luo Yuanguang, Han Yougui, and Tang Chaochen are each granted two hundred households of substantive fief and one son a regular sixth-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Yuanguang, Han Yougui, and Tang Chaochen gain fiefs and sixth-rank posts for their sons.

sentences.zh: 昨河中行營將士，共賜二十萬端匹以充宴賞，放歸本道。

translations.literal: The Hezhong campaign soldiers of yesterday are together granted two hundred thousand bolts of silk for feast rewards and released to their home circuits."
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday's Hezhong army receives two hundred thousand bolts of silk and marches home."

sentences.zh: 」新除中書侍郎、平章事張延賞為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Secretariat Vice Director and Grand Secretariat Associate Zhang Yanshang was made Minister of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanshang, newly made chancellor, was shifted to minister of the left.

sentences.zh: 時宰相劉從一病，詔徵延賞。

translations.literal: At the time Chancellor Liu Congyi was ill; an edict summoned Yanshang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Congyi lay ill and Yanshang was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 李晟與延賞有隙，自鳳翔上表論之。

translations.literal: Li Sheng had a rift with Yanshang and from Fengxiang submitted a memorial arguing the point.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng, feuding with Yanshang, memorialized from Fengxiang against him.

sentences.zh: 延賞罷鎮西川還，行至興元，改授左僕射。

translations.literal: Yanshang left his western Sichuan command and returned; reaching Xingyuan he was reassigned Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshang was demoted to left vice director while still en route from Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，前河陽節度使、檢校尚書左僕射、開陽郡王李芃卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi former Heyang military commissioner, acting Minister of the Left, Prince of Kaiyang Li Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Qi, former Heyang commissioner and Prince of Kaiyang, died.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，幽州節度劉怦病，請以子濟權知軍州事，從之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jihai: Youzhou commissioner Liu Zheng fell ill and asked that his son Ji be allowed to act as temporary administrator of the army and prefecture; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Liu Zheng, dying at Youzhou, had his son Ji made acting commander.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以牛名俊為丹州刺史。

translations.literal: On guimao Niu Mingjun was made Danzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Niu Mingjun became prefect of Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫崔縱奏：「準制勘會內外官員，商量並省停減，詳議聞奏者。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Cui Zong memorialized: "Per regulation, collate inner and outer officials, consult on consolidation and reduction, and report in detail for imperial hearing."
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zong reported on the edict to cut redundant offices throughout the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 伏以兵戎未息，仕進頗多，在官者既合序遷，有功者又頒褒賞。

translations.literal: We submit that with arms not yet stilled, advancement in office is quite numerous; those in office should in principle advance in order, and those with merit also receive rewards.
translations.idiomatic: War still rages and promotions abound; men in post expect advancement and the meritorious expect reward.

sentences.zh: 比來每至選集，不免據闕留人，嘗嘆遺才，仍招怨望。

translations.literal: In recent times at every selection gathering it has been impossible to avoid holding vacancies and retaining men; We have sighed over lost talent yet still provoked resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Each selection season we hold posts open and still hear complaint.

sentences.zh: 況有恩詔，甄錄功勞，諸道敘優，人數甚廣，見須處置，不可稽留。

translations.literal: Moreover there is a gracious edict recording merit; circuits report preferment — the numbers are very broad; disposition is needed now and cannot be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: A new edict honors campaign merit across every circuit — thousands await appointment now.

sentences.zh: 今若停減吏員，實恐未便於事，非但承優者無官可授，抑又敘進者無路可容，本冀便人，翻成斂怨。

translations.literal: If offices are now stopped and reduced, We truly fear it is not convenient to affairs — not only will those receiving preferment have no office to grant, but also those advancing in order will have no path to fit; what was meant to ease people instead gathers resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Cutting posts now would leave heroes without seats and anger the army — the cure would breed resentment.

sentences.zh: 事仍舊貫，以適時宜，更待事平，然後經度。

translations.literal: Matters should follow the old practice to suit the time; wait until affairs are pacified, then plan regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Keep the old establishment until peace returns, then reform."

sentences.zh: 」制從之。

translations.literal: The decree followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上御正殿，策賢良方正、能直言極諫等三科舉人。

translations.literal: On yisi the emperor held court in the main hall and examined candidates of the three categories: Worthy and Good in Square Uprightness, and those able to remonstrate with extreme directness.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he examined civil-service candidates in three categories of frank counsel in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宰相劉從一以疾辭任，授戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On xinhai Chancellor Liu Congyi, citing illness, resigned his post and was given the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Liu Congyi resigned the chancellery for the revenue ministry.

sentences.zh: 庚申劉從一卒。

translations.literal: On gengshen Liu Congyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the former chancellor Liu Congyi died.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使劉怦卒。

translations.literal: Youzhou military commissioner Liu Zheng died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng of Youzhou died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以權知幽州盧龍軍府事劉濟為幽州長史、兼御史大夫、幽州盧龍節度觀察、押奚契丹兩蕃等使。

translations.literal: On xinsi Liu Ji, acting administrator of the Youzhou-Lulong military government, was made Youzhou chief administrator, concurrent censor-in-chief, Youzhou-Lulong military observation commissioner, and commissioner for Xi, Khitan, and the two frontier peoples.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Liu Ji succeeded his father as Lulong commissioner with full titles.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，渾瑊自河中來朝。

translations.literal: On bingxu Hun Jian came to court from Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Hun Jian arrived from Hezhong for audience.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳朔，山南嚴震來朝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guisi new moon: Shannan Yan Zhen came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's new moon Yan Zhen of Shannan came to court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上親祀昊天上帝於圓丘。

translations.literal: On guimao the emperor personally sacrificed to the Lord on High at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the emperor offered to Heaven at the Round Altar.

sentences.zh: 時河中渾瑊、澤潞李抱真、山南嚴震、同華駱元光、邠寧韓游瑰、鄜坊唐朝臣、奉誠康日知等大將侍祠。

translations.literal: At the time Hun Jian of Hezhong, Li Baozhen of Zelu, Yan Zhen of Shannan, Luo Yuanguang of Tong-Hua, Han Yougui of Binning, Tang Chaochen of Yan-Fang, and Kang Rizhi of Fengcheng — great generals — attended the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Jian, Li Baozhen, Yan Zhen, Luo Yuanguang, Han Yougui, Tang Chaochen, and Kang Rizhi stood the southern rite.

sentences.zh: 郊壇畢，還宮，御丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: When the suburban altar was complete, returning to the palace, he ascended Danfeng Tower and proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: After the rites he proclaimed universal amnesty from Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔文武常參官共賜錢七百萬貫，以歲兇穀貴，衣冠窘乏故也。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict granted civil and military regular-attendance officials seven million strings of cash in all — because the year was famine-stricken, grain dear, and the official class was in want.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou regular officials received seven million strings of cash to ease famine prices.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，詔延英視事日，令常參官七人引對，陳時政得失。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuchen: on days when he conducted affairs at Yanying, seven regular-attendance officials were ordered to be introduced to state gains and faults in current policy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he ordered seven officials daily at Yanying audiences to speak on policy.

sentences.zh: 自是群官互進，有不達理道者，因多詆訐，不適事宜，上亦優容遣之。

translations.literal: From then on officials advanced in turn; when some did not grasp reason, there was much slander and impeachment, not fitting the occasion — the emperor also treated them indulgently and sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: Officials then crowded in with petty attacks; the emperor listened and let them go.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年二年春正月壬辰朔，以歲饑罷元會，禮也。

translations.literal: Zhenyuan 2, spring, first month, renchen new moon: because of famine the New Year audience was suspended — ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan 2 opened without the New Year audience — famine made it improper.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔以民饑，御膳之費減半，宮人月共糧米都一千五百石，飛龍馬減半料；

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict stated that because the people hungered, imperial meal expenses were halved; palace women's monthly grain ration in all was fifteen hundred shi; Flying Dragon horses' fodder was halved;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the palace halved the imperial table, cut palace women's grain to fifteen hundred shi, and halved fodder for the imperial stud;

sentences.zh: 臺郎御史與兼官出為畿赤令。

translations.literal: palace gentlemen censors and concurrent officials were sent out as metropolitan county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: censors with concurrent posts were sent out as capital county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大雪，平地尺餘。

translations.literal: On gengzi great snow; more than a foot on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi snow piled more than a foot deep.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以散騎常侍劉滋、給事中崔造、中書舍人齊映並守本官，同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On renyin Regular Attendant Liu Zi, Supervising Censor Cui Zao, and Secretariat Drafter Qi Ying were all to keep their original offices and serve as Grand Secretariat Associates.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Liu Zi, Cui Zao, and Qi Ying entered the chancellery while keeping their posts.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎、平章事盧翰為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Secretariat Vice Director and Grand Secretariat Associate Lu Han was made Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Han left the chancellery for the heir's grand mentorship.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以禮部侍郎鮑防為京兆尹，京兆尹韓洄為刑部侍郎，國子祭酒包佶知禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: On dingwei Vice Minister of Rites Bao Fang was made Capital Metropolitan Prefect; metropolitan prefect Han Hui was made Vice Minister of Punishments; National University Director Bao Ji was charged with the Rites Ministry examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Bao Fang became metropolitan prefect, Han Hui vice minister of punishments, and Bao Ji examiner for the civil service.

sentences.zh: 以江陵少尹李復為容州刺史、本管經略使。

translations.literal: Jiangling junior administrator Li Fu was made Rongzhou prefect and commissioner of that circuit's frontier command.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fu was posted to Rongzhou as frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，御史大夫崔縱為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On guichou Censor-in-Chief Cui Zong was made Vice Director of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Cui Zong became vice director of personnel.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫、知制誥、翰林學士吉中孚為戶部侍郎、判度支兩稅，元琇判諸道鹽鐵、榷酒。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Bureau Grandee, drafter of edicts, Hanlin academician Ji Zhongfu was made Vice Minister of Revenue and charged with the two-tax system; Yuan Xiu was charged with salt and iron and wine monopoly on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zhongfu took the two-tax portfolio; Yuan Xiu took salt, iron, and wine monopolies.

sentences.zh: 詔宰相齊映判兵部，李勉判刑部，劉滋判吏部、禮部，崔造判戶部、工部。

translations.literal: An edict assigned Chancellor Qi Ying to judge the War Ministry, Li Mian the Punishments Ministry, Liu Zi the Personnel and Rites ministries, and Cui Zao the Revenue and Works ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellors were assigned to head ministries: Qi Ying war, Li Mian punishments, Liu Zi personnel and rites, Cui Zao revenue and works.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔天下兩稅錢物，委本道觀察使、刺史差人送上都；

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict stated: two-tax money and goods throughout the empire are entrusted to each circuit's observation commissioner and prefect to send persons to deliver to the capital;
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the two-tax revenues were ordered delivered by each circuit's commissioner and prefect;

sentences.zh: 其先置諸道水陸轉運使及度支巡院、江淮轉運等使並停。

translations.literal: the previously established circuit water-and-land transport commissioners, revenue inspection offices, and Jiang-Huai transport commissioners were all stopped.
translations.idiomatic: and the old transport and inspection posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 時崔造專政，改易錢穀，職事多隳敗；

translations.literal: At the time Cui Zao monopolized government; he changed money and grain affairs — duties mostly collapsed in failure;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zao's monopoly on power wrecked fiscal administration;

sentences.zh: 造尋以憂病歸第。

translations.literal: Zao soon returned home with worry and illness.
translations.idiomatic: and he soon left office, ill with anxiety.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，山南樊澤奏破希烈將杜文朝之眾五千，擒文朝以獻。

translations.literal: Second month, guihai: Shannan Fan Ze memorialized defeating five thousand of Xilie's general Du Wenchao's forces and capturing Wenchao for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Fan Ze reported capturing Du Wenchao and five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鹿入含元殿，衛士執之。

translations.literal: On yichou a deer entered Hanyuan Hall; guards seized it.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou a deer wandered into Hanyuan Hall and was caught.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，戶部侍郎元琇為尚書左丞，京兆少尹李竦為戶部侍郎、判鹽鐵榷酒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Vice Minister of Revenue Yuan Xiu was made Minister of the Left; Capital Metropolitan junior administrator Li Song was made Vice Minister of Revenue and charged with salt, iron, and wine monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yuan Xiu became left minister and Li Song took the salt and wine portfolios.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，滑州李澄奏破希烈之眾於鄭州。

translations.literal: Third month, renyin: Li Cheng of Huazhou memorialized defeating Xilie's forces at Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Cheng reported a victory over Xilie at Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以司農卿李模為黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: On yisi Director of Agriculture Li Mo was made Qianzhong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Mo became Qianzhong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月丙寅，淮西李希烈為其牙將陳仙奇所ＣＧ，並誅其妻子，仙奇以淮西歸順。

translations.literal: Fourth month, bingyin: Huaixi Li Xilie was killed by his牙將 Chen Xianqi, who also executed his wife and children; Xianqi brought Huaixi to submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Xilie was slain by his officer Chen Xianqi, who killed the family and surrendered Huaixi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前黔中觀察使元全柔為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuchen former Qianzhong observation commissioner Yuan Quanrou was made Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Yuan Quanrou was sent to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，陜州觀察使李泌奏盧氏山冶出瑟瑟，請禁以充貢奉。

translations.literal: On xinsi Shanzhou observation commissioner Li Bi memorialized that Lushi Mountain smeltery produced green jade; he requested prohibition for tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Bi reported jade at the Lushi Mountain mines and asked to monopolize it for tribute.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「瑟瑟不產中土，有則與民共之，任人採取。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Green jade is not produced in the central land; if there is any, share it with the people — let anyone mine it."
translations.idiomatic: "Jade does not belong to the throne alone," the emperor said. "Let the people dig what they find."

sentences.zh: 」甲申，詔以淮西牙將陳仙奇為蔡州刺史、淮西節度使，都統劉玄佐、李澄、曲環、李皋、賈耽、張建封各與一子正員官，賞平淮、蔡功也。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict made Huaixi guard commander Chen Xianqi Caizhou prefect and Huaixi military commissioner; overall commanders Liu Xuanzuo, Li Cheng, Qu Huan, Li Gao, Jia Dan, and Zhang Jianfeng were each granted one son a regular-rank office — rewarding the pacification of Huai and Cai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Chen Xianqi became Huaixi commissioner; six campaign commanders each received a regular post for a son.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以劍南東川節度使李叔明為太子太傅，以東川兵馬使王叔邕梓州刺史、劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: On dingwei Jiannan East River military commissioner Li Shuming was made Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent; East River military envoy Wang Shuyong was made Zizhou prefect and Jiannan East River military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Shuming became grand preceptor; Wang Shuyong took East Sichuan command.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，自癸巳大雨至於茲日，饑民俟夏麥將登，又此霖澍，人心甚恐，米復千錢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingchen: from guisi great rain continued to this day; starving people awaited the summer wheat about to ripen, yet this downpour came — hearts were greatly afraid; rice again reached a thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: Rain from guisi through bingchen drowned hopes for the summer wheat; grain again hit a thousand cash the dou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以伊西北庭節度留後楊襲古為北庭大都護、伊西北庭節度度支營田瀚海等使。

translations.literal: On dingyou Yi-Xi Beiting military acting commissioner Yang Xigu was made chief administrator of Beiting and commissioner of Yi, Xi, Beiting revenue, garrison-farming, and Hanhai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Yang Xigu was confirmed at Beiting with full northwest powers.

sentences.zh: 己亥，百僚請上復常膳；

translations.literal: On jihai the hundred officials begged the emperor to resume regular meals;
translations.idiomatic: On jihai officials urged the emperor to restore the normal palace table;

sentences.zh: 是時民久饑困，食新麥過多，死者甚眾。

translations.literal: at the time the people had long been famine-weary; eating new wheat in excess — the dead were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: the hungry ate green wheat too greedily and died in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 伊西北庭節度使李元忠卒，贈司空。

translations.literal: Yi-Xi Beiting military commissioner Li Yuanzhong died; he was posthumously made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuanzhong of Beiting died and was posthumously made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大風雨，街陌水深數尺，人有溺死者。

translations.literal: On xinyou great wind and rain; streets and lanes several chi deep in water; some people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou a storm flooded the streets waist-deep and drowned residents.

sentences.zh: 癸未，橫海軍使、滄州刺史程日華卒，以其子懷直權知軍州事。

translations.literal: On guawei Transverse Sea Army commissioner and Cangzhou prefect Cheng Rihua died; his son Huaizhi was allowed to act as temporary administrator of the army and prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guawei Cheng Rihua of Cangzhou died; his son Huaizhi succeeded him acting commander.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，黔中觀察使理所復在黔州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuzi: the Qianzhong observation commissioner's seat of government was again at Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Qianzhong commissioner returned his seat to Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以開州別駕白志貞為果州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao former Kaizhou registrar Bai Zhizhen was made Guozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Bai Zhizhen became Guozhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 乙未，福建觀察盧惎卒。

translations.literal: On yiwei Fujian observation commissioner Lu Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Lu Qi, Fujian commissioner, died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以虔王諒為申光、隨、蔡節度大使，以淮西兵馬使吳少誠為蔡州刺史、知節度留後，加東都留守賈耽東都畿唐、汝、鄧都防禦觀察使，以隴右行營節度使曲環為陳許節度使。

translations.literal: On jiyou Prince of Qian Li Liang was made grand commissioner of Shen, Guang, Sui, and Cai; Huaixi military envoy Wu Shaoqing was made Caizhou prefect and acting commissioner; eastern capital protector Jia Dan was advanced as eastern capital Ji-Tang-Yu-Deng metropolitan defense and observation commissioner; Longyou campaign commissioner Qu Huan was made Chen-Xu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Liang took the Shen-Guang-Sui-Cai command; Wu Shaoqing held Caizhou; Jia Dan and Qu Huan received enlarged posts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以鄜坊節度唐朝臣為單于大都護、振武綏銀節度使，右金吾大將軍論惟明為鄜州刺史、鄜坊都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuwu Yan-Fang commissioner Tang Chaochen was made chief administrator of the Shanyu Protectorate and Zhenwu-Sui-Yin military commissioner; Right Golden Guards grand general Lun Weiming was made Yan prefect and Yan-Fang metropolitan defense and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Tang Chaochen went to the northern frontier; Lun Weiming took Yan-Fang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以金吾大將軍董晉為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On jisi Golden Guards grand general Dong Jin was made Vice Director of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Dong Jin became right vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，右散騎常侍蔣沇卒。

translations.literal: On gengchen Right Regular Attendant Jiang Mian died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Jiang Mian died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吐蕃寇涇、隴、邠、寧，諸鎮守閉壁自固，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: On bingxu Tibet raided Jing, Long, Bin, and Ning; garrisons closed their walls and held firm; the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Tibet struck the northwest; garrisons shut their gates and Chang'an armed.

sentences.zh: 遣河中節度駱元光鎮咸陽。

translations.literal: Hezhong military commissioner Luo Yuanguang was sent to garrison Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Yuanguang of Hezhong was posted to Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔：「左右金吾及十六衛將軍，故事皆擇勛臣，出鎮方隅，入居侍從。

translations.literal: Ninth month, an edict stated: "The Left and Right Golden Guards and the Sixteen Guards generals — by precedent all select meritorious ministers, going out to garrison corners, entering to attend the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict declared: "The Sixteen Guards and Golden Guards should again honor meritorious men who serve in court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 自天寶艱難之後，衛兵雖然廢闕，將軍品秩尤高。

translations.literal: Since the Tianbao troubles the guard soldiers have indeed been abolished and neglected, yet generals' ranks remain especially high.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tianbao the guards have thinned, yet their generals still rank high.

sentences.zh: 此誠文武勛臣出入轉遷之地，宜增祿秩，以示優崇。

translations.literal: This is truly the place where civil and military meritorious ministers rotate in and out — salaries and ranks should be increased to show exceptional honor.
translations.idiomatic: These posts are the ladder of civil and military honor and deserve richer pay.

sentences.zh: 並宜加給料錢及隨身糧課，仍舉故事，置武班朝參，其廊下食亦宜加給。

translations.literal: All should receive added stipend money and personal grain rations; still follow precedent and establish a martial court attendance; corridor meals should also be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Raise their stipends, corridor rations, and martial court privileges.

sentences.zh: 其十六衛各置上將軍一人，秩從二品；

translations.literal: Each of the Sixteen Guards is to establish one senior general, rank from second grade;
translations.idiomatic: Each guard shall have a senior general of second rank;

sentences.zh: 左右金吾上將軍，俸料次於六統軍支給。

translations.literal: the Left and Right Golden Guards senior generals' salaries are to be paid after the six supreme army commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Golden Guard pay shall rank just below the six supreme commanders.

sentences.zh: 欲求致理，必藉兼才，文武遞遷，不全限隔。

translations.literal: To seek good order one must rely on combined talent; civil and military rotation in turn — not wholly limited and separated.
translations.idiomatic: Good government needs men skilled in both civil and military service.

sentences.zh: 自今內外文武缺官，於文武班中量才望相參敘用。

translations.literal: From now on, for inner and outer civil and military vacancies, from civil and military ranks measure talent and reputation and appoint in mutual reference.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth fill vacancies from both civil and military rolls by merit.

sentences.zh: 仍依故事，於本衛量置衛兵。

translations.literal: Still follow precedent and in each guard establish guard soldiers in measure.
translations.idiomatic: Restore guard complements in each command.

sentences.zh: 所司條件以聞。

translations.literal: The relevant offices are to set conditions and report.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were ordered to draft regulations and report.

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，義成軍節度、鄭滑觀察等使、檢校尚書左僕射、滑州刺史、武威郡王李澄卒。

translations.literal: 」 On dingyou Fengcheng Army military commissioner, Zheng-Hua observation commissioner, acting Minister of the Left, Huazhou prefect, Prince of Wuwei Li Cheng died.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict. On dingyou Li Cheng of Fengcheng and Wuwei died.

sentences.zh: 以東都畿、唐、鄧、汝等防禦觀察使賈耽檢校尚書右僕射，兼滑州刺史、義成軍節度、鄭滑等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Eastern capital Ji, Tang, Deng, and Ru defense and observation commissioner Jia Dan was made acting Minister of the Right, concurrent Huazhou prefect, Fengcheng Army military commissioner, and Zheng-Hua and attached prefectures observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Dan succeeded Li Cheng on the Henan front.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以吏部侍郎崔縱檢校禮部尚書、東都留守、東都畿唐鄧汝防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Vice Director of Personnel Cui Zong was made acting Minister of Rites, eastern capital protector, and eastern capital Ji-Tang-Deng-Ru defense and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Cui Zong became Luoyang protector and Henan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，敕左右衛上將軍、大將軍並於衛內宿。

translations.literal: On jihai an order stated: Left and Right Guard senior generals and grand generals are all to lodge within the guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai guard generals were ordered to reside in their barracks.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吐蕃寇好畤，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: On yisi Tibet raided Hao; the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Tibet raided Hao and Chang'an armed again.

sentences.zh: 李晟部將王佖擊吐蕃於汧陽城，敗其中軍。

translations.literal: Li Sheng's subordinate Wang Bi struck Tibet at Qianyang City and defeated their center army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bi, Li Sheng's lieutenant, routed the Tibetan center at Qianyang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，寇鳳翔，李晟出師御之，一夕而退。

translations.literal: On xinhai they raided Fengxiang; Li Sheng took the field against them and in one night withdrew them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Sheng drove Tibet from Fengxiang overnight.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，奏關內、河中，河南等道秋夏兩稅、青苗等錢，悉折納粟麥，兼加估收糴以便民，從之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renwu: it was memorialized that within Guannei, Hezhong, Henan, and other circuits the autumn and summer two-tax and green-sprout monies were all to be commuted to grain and wheat payment, with added valuation for government purchase to benefit the people — granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the court allowed tax cash in several circuits to be paid in grain at favorable rates.

sentences.zh: 是月，李晟破吐蕃摧沙堡。

translations.literal: That month Li Sheng broke Tibet's Cuisha Fort.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Sheng took Tibet's Cuisha Fort.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，冊淑妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiawu: Consort Shu, Lady Wang, was enfeoffed empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Lady Wang became empress.

sentences.zh: 乙未，兩浙節度使韓滉來朝。

translations.literal: On yiwei Zhejiang East and West military commissioner Han Huang came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Han Huang arrived for audience.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，冊皇后王氏。

translations.literal: On dingyou Empress Wang was invested.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the investiture rites were held.

sentences.zh: 是日後崩，謚曰昭德。

translations.literal: That day the empress died; posthumous title Zhaode.
translations.idiomatic: She died the same day and was posthumously styled Zhaode.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，吐蕃陷鹽州。

translations.literal: On xinchou Tibet took Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Tibet seized Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，劉玄佐、曲環、鄂岳盧玄卿並來朝。

translations.literal: On renyin Liu Xuanzuo, Qu Huan, and E-Yue Lu Xuanqing all came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Liu Xuanzuo, Qu Huan, and Lu Xuanqing came to audience.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，以韓滉兼度支、諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingsi: Han Huang was additionally made fiscal commissioner and commissioner of salt and iron transport on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Han Huang took the treasury and salt portfolios.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃陷夏州，又陷銀州。

translations.literal: Tibet took Xia Prefecture and also took Yin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet seized Xia and Yin.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以給事中、同平章事崔造為右庶子。

translations.literal: On gengshen Supervising Censor and Grand Secretariat Associate Cui Zao was made Right Subordinate Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Cui Zao left the chancellery for the right subordinate heir's post.

sentences.zh: 貶尚書右丞、度支元琇為雷州司戶，為韓滉誣奏，人以為非罪，諫官屢論之。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Director of the Right and fiscal commissioner Yuan Xiu was demoted to registrar of Leizhou — because Han Huang falsely impeached him; people considered it a wrongful crime; remonstrating officials repeatedly argued the point.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Xiu was exiled to Leizhou on Han Huang's false charge; remonstrators called it injustice.

sentences.zh: 辛未，鳳翔李晟來朝。

translations.literal: On xinwei Li Sheng of Fengxiang came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Sheng came from Fengxiang for audience.

sentences.zh: 壬申，京城畿內榷酒，每斗榷錢一百五十文，蠲酒戶差役，從度支奏也。

translations.literal: On renshen within the capital region wine was monopolized — one hundred fifty cash monopoly per dou; wine-house corvée was remitted — following the fiscal office's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the capital levied a hundred fifty cash per dou of wine and freed brewers from corvée.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年三年春正月丙戌朔。

translations.literal: Zhenyuan 3, spring, first month, bingxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan 3 opened on the bingxu new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以左僕射張延賞同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On renyin Minister of the Left Zhang Yanshang was made Grand Secretariat Associate.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhang Yanshang re-entered the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禮部侍郎薛播卒。

translations.literal: On yisi Vice Minister of Rites Xue Bo died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Xue Bo died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以戶部侍郎李竦為鄂岳觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Vice Minister of Revenue Li Song was made E-Yue observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Song was sent to E-Yue.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以兵部侍郎柳渾同中書門下平章事；

translations.literal: On renzi Vice Minister of War Liu Hun was made Grand Secretariat Associate;
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liu Hun entered the chancellery;

sentences.zh: 劉滋守本官，罷知政事；

translations.literal: Liu Zi kept his original office and ceased managing government affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zi kept his title but left the council;

sentences.zh: 中書舍人、平章事齊映貶夔州刺史。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter and Grand Secretariat Associate Qi Ying was demoted to prefect of Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ying was exiled to Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，度支鹽鐵轉運使、鎮海軍節度、浙江東西道觀察等使、檢校左僕射、同中書門下平章事、晉國公韓滉卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On wuyin fiscal, salt, and iron transport commissioner, Zhenhai Army military commissioner, Zhejiang East and West observation commissioner, acting Minister of the Left, Grand Secretariat Associate, Duke of Jin Han Huang died; posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Han Huang, duke of Jin, died and was posthumously made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 以果州刺史白志貞為潤州刺史、兼御史大夫、浙西觀察使，宣州刺史皇甫政為越州刺史、浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: Guozhou prefect Bai Zhizhen was made Runzhou prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Zhexi observation commissioner; Xuanzhou prefect Huangfu Zheng was made Yuezhou prefect and Zhedong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Zhizhen took Zhexi; Huangfu Zheng took Zhedong.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，詔今年朝集使宜停。

translations.literal: Third month, gengyin: an edict stated this year's court-gathering envoys should stop.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the annual court-gathering missions were canceled.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鳳翔隴右元帥副兵馬使吳詵為福建觀察使，鳳翔都虞候邢君牙為鳳翔尹、本府團練使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Fengxiang-Longyou deputy commander-in-chief Wu Shen was made Fujian observation commissioner; Fengxiang chief commandant Xing Junya was made Fengxiang prefect and regimental training commissioner of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wu Shen went to Fujian; Xing Junya became Fengxiang prefect.

sentences.zh: 丁未，制鳳翔隴右涇原四鎮北庭管內兵馬副元帥、鳳翔隴右道節度使、奉天靖難功臣、司徒兼中書令、鳳翔尹、上柱國、西平郡王、食實封一千五百戶李晟可太尉兼中書令。

translations.literal: On dingwei an order stated: Fengxiang-Longyou, Jingyuan, Four Garrisons, and Beiting campaign deputy commander-in-chief, Fengxiang-Longyou circuit military commissioner, Fengtian Pacification merit-holder, Grand Master of the Court concurrent Grand Secretariat Director, Fengxiang prefect, Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of Xiping commandery, substantive fief one thousand five hundred households Li Sheng may be Grandee of the Court concurrent Grand Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Sheng was promoted to grandee of the court while keeping the Xiping command.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以晟甥元帥兵馬使王佖為右威衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu Sheng's nephew, campaign military envoy Wang Bi, was made senior general of the Right Majestic Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wang Bi, Sheng's nephew, became a Right Majestic Guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，河東馬燧來朝。

translations.literal: On xinhai Hedong Ma Sui came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Ma Sui arrived from Hedong.

sentences.zh: 時蕃相尚結贊使大將論頰熱卑辭厚意告馬燧，請兩國同盟和好，上疑其不誠，不允，故燧自將論頰熱入朝，盛言蕃相請盟，可以保信。

translations.literal: At the time the Tibetan chancellor Shang Jiezan sent the great general Lun Chinje with humble words and thick favors to tell Ma Sui, requesting alliance and good relations between the two states; the emperor suspected insincerity and did not grant it — therefore Sui himself led Lun Chinje to court, greatly stating that the Tibetan chancellor begged alliance and trust could be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet's chancellor sent Lun Chinje to Ma Sui with offers of peace; the emperor doubted them until Sui brought the envoy to court vouching for Tibetan sincerity.

sentences.zh: 上乃從之，許盟於平涼。

translations.literal: The emperor then followed this and permitted alliance at Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed to treaty at Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，詔：「蕃寇雖退，疆理猶虞，安邊之策，必有良算，宜令常參官各陳邊事，隨所見封進以聞。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengshen, an edict stated: "Though Tibetan raiders have withdrawn, the frontier still gives concern; policies to settle the border must have sound plans — let regular-attendance officials each state border affairs and submit sealed memorials as they see fit."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month officials were invited to submit sealed plans for the frontier.

sentences.zh: 」入蕃使崔翰奏於蕃中誘問給役者，求蕃國人馬真數，云凡五萬九千餘人，馬八萬六千匹，可戰者僅三萬人，餘悉老幼。

translations.literal: The envoy to Tibet Cui Han memorialized that in Tibet he questioned conscripted laborers and sought the true numbers of Tibetan men and horses — in all fifty-nine thousand-odd men, eighty-six thousand horses; able to fight barely thirty thousand; the rest all old and young.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Han reported Tibet could field barely thirty thousand men from a host mostly aged or young.

sentences.zh: 庚午，御麟德殿，試《定難樂曲》，馬燧所獻。

translations.literal: On gengwu he held court at Qinde Hall and tested the "Settling Difficulty" music — presented by Ma Sui.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Ma Sui's "Settling Difficulty" suite was performed at Qinde Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，以侍中渾瑊為吐蕃清水會盟使，兵部尚書崔漢衡副之；

translations.literal: Fifth month, dinghai: Palace Attendant Hun Jian was made Tibet Qingshui alliance commissioner; Minister of War Cui Hanheng was deputy;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Hun Jian was named treaty commissioner to Tibet at Qingshui with Cui Hanheng as deputy;

sentences.zh: 瑊與駱元光率師二萬往會盟所。

translations.literal: Jian with Luo Yuanguang led twenty thousand troops to the alliance site.
translations.idiomatic: he and Luo Yuanguang marched twenty thousand men to the meeting.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以左丞暢悅為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingyou Left Vice Director Chang Yue was made Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Chang Yue went to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，左右神策、左右龍武各加將軍一員。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Left and Right Divine Strategy and Left and Right Dragon Martial each added one general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu each elite guard received an additional general.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以嶺南節度使杜佑為尚書右丞，以容管經略使李復為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Lingnan military commissioner Du You was made Vice Director of the Right; Rongguan frontier commissioner Li Fu was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Du You became right vice director; Li Fu took Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 蕃相尚結贊請改會盟之所於原州之土梨樹，神策將馬有麟奏：「土梨地多險厄，恐蕃軍隱伏；

translations.literal: The Tibetan chancellor Shang Jiezan asked to change the alliance site to Tuli Tree in Yuan Prefecture; Divine Strategy general Ma Youlin memorialized: "Tuli ground has many narrows — fear Tibetan troops in ambush;
translations.idiomatic: Tibet asked to meet at Tuli Tree; Ma Youlin warned of ambush in the ravines;

sentences.zh: 不如平涼川，其地坦平，又近涇州。

translations.literal: better Pingliang River — its ground is level and it is near Jing Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: and urged the open ground of Pingliang near Jingzhou."

sentences.zh: 」乃改盟於平涼川。

translations.literal: The alliance was then changed to Pingliang River.
translations.idiomatic: The court moved the conference to Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 十月，東都、河南、江陵、汴州、揚州大水，漂民廬舍。

translations.literal: Tenth month: the eastern capital, Henan, Jiangling, Bianzhou, and Yangzhou suffered great flood; people's houses were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month floods wrecked Luoyang, the Henan towns, Jiangling, Bian, and Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙卯，以國子司業裴胄為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, yimao: Director of Studies Pei Zhou was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Pei Zhou became Hunan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，陜虢李泌獻瑞麥，一莖五穗。

translations.literal: On wuwu Shan-Guo Li Bi presented auspicious wheat — one stalk, five ears.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Bi sent up five-eared wheat as an omen.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔省州縣官員，上州留上佐、錄事、參軍、司戶、司士各一員，中州上佐、錄事、參軍、司戶、司兵各一員，下州上佐、錄事、司戶各一員，京兆河南兩府司錄、判司及四赤丞、簿、尉量留一半，諸赤畿縣留令、丞、尉各一員。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict reduced prefectural and county staff: upper prefectures were to retain one senior aide, registrar, adjutant, revenue clerk, and clerk each; middle prefectures one senior aide, registrar, adjutant, revenue clerk, and militia clerk each; lower prefectures one senior aide, registrar, and revenue clerk each; the two metropolitan prefectures' registrars, judges, and four red counties' assistants, recorders, and magistrates were to retain half in measure; all red metropolitan counties were to retain one magistrate, assistant, and magistrate's aide each.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Yanshang's staff cuts trimmed every prefecture and half the capital bureaucracy to fund the Tibetan war.

sentences.zh: 時宰相張延賞請減官收俸料以助軍討吐蕃故也。

translations.literal: At the time Chancellor Zhang Yanshang requested reducing officials and taking salary to aid the army in attacking Tibet for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: The reductions were meant to pay for campaigns against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，日有黑暈，自辰及申方散。

translations.literal: On renxu the sun had a black halo; from chen to shen it only then dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu a solar halo lasted from morning to mid-afternoon.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以荊南節度使、檢校戶部尚書、嗣曹王皋為襄州刺史、山南東道節度、襄鄧郢安隨唐等州觀察使，以山南東道節度使樊澤為江陵尹、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai Jingnan military commissioner, acting Minister of Revenue, Heir Apparent of Cao Wang Gao was made Xiangzhou prefect, Shannan East Circuit military commissioner, and observation commissioner for Xiang, Deng, Ying, An, Sui, and Tang; Shannan East military commissioner Fan Ze was made Jiangling prefect and Jingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Wang Gao took the Han River command; Fan Ze took Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，侍中渾瑊與吐蕃宰相尚結贊同盟於平涼，為蕃兵所劫，瑊狼狽遁而獲免，崔漢衡已下將吏陷沒者六十餘人。

translations.literal: On xinwei Palace Attendant Hun Jian allied with Tibetan chancellor Shang Jiezan at Pingliang; he was seized by Tibetan troops — Jian fled in disarray yet escaped; Cui Hanheng and subordinate generals and officials lost below — more than sixty persons.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Tibet ambushed the Pingliang treaty; Jian escaped but sixty officers including Cui Hanheng were taken.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣使齎書以讓結贊，蕃界不受。

translations.literal: On guiyou an envoy was sent bearing a letter to reproach Jiezan; the Tibetan border did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou a reproach reached Jiezan; Tibet refused the letter.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，枉矢墜於虛危。

translations.literal: On wuyin the Broom Star fell in Xu and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin a comet fell in the Xu–Wei lodges.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以少府監盧嶽為陜虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinsi Junior Chamberlain Lu Yue was made Shan-Guo observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Lu Yue became Shan-Guo commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，太白晝見，凡四十餘日。

translations.literal: That month Venus was seen in daylight for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: Venus shone by day for forty days that month.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，以檢校司徒、侍中馬燧為司徒兼侍中，以贊吐蕃之盟失策而罷兵柄也。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingxu: acting Grand Master of the Court and Palace Attendant Ma Sui was made Grand Master of the Court concurrent Palace Attendant — because he had praised the Tibetan alliance and lost strategy, military power was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Ma Sui was promoted in title but stripped of command for misjudging the Tibetan peace.

sentences.zh: 以陜虢觀察使李泌為中書侍郎、平章事，以左龍武將軍李自良為檢校工部尚書、太原尹、河東節度使。

translations.literal: Shan-Guo observation commissioner Li Bi was made Secretariat Vice Director and Grand Secretariat Associate; Left Dragon Martial general Li Ziliang was made acting Minister of Works, Taiyuan prefect, and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bi entered the chancellery; Li Ziliang took Hedong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，浙西觀察使白志貞卒。

translations.literal: On yisi Zhexi observation commissioner Bai Zhizhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Bai Zhizhen of Zhexi died.

sentences.zh: 是月，吐蕃驅鹽、夏二州居民，焚其州城而去。

translations.literal: That month Tibet drove the residents of Yan and Xia prefectures, burned their prefectural cities, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tibet depopulated Yan and Xia and burned the towns.

sentences.zh: 七月甲寅，渾瑊自盟所來，素服待罪，釋之。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiayin: Hun Jian came from the alliance site, wore plain dress awaiting punishment, and was released.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Jian returned from Pingliang in mourning dress and was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔：「朕頃緣興師備邊，資用不給，遂權議減官，以務集事。

translations.literal: On yimao an edict stated: "We lately because of raising armies and preparing the border, funds were insufficient, and therefore provisionally discussed reducing officials to gather affairs together.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict said: "To pay for defense I cut the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 近聞授官者皆已隨牒之任，扶老攜幼，盡室而行。

translations.literal: Recently We hear that those granted office have all gone to their posts with documents, supporting the old and leading the young, whole households on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Men had already taken up posts and moved their families;

sentences.zh: 俸祿未請，歸還無所，衣冠之弊，流寓何依？

translations.literal: salaries not yet requested, nowhere to return — the plight of the official class, where are they to lodge?
translations.idiomatic: salaries unpaid, with nowhere to turn — officials were stranded on the road.

sentences.zh: 其先敕所減官員，並宜仍舊。

translations.literal: The officials reduced in the prior edict are all to be as before."
translations.idiomatic: All posts cut by the prior edict are restored."

sentences.zh: 」初既減員，內外咨怨張延賞。

translations.literal: At first, when staff was reduced, inner and outer circles complained against Zhang Yanshang.
translations.idiomatic: The cuts had made Zhang Yanshang hated throughout the court.

sentences.zh: 李泌初入相，乃諷官論之，乃下此詔。

translations.literal: Li Bi had newly entered the chancellery and therefore prompted officials to argue the point — only then was this edict issued.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bi, new to power, had officials protest until this reversal was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，平涼陷蕃官員崔漢衡已下各與一子正員官。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Pingliang officials lost to Tibet, including Cui Hanheng and those below — each was granted one son a regular-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen each captive from Pingliang, down to Cui Hanheng, received a regular post for a son.

sentences.zh: 以左羽林大將軍韓潭為夏州刺史、夏綏銀等州節度使。

translations.literal: Left Feathered Forest grand general Han Tan was made Xiazhou prefect and Xia-Sui-Yin military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tan became Xiazhou commissioner on the northern line.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜駱元光姓曰李元諒。

translations.literal: On renshen Luo Yuanguang was granted the surname Li and the name Yuanliang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Luo Yuanguang received the imperial surname Li and the name Yuanliang.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事張延賞薨，贈太保。

translations.literal: Minister of the Left, Grand Secretariat Associate Zhang Yanshang died; posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanshang died and was posthumously made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復置吏部小選。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Personnel Ministry's minor selection was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou junior appointments under the Board of Personnel resumed.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinsi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's new moon the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，陷蕃兵部尚書崔漢衡得還。

translations.literal: On dinghai the captive Minister of War Cui Hanheng was able to return.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Cui Hanheng returned from captivity.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以兵部侍郎、平章事柳渾為散騎常侍，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On jichou Vice Minister of War and Grand Secretariat Associate Liu Hun was made Regular Attendant and ceased managing government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Liu Hun left the chancellery for a regular attendant's post.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以給事中王緯為潤州刺史、浙西觀察使，常州刺史劉贊為宣州刺史、宣歙池觀察使。

translations.literal: On renshen Supervising Censor Wang Wei was made Runzhou prefect and Zhexi observation commissioner; Changzhou prefect Liu Zan was made Xuanzhou prefect and Xuan-She-Chi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Wei took Zhexi and Liu Zan the Xuan-She-Chi command.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，貶前門下侍郎、平章事蕭復為太子左庶子，饒州安置，坐宗人位、佩、儒、偲、鼎等連郜國長公主奸蠱事也。

translations.literal: On wuxu former Secretariat Vice Director and Grand Secretariat Associate Xiao Fu was demoted to Left Subordinate Heir Apparent, settled at Raozhou — sitting in the affair of clansmen Wei, Pei, Ru, Si, and Ding connecting with the Princess of Guo in sorcery and poison.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Xiao Fu was exiled to Raozhou for kin tied to the Princess of Guo's poisoning plot.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，吐蕃犯寒，諸軍戒嚴。

translations.literal: On wuchen Tibet raided in cold weather; all armies went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen a winter Tibetan raid put the armies on alert.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，吐蕃大掠汧陽、吳山、華亭界民庶，徙於安化峽西。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingsi: Tibet greatly plundered the people of Qianyang, Wushan, and Huating and moved them west of Anhua Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Tibet swept Qianyang, Wushan, and Huating and deported the people beyond Anhua Gorge.

sentences.zh: 庚申，左庶子崔造卒。

translations.literal: On gengshen Left Subordinate Heir Apparent Cui Zao died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Cui Zao died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，回紇可汗遣使合闕將軍請婚於我，許以咸安公主降之。

translations.literal: On guihai the Uyghur qaghan sent the envoy Heluo General to request marriage; the emperor agreed to marry the Princess of Xian'an to him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Uyghur qaghan sought marriage and was promised the Princess of Xian'an.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吐蕃陷華亭，又陷涇州之連雲堡。

translations.literal: On bingyin Tibet took Huating and also took Lianyun Fort in Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Tibet seized Huating and Jingzhou's Lianyun Fort.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，吐蕃退，俘掠邠、涇、隴等州民戶殆盡。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Tibet withdrew, carrying off the households of Bin, Jing, and Long circuits almost to the last.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Tibet retreated after emptying Bin, Jing, and Long of people.

sentences.zh: 自是蕃寇常至涇、隴。

translations.literal: From this Tibet raided often to Jing and Long.
translations.idiomatic: Raids on Jing and Long then became routine.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，吐蕃修原州城，屯據之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Tibet repaired Yuan Prefecture's walls and garrisoned them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Tibet rebuilt and held Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太子太傅李叔明卒。

translations.literal: On dinghai Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent Li Shuming died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Shuming died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，神策將魏循上言：「射生將韓欽緒等十餘人與資敬寺妖僧李廣弘同謀不軌，廣弘自言當為人主，約十月十日大舉，已署置將相名目。

translations.literal: On bingxu Divine Strategy officer Wei Xun memorialized: "The life-taking officers Han Qinxu and more than ten others together with the sorcerer-monk Li Guanghong of Zijing Temple plotted treason; Guanghong declared he was to become ruler of men, set the tenth day of the tenth month for a great rising, and had already appointed ranks of generals and chancellors."
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Wei Xun reported a plot by Han Qinxu and a monk who claimed the throne, set for the tenth of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 」詔捕劾之，連坐死者百餘人；

translations.literal: An edict ordered arrest and investigation; those implicated in succession numbered more than a hundred dead;
translations.idiomatic: Investigation followed; more than a hundred were executed;

sentences.zh: 欽緒游瑰之子，特赦之。

translations.literal: Qinxu was Yougui's son — specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qinxu, Han Yougui's son, alone was spared.

sentences.zh: 是月，復降魚書停刺史務。

translations.literal: That month fish tally was again lowered and prefects' duties suspended.
translations.idiomatic: That month imperial tallies again relieved prefects of certain duties.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，以湖南觀察使趙憬為給事中。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingchou: Hunan observation commissioner Zhao Jing was made supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhao Jing of Hunan became a supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 是夜，京師地震者三，鳥巢散落。

translations.literal: That night the capital quaked three times; birds' nests scattered and fell.
translations.idiomatic: That night Chang'an shook thrice and birds' nests fell from the eaves.

sentences.zh: 壬申，禁商人不得以口馬兵械市於黨項。

translations.literal: On renshen merchants were forbidden to sell mouths, horses, or weapons to the Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen trade in slaves, horses, and arms with the Tangut was banned.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鄜坊節度使論惟明卒。

translations.literal: On xinchou Yan-Fang military commissioner Lun Weiming died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Lun Weiming of Yan-Fang died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，作玄英觀於大明宮北垣。

translations.literal: That year the Xuanying Abbey was built on the northern wall of the Great Bright Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Xuanying Abbey rose on the north wall of Daming Palace.
